Title: Consultant Data Science - Healthcare (m/f/d)
Description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Statista Healthcare

Statista Healthcare is a vertical business unit of Statista, focused on making healthcare quality transparent, measurable, and comparable across countries, care settings, and specialties. We work with leading healthcare stakeholders worldwide to support data-driven quality measurement and transformation by combining in-depth analytical expertise with scalable technology and communication power.

Our offerings span international rankings, ratings, benchmarking studies, and customized consulting projects. Our global healthcare rankings and hospital ratings are published in collaboration with our trusted media partner Newsweek, enabling high visibility and credibility across markets.

We help healthcare organizations define relevant key performance indicators, validate and harmonize data structures, and translate insights into actionable strategies. At the heart of our approach is a data driven understanding of healthcare quality, grounded in robust methodologies, global comparability, and stakeholder trust.

In our consulting projects, we support healthcare providers and systems in developing tailored KPI frameworks, standardizing and validating data processes, and deriving actionable insights that enable measurable improvements in patient care and system-level performance. We combine structured methodologies with hands-on delivery to unlock the full value of healthcare quality data.

Your Role

As Consultant Data Science - Healthcare, you will join our international team of data professionals, supporting the analytical backbone of Statista’s healthcare activities.

Your work will focus on the collection, processing, and analysis of healthcare data that power our Rankings, Ratings, and Benchmarking projects.

In Benchmarking and custom quality development projects with healthcare providers and other stakeholders you will be part of an interdisciplinary project team that works directly with our clients.

You will work hands-on with large and diverse datasets, transform raw data into clean, structured information, and contribute to the automation of our analytical workflows.

Your work will directly support Statista’s mission to make healthcare quality measurable, comparable, and actionable - globally.

Responsibilities


Support in maintaining and further developing Statista’s ranking and rating databases, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and scalability
Collaborate on data pilots and benchmarking projects — from design and metric development to scoring and results analysis, interacting directly with our clients as part of an interdisciplinary Statista project team
Integrate, clean, and standardize external datasets from hospitals, ministries, and partners for unified use in Statista’s healthcare products
Develop and document data models and scoring frameworks in alignment with the Healthcare Analysis and IT teams
Support the development of Statista’s Unified Health Database and future Healthcare Data Platform
Perform internal analyses and reporting to improve data quality and performance metrics of existing healthcare products
Ensure data validation and reproducibility, including peer review and internal QA checks.
Actively contribute ideas for new data-driven healthcare products and improvement of existing workflows


Your profile


Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Public Health, or related field
4+ years of experience in data analytics, modeling, or applied statistics, ideally within healthcare or another data-intensive field in a consulting or client-facing role
Proven skills in Python and SQL, proven experience with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar), including dashboard design and storytelling with data
Strong analytical mindset and ability to transform complex data into actionable insights
Basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts is advantageous
Fluent in English, German a plus
Highly structured, curious, and motivated to work in an international and cross-functional environment


What We Offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:


Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year
Hybrid work and flex-time
International team and social events
Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options
Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities
Career & training opportunities
Attractive locations and modern offices
Mental health support with OpenUp


Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
Team description

The Central Product Analytics team sits at the heart of how SumUp understands and improves the experience of millions of merchants using our products every day. This role owns the Engagement domain — covering merchant engagement, product activation, support responses, and navigation across the SuperApp and web dashboard — and is the primary analytics partner for the Engagement product team. It's a genuine opportunity to take full ownership of a domain, build the measurement foundations from the ground up, and shift the team from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-led decision-making.

What you'll do


Define event taxonomies and measurement plans, implement and QA tracking (GA4), and make sure analytics is built into new product features from day one
Build and maintain scalable datasets in Snowflake — including funnels, customer behaviour models, and feature adoption metrics — and use them to generate insights that directly inform product decisions
Design and evaluate A/B tests: define success metrics, assess statistical validity, and communicate results clearly to product and engineering stakeholders
Create and maintain intuitive dashboards and reusable query templates in Tableau that help teams answer their own questions without always needing an analyst
Partner with product managers to develop and map out KPI trees, identify measurement gaps, and improve the quality and accuracy of engagement tracking across the domain


You'll be great for this role if…


Proven experience as a Data or Product Analyst, with a strong track record of working with customer behaviour data and translating it into product decisions.
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including writing, optimising, and validating queries, building data models, and participating in code reviews.
Strong knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI, and experience with data warehousing platforms like Snowflake, Postgres, or Redshift.
Comfortable designing and analysing end-to-end experiments, including A/B tests and feature flag rollouts, with a solid understanding of statistical validity.
Ability to communicate complex data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong written and verbal English skills.


Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🏋️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Als Consultant AI & Data Analytics (m/w/d) berätst du Mandanten im Risikomanagement nachhaltig. In diesem Rahmen erarbeitest und setzt du innovative, cutting-edge Lösungen um.

Artificial Intelligence: Dein Fokus liegt auf diversen Leistungskernen und ihrem Einsatz: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, Trustworthy AI

Abschluss in Informatik, Statistik, Finanz-/Wirtschaftsmathematik, Ingenieurwesen oder Naturwissenschaften, Know-how in Programmiersprachen und Analysewerkzeugen
Sicherer Umgang mit Python und Frameworks (sklearn, TensorFlow, Keras, Pytorch) oder R (bzw. Java, C++), Daten-Mgt (SQL, Spark, Hadoop) und Analyse-Tools (u.a. Qlik, Tableau)
Freude an komplexen Aufgaben und wie sie ebenso kreativ wie konzeptionell zu lösen sind - vor allem mit Daten und statistischer Modellierung
Winning Attitude, die sich im Tagesgeschäft in unternehmerischem Handeln, Wissbegierde und Kreativität sowie einer kunden- und teamorientierten Haltung zeigt
Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift

Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen
Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits

Contract Type: Permanent

Salary Range: £50,000 - £65,000 Dependent on Experience

Data Analyst: Ageas are looking for a Data Analyst, to grow our dynamic and growing Data & AI function, to support in the analysis and design on relevant projects, whilst ensuring traceability of outcome through all stages of the project lifecycle.

As a Data Analyst, you will be crucial in Proactively identify opportunities in data to accelerate product development, as well as creating, maintaining & automating business intelligence dashboards and self-serve capability

Main Responsibilities as Data Analyst:


Help define the right metrics/kpis across different teams and build out tracking frameworks
Prioritise, delivering and reporting projects, trends & requests.
Ensure data quality and integrity.
Work with architects on best design for data products, evaluating and experimenting with new data tools & supporting ML & AI infrastructure and workflows
Thrives working in a fast-paced trading environment where insight is key to strategy

Proficient in SQL & Python. PySpark & SparkSQL a bonus.
Strong data viz skills using tools for presenting results such as Tableau or Power BI.
Ability to write efficient code is essential for writing and troubleshooting queries involving complex joins and functions. Use of Gitis advantageous.
Ability to prioritise, multi-task, work to tight deadlines and a ‘deliver & iterate’ mindset.
Experience using LLM APIs to perform analysis or AI assistant coding tools would be beneficial.

Flexible Working- Smart Working @ Ageas gives employees flexibility around location (as long as it’s within the UK) and, for many of our roles, flexibility within the working day to manage other commitments, such as school drop offs etc. We also offer all our vacancies part-time/job-shares. We also offer a minimum of 35 days holiday (inc. bank holidays) and you can buy and sell days.

Supporting your Health- Dental Insurance Health Cash Plan, Health Screening, Will Writing, Voluntary Critical Illness, Mental Health First Aiders, Well Being Activities – Mindfulness.

Supporting you at Work- Well-being activities, mindfulness sessions, Sports and Social Club events and more.

Supporting you and your Family- Maternity/pregnant parent/primary adopter entitlement of 16 weeks at full pay and paternity/non-pregnant parent/co-adopter at 8 weeks’ full pay.

Benefits for Them- Partner Life Assurance and Critical Illness cover.

Get some Tech- Deals on various gadgets including Wearables, Tablets and Laptops.

Getting around- Car Salary Exchange, Cycle Scheme, Vehicle Breakdown Cover.

Supporting you back to work- Return to work programme after maternity leave.

About Ageas:

We are one of the largest car and home insurers in the UK. Our People help Ageas to be a thriving, creative and innovative place to work. We show this in the service we provide to over four million customers.

As an inclusive employer, we encourage anyone to apply. We’re a signatory of the Race at Work Charter and Women in Finance Charter, member of iCAN and GAIN. As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to ensuring our recruitment processes are fully inclusive. That means if you are applying for a job with us, you will have fair access to support and adjustments throughout your recruitment experience. If the list does not cover the support you need, please contact our Recruitment Team to discuss how they can help. We have a zero-tolerance approach towards any form of harassment during the recruitment process, ensuring that everyone is treated with respect and professionalism.

Our aim is to have great people everywhere in our business and we’re always looking for outstanding people to join us. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




-Hybrid Working / Entertainment Industry / International Environment-

A well-known Japanese entertainment company is recruiting for an experienced Data Analyst to join its Data Analytics team.

The role supports end-to-end data analytics across the business.

The ideal candidate should have at least 3 years of data analysis experience with strong Excel, Python and SQL skills, as well as the ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

(Ref: MK47548 - Please include this when making any enquiries.)




Main Responsibilities

Analyse sales performance by product, branch, language and region
Conduct customer-level performance analysis to support sales activities
Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock and shortfall risks
Analyse event participation and regional trends to support business planning
Prepare analytical reports and supporting materials for internal stakeholders and Japan HQ
Maintain and update sales forecasts using order data and actual sales results
Compare order quantities against forecasts and sales targets, identifying potential risks
Support annual budget planning using historical performance and forecast data
Provide data analysis for distributor rebates and related commercial discussions
Create, maintain and improve Tableau dashboards and recurring management reports
Maintain data pipelines integrating multiple internal and external data sources
Perform data cleaning, transformation and validation to maintain data quality
Conduct ad hoc analysis covering inventory, marketing, events and other business requirements




Ideal Candidate

At least 3 years of experience in a data analysis role
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Proficient in Excel, Python and SQL, including working with large datasets and forecasting
Experience creating and maintaining dashboards and management reports
Strong understanding of data cleaning, transformation, validation and data pipelines
Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce accurate analytical outputs
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data and analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders
Ability to manage multiple tasks and changing deadlines
Experience supporting commercial, sales or planning-related analysis would be advantageous
Experience with Tableau would be advantageous




Conditions

Location: Windsor, UK
Working Style: hybrid
Salary: depending on experience
Job Type: permanent, full-time
Working Hours: Monday to Friday
Start: negotiable




We regret that we cannot accept applications from Working Holiday, Graduate or Student visa holders.

Title: Solution Design Analyst
Description:
At Gist, we're proud to be part of the M&S Group, the logistics engine behind M&S Food.

From our distribution centres to our transport operations and support functions, we connect people, technology and expertise to ensure the right products reach the right stores at the right time.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and network, there's never been a more exciting time to join Gist and help shape the future of food logistics.

The Opportunity

Our Solution & Optimisation team have an exciting opportunity for an analytically strong Solution Design Analyst where you will support both M&S and Gist on the network renewal programme applying analytical techniques to produce outputs which will be instrumental in shaping the future network, automation and design processes.

This pivotal role will see you working either at our Gist Chineham or M&S Paddington offices with the ability to work from home.

What You'll Be Doing

Reporting into the Head of Solutions, you will be crucial in applying problem solving to a range of operational and organisational challenges where you will engage with both M&S and Gist stakeholders to drive change projects gaining buy-in and agreement. You will take time to understand the M&S and Gist data structure and access to enable you to recommend the most suitable solution.

This role will see you forming new analytical techniques to solve complex problems and challenges in a practical, robust and coherent way. You will use analytical skills to support the wider team to drive informed decision making and produce compelling outputs and communicate with senior stakeholders to help shape their thinking on materials and information gathered.

What We're Looking For

To be successful in your application you will hold a mathematical or data science degree with proven analytical experience and advanced skills in programme language, Python, and SQL.

You will be able to formulate concise approaches to analytical problem solving, producing and interpreting compelling materials explaining complex problems and outputs. It goes without saying that you will be a strong communicator and influencer with the ability to form excellent working relationships at all levels both within Gist and M&S.

Role Details


Salary: Up to £64,000 per annum + Bonus
Working pattern: 37.5 hours per week Monday to Friday.


What’s in it for you?

As Well As a Competitive Salary, You'll Benefit From


20% M&S discount on most things from furniture, fashion and food
25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays (rising with length of service)
Discounted rates on healthcare cash plan
Attractive annual bonus scheme, based on M&S performance and personal objectives
Auto Enrolment Pension or competitive Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and life assurance (up to 4 times salary)
Amazing perks and discounts via our App to major restaurants and retailers
Access to a wide range of wellbeing support – including our Employee Assistance Programme
A first-class welcome with a tailored induction and a wide range of training schemes to help with your learning and development
Cycle to work scheme


Why Gist?

When you join Gist, you're joining a business that plays a critical role within the M&S Group.

You'll have the opportunity to influence meaningful change, work alongside experienced leaders and contribute to one of the UK's leading food supply chains.

Our culture is built around our values of beingProgressive, Accountable, Collaborative and Ethical, creating an environment where people are trusted, supported and encouraged to grow.

Whether you're leading a site operation, delivering transformation or shaping future strategy, your work will make a real difference.

Our commitment to inclusion

At Gist, we believe our differences make us stronger.

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to succeed. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of our recruitment process, please let us know. We'll work with you to ensure you have the support you need.

Title: Data Analyst (0448)
Description:
Make your career count

At Price Bailey, we provide exciting opportunities for training, personal growth and career engagement. We believe in fostering happiness and fulfilment in your work, whilst supporting and inspiring you to grow. We understand that your life extends beyond the workplace, which is why our Smart Working culture promotes flexibility, allowing you to choose when and where you work, whilst still providing excellent client care.

We are a well-established, independently owned firm of chartered accountants and business advisors, offering a comprehensive range of services including audit, accounting, tax, and corporate finance. We proudly support a diverse client base across the UK and internationally, with a strong focus on entrepreneurial, owner-managed businesses that share our passion for innovation.

What do the team do?

Our IT team plays an important role in helping the firm operate more efficiently, make better-informed decisions and continue to improve the way we deliver services to our clients.

As part of our growing data and digital transformation team, you will help develop, maintain and enhance reporting and analytical solutions that support decision-making across the firm. Working primarily with data from our Practice Management System and associated business applications, you will transform complex data into meaningful insight using SQL, Power BI and other Microsoft technologies.

Because your perspective shapes trends.

Innovate, your way.

Merchandising at Primark

Our merchandising team turn strategic goals into vast opportunities. Here, your insights will maximise our growth as a business and ensure we continue to stay at the forefront in the world of retail fashion.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You'll do as Data Governance Analyst – Smart Retail Ordering (SRO)

We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:


Support the rollout of data governance practices within the Smart Retail Ordering (SRO) programme, working with Data Owners and stakeholders across technology, retail, and supply chain functions to establish clear data ownership and accountability.
Develop and maintain data definitions, business glossaries, standards, and governance documentation for critical SRO data elements.
Improve the quality, consistency, and usability of product, supplier, inventory, and ordering data through effective data quality management and Master Data Management (MDM) practices.
Monitor data quality, manage data issues, conduct root cause analysis, investigate discrepancies, and perform validation and quality checks across data platforms.
Support data lineage and traceability initiatives, providing greater transparency and confidence in ordering, inventory, and stock management decisions.
Partner with business and technology teams to embed governance principles into new SRO processes and systems, while delivering training and guidance to promote best practices in data management.
Drive continuous improvement by preparing ad hoc reports and data extracts, identifying and implementing process enhancements, transforming data analysis processes for greater accuracy and scalability, and supporting governance reviews, audits, and risk management activities.


What You’ll Bring 

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:


Proven experience in data governance, data quality, or data management, with a strong understanding of retail buying, merchandising principles, and retail, supply chain, merchandising, or operational data.
Strong ability to work effectively with both business stakeholders and technical teams, building collaborative relationships and driving alignment across functions.
Highly analytical, with experience identifying, investigating, and resolving data quality issues to support accurate and reliable business information.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment, adapting to changing priorities while maintaining high standards of delivery.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence audiences at all levels.
Demonstrates a high level of integrity, professionalism, diplomacy, and tact, supported by strong planning, organisational, prioritisation, and multitasking skills to deliver work within agreed timelines.


Excited? Good. Because it’s energising to put your skills to work, in a growing global business committed to encouraging people to express themselves – and feel a sense of belonging. Apply to be part of Primark’s future, today… and enjoy career growth, our way.

And finally, we succeed Together.

Developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports that provide clear visibility of framework performance
Using Excel, Power Query and DAX to transform project information into reliable reporting outputs
Analysing trends and data gaps, translating them into simple, decision-ready insights
Administering SharePoint-based lists, libraries and registers used by the PMO
Coordinating PMO data returns and supporting governance forums, meeting packs and reporting calendars



What are we looking for?

This role of Junior Data / Power BI Analyst is great for you if:


You have strong analytical ability, curiosity and attention to detail
You have experience in Power BI, Power Query, DAX, Excel, dashboards or business intelligence
You're comfortable using SharePoint or willing to develop administration skills for structured information management
You can translate data into insight and produce outputs that support decision-making
You're confident communicating with stakeholders and have an interest in learning PMO and project governance

Title: OAM Asset Data Analyst
Description:
Closing Date

2026-09-04

Job Title: OAM Asset Data Analyst

Location: Durrington, Worthing

Contract Type: Permanent

Hours: 37

Salary: From £35,100 based on skills and experience

About The Role

The purpose of the OAM (Operational Asset Management) Asset Data Analyst role is to lead and drive improvements in Southern Water's asset data quality, ensuring asset information is trusted, governed and fit for operational and strategic decision making.

The role will take ownership of key asset data improvement initiatives, with a particular focus on Below Ground assets. Working across Operational Asset Management, GIS and business stakeholders, the successful candidate will identify opportunities, define solutions and drive the delivery of sustainable improvements that strengthen the relationship between Maximo and GIS.

This role is not solely focused on analysis. It requires someone who can influence stakeholders, challenge existing practices and act as a catalyst for continuous improvement in asset data management.

What You Will Be Responsible For

 The OAM Asset Data Analyst will act as a subject matter expert for asset master data and will be accountable for identifying, prioritising and driving asset data improvements across Southern Water.

Key Responsibilities Include


Leading initiatives to improve the quality, completeness and integrity of Below Ground asset and location data across Maximo and GIS.
Acting as the primary liaison between OAM and GIS teams to define and maintain an integrated asset and location data model and management of change process.
Identifying data quality risks, root causes and improvement opportunities, then developing and driving corrective actions through to implementation.
Establishing and monitoring asset data quality measures, reporting performance trends and driving accountability with business stakeholders.
Shaping and influencing business processes to improve the capture, maintenance and governance of asset data at source.
Driving adoption of Maximo asset data products, including Asset Data Manager, Asset Templates, Condition Monitoring and Safety Plans.
Leading analysis activities associated with data migration, enrichment and transformation to support Maximo and future business requirements.
Collaborating with operational, engineering, GIS and digital teams to ensure asset data supports operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and investment planning.
Using data storytelling and visualisation techniques to communicate insights, influence decisions and secure stakeholder buy-in for improvement initiatives.


What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months you will:


Deliver measurable improvements in asset data quality across Maximo and GIS.
Strengthen governance and management of change processes between asset and spatial data systems.
Develop trusted reporting and insights that drive business decisions.
Build strong relationships with operational, engineering and GIS stakeholders and become the recognised expert for asset data quality improvements.


What You’ll Bring To The Role

 Skills & Competencies


Self-starter who takes ownership and drives outcomes with minimal supervision.
Able to influence stakeholders across multiple business functions and levels of seniority.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable improvements.
Comfortable challenging existing processes and working practices where data quality can be improved.
Able to lead complex workstreams from concept through to delivery.
Strong communication and data storytelling skills, able to translate technical findings into business outcomes.
Passionate about improving asset information and realising the value of high-quality data. 


Knowledge


Strong understanding of Enterprise Asset Management principles and asset master data.
Experience working with Maximo or other Enterprise Asset Management systems.
Understanding of GIS principles, spatial data and asset-location relationships.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management and master data management.
Experience developing data standards, controls and improvement frameworks 


Essential

Qualifications:


Proven experience working as an Asset Analyst or similar


Desirable


Prior experience in a utility or water company


Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain’s water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability, and service excellence. With £7.8bn planned investment for 2025-30, this is an unparalleled opportunity to join a business committed to delivering a generational shift in the way water services are managed.

You will be joining at a time of significant change, working alongside a highly skilled leadership team with a clear vision for the future. We offer an environment where senior professionals can make a meaningful impact, influence major strategic decisions, and drive long-term value creation

"Our mission is to protect and enhance life through water—and we need passionate people to help us achieve it. If you’re inspired by our purpose and believe you can contribute, apply today. You don’t need to meet every criterion; what matters most is your drive to make a difference."

If this role isn’t quite what you’re looking for but are keen to be contacted about opportunities at Southern Water, you can register your details here: Introduce Yourself (myworkdaysite.com- Introduce Yourself)

Our Commitment to Diversity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Additional Information

In line with Southern Water’s security requirements, successful candidates will be required to provide evidence of their identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record check (DBS) and verification of their employment and/or education history for the past three years.

Appointment to this role is subject to the successful completion of all pre‑employment checks, including security vetting.

Please note that if a candidate does not meet the required security standards or fails to pass the vetting process, Southern Water reserves the right to withdraw the offer of employment.

Some positions may also require higher levels of security vetting, which may involve providing additional documentation.

At Whitbread, we're transforming how data powers decisions across our business. As we continue to evolve our modern data platform, we're looking for an experienced Analytics Engineer to help build trusted, scalable data products that enable analytics, reporting, data science and automation across the organisation.

This is an exciting opportunity to sit at the intersection of Data Engineering and Analytics, combining technical expertise with business impact. You'll work with modern cloud technologies, helping shape data products that are reliable, reusable and trusted by teams throughout Whitbread.

Role: Analytics Engineer

Contract Type: Full time, Permanent

Location: Whitbread Court, Dunstable

Salary: £55k-£60k depending on experience

Why You’ll Love It Here


Healthcare: Family BUPA healthcare
10% matched pension
Discounts: Up to 60% discount on Premier Inn stays and 25% discount on our Restaurant brand
Annual Incentive of up to 20% Bonus


Check out all our benefits here: https://www.whitbreadcareers.com/about-us/benefits/

What You’ll Be Doing

As an Analytics Engineer, you'll play a key role in building and developing trusted data products that power decision-making across Whitbread. Working within our modern Databricks-based FLOW platform, you'll design, build and maintain robust data models and transformation pipelines, turning raw data into high-quality, analysis-ready datasets that can be confidently used by teams across the business.

You'll work closely with stakeholders to understand requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions and ensure that data products are accurate, well-documented and easy to reuse. You'll take ownership of testing, governance and continuous improvement, applying engineering best practices to deliver reliable and cost-effective solutions.

Alongside managing your own priorities within an agile delivery environment, you'll contribute to the development of standards across the team, support junior colleagues through coaching and mentoring, and help shape the future evolution of Whitbread's data platform and analytics capabilities

What You’ll Need


Strong Experience developing data products within Databricks or a similar Spark/lakehouse environment.
Strong SQL and Python development skills.
Strong knowledge of data modelling, transformation and dimensional design.
Experience in AI driven development.
A passion for building high-quality data solutions and a strong understanding of modern analytics engineering principles.
Ability to solve problems independently


Be part of our Technology Team at Whitbread

Through collaboration, passion and hiring the smartest minds, our Technology team builds products and services that are used by 38,000 of us at Whitbread and millions of guests. Everything from an eCommerce website that handles £2 billion in transactions per year, applications that are scalable across our 1,200 hotel and restaurants, devices that enable our teams and guests to have a seamless experience, all whilst keeping data secure. Together we’re building the hotel of the future.

We believe that everyone is unique and there should be no barriers to entry and no limits to ambition. We are committed to being an inclusive organisation that values diversity and welcomes your application whatever your background or situation.

Under-represented groups such as women, ethnic minorities, people with disabilities & members of the LGBTQIA+ community (those who identify as lesbian, gay, bi, trans and non-binary or those who use a different LGBTQIA+ term), are strongly encouraged to build a career with us. Speak to us about workplace adjustments, part-time and flexible working. Where possible we will support this.

Title: AI Analyst (London)
Place: City Of London, England, United Kingdom
Description:
AI Analyst — Business Transformation

Location: London

Working pattern: Full-time, five days per week in the Pixi London office

About Pixi

Pixi is a global beauty brand known for innovative skincare and colour cosmetics that enhance natural beauty. Founded in London, Pixi now operates across international retail, ecommerce and marketplace channels.

We are building practical AI capabilities across the business to improve how our teams work, make decisions and serve customers.

The Role

The AI Analyst will turn business problems into practical, reliable solutions.

This is not a role focused only on building bots. You will work directly with teams across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales and Marketplace to understand how work is completed, improve the underlying data and develop AI-enabled workflows that deliver measurable value.

The Role Combines Four Capabilities


Functional business understanding
Problem solving and team enablement
Data management and reporting
Practical AI and automation development


You will be expected to move comfortably between understanding a business problem, working directly with its users, preparing messy data and building or improving the technical solution.

What You’ll Own


Business Analysis and Solution Design
Partner with Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales and Marketplace teams to understand their processes, systems and business requirements
Translate unclear or complex problems into structured requirements, proposed solutions and measurable outcomes
Map current workflows, identify root causes and distinguish between a quick fix, a repeatable workflow and a larger roadmap opportunity
Define the business rules, exceptions, approvals and controls required before development begins
Prioritise work based on business value, effort, risk and scalability
Problem Solving and Business Enablement
Work directly with teams to solve practical problems involving Excel, data, reporting, AI tools and repetitive workflows
Help establish regular AI office hours where employees can bring problems for assessment and support
Train employees to use new AI tools and workflows confidently
Identify recurring themes from individual requests and recommend opportunities for wider automation
Create clear SOPs, user guides, walkthroughs and handover materials
Report emerging opportunities, recurring issues and adoption barriers to the AI Transformation team
Data Management and Reporting
Clean, reconcile and structure data from multiple business systems and spreadsheets
Create repeatable processes for data preparation, validation, transformation and reporting
Document business definitions, field mappings, calculations and data lineage
Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide clear, trusted information
Introduce data-quality checks that identify missing, duplicated or inconsistent information
Support the development of shared datasets and the longer-term foundation for Pixi’s data environment
Ensure workflows have appropriate audit trails, version control and ownership
AI and Automation Development
Design, build and deploy AI-enabled workflows using LLMs, developer CLI tools, APIs, MCP and automation platforms
Connect systems including ERP, ecommerce, CRM, customer service and reporting platforms
Decide where to use AI, deterministic rules or human review based on the accuracy and risk required
Build headless and scheduled workflows where appropriate
Develop testing plans covering accuracy, exceptions, regressions and failure handling
Monitor live workflows and improve them based on performance and user feedback
Apply appropriate privacy, security and access controls


What Success Looks Like


Business problems are translated into clear, practical solutions
Delivered workflows are adopted by their intended users and produce measurable improvements in time, accuracy, cost or decision-making
Data and reporting processes become cleaner, more reliable and easier to repeat
Solutions include documented logic, controls, ownership and handover materials
Small employee requests generate both immediate value and insight into larger opportunities
AI is applied where it adds value rather than added unnecessarily
Business teams become more capable and confident in using AI effectively


Who You Are


You have 2–3 years of experience in business analysis, data analysis, automation, technical operations or AI workflow development
You understand how business functions operate and can learn unfamiliar processes quickly
You have strong Excel skills and practical experience cleaning and reconciling messy datasets
You can use SQL and ideally Python or another scripting language to analyse or transform data
You have worked with APIs, JSON, developer tools and automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, UiPath or similar
You have practical experience using or integrating LLMs such as OpenAI, Claude or equivalent
You can explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users
You are comfortable training colleagues and working directly with teams to solve day-to-day problems
You document your work carefully and pay close attention to detail
You take ownership from initial problem definition through testing, launch and adoption
You know when to ask questions, challenge an assumption or recommend a simpler solution


Helpful Experience


Experience with NetSuite, Shopify, Kustomer or other ERP, ecommerce, CRM or customer service systems
Experience in retail, beauty, consumer goods, ecommerce or marketplace businesses
Experience developing dashboards or working with data warehouses
Familiarity with Git, cloud platforms, data governance or Lean/Six Sigma methods


How We Work

Pixi is entrepreneurial, fast-moving and hands-on. We value people who combine curiosity with execution, communicate clearly and take responsibility for delivering useful results.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape how AI, data and automation are used across a growing global beauty business.

This is not a role focused only on building bots. You will work directly with teams across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales and Marketplace to understand how work is completed, improve the underlying data and develop AI-enabled workflows that deliver measurable value.

The Role Combines Four Capabilities

  • Functional business understanding
  • Problem solving and team enablement
  • Data management and reporting
  • Practical AI and automation development

You will be expected to move comfortably between understanding a business problem, working directly with its users, preparing messy data and building or improving the technical solution.

What You’ll Own

  • Business Analysis and Solution Design
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales and Marketplace teams to understand their processes, systems and business requirements
  • Translate unclear or complex problems into structured requirements, proposed solutions and measurable outcomes
  • Map current workflows, identify root causes and distinguish between a quick fix, a repeatable workflow and a larger roadmap opportunity
  • Define the business rules, exceptions, approvals and controls required before development begins
  • Prioritise work based on business value, effort, risk and scalability
  • Problem Solving and Business Enablement
  • Work directly with teams to solve practical problems involving Excel, data, reporting, AI tools and repetitive workflows
  • Help establish regular AI office hours where employees can bring problems for assessment and support
  • Train employees to use new AI tools and workflows confidently
  • Identify recurring themes from individual requests and recommend opportunities for wider automation
  • Create clear SOPs, user guides, walkthroughs and handover materials
  • Report emerging opportunities, recurring issues and adoption barriers to the AI Transformation team
  • Data Management and Reporting
  • Clean, reconcile and structure data from multiple business systems and spreadsheets
  • Create repeatable processes for data preparation, validation, transformation and reporting
  • Document business definitions, field mappings, calculations and data lineage
  • Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide clear, trusted information
  • Introduce data-quality checks that identify missing, duplicated or inconsistent information
  • Support the development of shared datasets and the longer-term foundation for Pixi’s data environment
  • Ensure workflows have appropriate audit trails, version control and ownership
  • AI and Automation Development
  • Design, build and deploy AI-enabled workflows using LLMs, developer CLI tools, APIs, MCP and automation platforms
  • Connect systems including ERP, ecommerce, CRM, customer service and reporting platforms
  • Decide where to use AI, deterministic rules or human review based on the accuracy and risk required
  • Build headless and scheduled workflows where appropriate
  • Develop testing plans covering accuracy, exceptions, regressions and failure handling
  • Monitor live workflows and improve them based on performance and user feedback
  • Apply appropriate privacy, security and access controls

What Success Looks Like

  • Business problems are translated into clear, practical solutions
  • Delivered workflows are adopted by their intended users and produce measurable improvements in time, accuracy, cost or decision-making
  • Data and reporting processes become cleaner, more reliable and easier to repeat
  • Solutions include documented logic, controls, ownership and handover materials
  • Small employee requests generate both immediate value and insight into larger opportunities
  • AI is applied where it adds value rather than added unnecessarily
  • Business teams become more capable and confident in using AI effectively

Who You Are

  • You have 2–3 years of experience in business analysis, data analysis, automation, technical operations or AI workflow development
  • You understand how business functions operate and can learn unfamiliar processes quickly
  • You have strong Excel skills and practical experience cleaning and reconciling messy datasets
  • You can use SQL and ideally Python or another scripting language to analyse or transform data
  • You have worked with APIs, JSON, developer tools and automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, UiPath or similar
  • You have practical experience using or integrating LLMs such as OpenAI, Claude or equivalent
  • You can explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users
  • You are comfortable training colleagues and working directly with teams to solve day-to-day problems
  • You document your work carefully and pay close attention to detail
  • You take ownership from initial problem definition through testing, launch and adoption
  • You know when to ask questions, challenge an assumption or recommend a simpler solution

Helpful Experience

  • Experience with NetSuite, Shopify, Kustomer or other ERP, ecommerce, CRM or customer service systems
  • Experience in retail, beauty, consumer goods, ecommerce or marketplace businesses
  • Experience developing dashboards or working with data warehouses
  • Familiarity with Git, cloud platforms, data governance or Lean/Six Sigma methods

How We Work

Pixi is entrepreneurial, fast-moving and hands-on. We value people who combine curiosity with execution, communicate clearly and take responsibility for delivering useful results.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape how AI, data and automation are used across a growing global beauty business.

Title: Consultant, Advanced Analytics
Description:
Job Description:

Rakuten International is a division of Rakuten Group, Inc., a Japanese global technology leader in services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Headquartered in San Mateo, California with more than 4,000 employees worldwide, the Rakuten International business portfolio includes market leaders in e-commerce, digital marketing, advertising, communications and entertainment. We create products and services that provide exceptional value by aligning members and the businesses that want to engage them in a shared community.

Rakuten Advertising provides advertising technology and consumer insights to the world’s leading brands and retailers. Working with agencies and brands around the world, Rakuten Advertising unites technology, client strategy and consumer insights to deliver advertising experiences that drive increased brand awareness and marketing performance. With access to Rakuten’s diverse media properties and audiences, combined with an award-winning performance network and proprietary consumer research, Rakuten Advertising creates the right conditions to reach new customers and sustain long-lasting loyalty.

Job Summary:

Responsible for the development and execution of analyses that address specific client issues or initiatives. This role proactively identifies trends and issues utilizing a comprehensive range of analytic techniques and tools, translating complex business questions into actionable analytical solutions. The Consultant liaises directly with client services, network development, and operational personnel, and engages directly with clients to ensure the appropriateness of underlying assumptions and interpretations, and to provide expert direction on client analytics solutions/services, both internally and externally.

Key Responsibilities:


Lead the development and delivery of client analytics and reporting activities, driving client relationship building, and managing the overall project lifecycle of externally focused analytic deliverables.
Independently develop and refine methodologies, tools, and templates to allow for the successful execution of analytic deliverables. Proactively identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency.
Support the ongoing development of the Advanced Analytics group capabilities by sharing innovative approaches and solutions with the broader team, and actively mentor junior team members.
Participate in various activities to support the growth of the Advanced Analytics group including:
Developing and delivering training content to Account Management and other internal functions.
Leading the development and maintenance of appropriate documentation regarding advanced analytic approaches, metric definitions, etc.
Proactively identify client business needs and translate them into robust analytical questions and solution designs.
Present complex analytical findings and strategic recommendations directly to clients, influencing their decision-making processes.

Specific tasks:


Client Insights & Solution Design:
Lead client discussions to define analytical objectives and scope, guiding them towards the most impactful solutions.
Design and execute advanced custom analyses leveraging internal tools/databases (e.g., benchmarking, publisher optimization, program performance analysis), delivering comprehensive insights and strategic recommendations.
Develop and optimize complex trend analyses and performance dashboards, ensuring they align with evolving client needs and provide actionable intelligence.
Data Quality & Operational Excellence:
Oversee and ensure the integrity and accuracy of recurring reports and data pipelines, proactively resolving complex data discrepancies.
Manage and adapt reporting structures to accommodate complex client requirements, including fiscal calendar challenges.
Investigate and resolve complex discrepancies between dashboards and manual reports, implementing long-term solutions for data consistency.
Strategic Support:
Independently assess and forecast sales potential for prospects based on comprehensive data analysis and market insights, providing strategic input to sales teams.
Contribute to the strategic development of new analytical products and services based on client needs and market trends.

Qualifications and Minimum Requirements:

Candidate will have at least 2 years of experience in analytics/reporting, with a strong focus on client-facing roles or significant project ownership. Successful candidates may bring experience from an agency, client, or consulting environment. Bachelor’s degree required.


Advanced Analytical Skills – Expert in analyzing and synthesizing complex information to understand issues, identify root causes, and propose optimal solutions. Demonstrated ability to independently translate ambiguous business requirements into precise analytical questions and comprehensive solution designs. Proven ability to utilize and expand prospective business models.
Technical Abilities - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (including advanced functions, VBA), and strong experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, MicroStrategy) for dashboard development and data visualization. Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation is required. Familiarity with Python or R for advanced analytics and automation is highly beneficial.
Client & Stakeholder Management – Proven ability to independently manage diverse client and internal stakeholder relationships, effectively communicating complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Builds strong networks and acts as a trusted advisor.
Organizing and Planning - Demonstrated ability to independently plan, organize, and prioritize multiple complex projects, effectively balancing resources, skills, priorities, and timescales to achieve objectives.
Adaptability - Adaptable and proactive in responding to changing circumstances, effectively managing, solving problems, and providing innovative solutions in ambiguous environments.
Communicating Effectively – Written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to adjust messaging to fit diverse audiences and deliver compelling presentations that drive action.
Team Player – Proven ability to manage strong working relationships within the company, and actively contribute to team knowledge sharing, mentorship, and best practices.
Critical Thinking – Strong in using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to complex problems.
Plan for Contingencies – Proactively identifies potential problems and independently creates robust contingency plans or “work-arounds” to ensure project success.
Understanding the Business – Knows the mission-critical technical and functional skills needed; understands various types of business propositions and how businesses operate. Continuously learns new methods and technologies.


Five Principles for Success

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

Always improve, Always Advance - Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen

Passionately Professional - Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best

Hypothesize - Practice - Validate – Shikumika - Use the Rakuten Cycle to succeed in unknown territory

Maximize Customer Satisfaction - The greatest satisfaction for our teams is seeing their customers smile

Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! - Always be conscious of time - take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team

Title: Analytics App Developer - 12 month FTC
Description:
Job ID 2026-16975 Date posted 17/08/2026 Location Cambridge, United Kingdom Category Operations

Job Overview

This role sits within the Enterprise Data & Insights (EDI) team, supporting the development of our Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) within Arm Operations.

We enable analytics for business teams through high-quality data products. You will design and build lightweight analytics application on our data platform. This will bring data together from multiple sources and enable business teams to explore, understand and act on trusted insights. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analysts, and business stakeholders to translate user needs into intuitive applications, reusable data products that improve how data is accessed, understood, and used across the organisation.

This is a hands-on application development with strong analytical content. Its initial focus is an application that support training and onboarding, with responsibility for usability, data quality, documentation and adoption.

Responsibilities


Design build, test, deploy and maintain lightweight analytics application, primarily using python and streamlit, to support training and onboarding
Translate business and user requirements into intuitive application workflows, well-structured data models and transparent metrics.
Work closely with Data engineers to ensure data pipelines and reusable data sets meet application and analytical needs
Maintain application code in version control and contribute to testing, technical documentation and development best practices
Develop and maintain reusable datasets, semantic layer, data quality checks, monitoring and reporting for the data used by the applications.
Gather user feedback and iteratively improve application usability, accessibility and adoption
Build dashboards and visualisations where they are the most appropriate way to communicate onboarding, adoption and business metrics
Support onboarding of new users to the data platform, improving accessibility and usability


Required Skills And Experience


Hands on experience developing data or analytic applications in Python using Streamlit, Dash or a similar framework
Experience designing, testing and maintaining user-facing applications, including the use of version control
Strong SQL skills and experience analysing and integrating data sets from multiple sources
Experience with Databricks (or similar modern data platforms)
Working experience with notebooks and Python data libraries and processing frameworks (e.g. Pandas, PySpark)
Understanding of deployment, CI/CD, orchestration and application support practices.


“Nice To Have” Skills And Experience


Experience building dashboards and visualisation using (Databricks SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or a similar tool)
Familiarity with data quality frameworks and automated testing approaches
Understanding of data engineering concepts (pipelines, orchestration, version control)
Exposure to working in a product-oriented or data platform environmen


In Return

This is a meaningful role in shaping our Enterprise Data Platform, with the opportunity to influence how data is accessed, trusted, and used across Arm Operations.

Accommodations at Arm

Hybrid Working at Arm

Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may stop accepting applications if a high volume of applications is received.

At TUI, we're looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to support the development and delivery of business intelligence solutions by gathering requirements, building reports and dashboards, and analyzing data from multiple sources, within the context of TUI's data transformation journey, so that business users across Markets & Airlines can access timely, accurate, and actionable insights to drive commercial decisions and improve business performance.

About Our Offer


Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams.
Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.


About The Job


You'll work in close partnership with Business and Technical teams to analyze, design, and co-create new data products, visualizations, and reporting solutions that are standardized, scalable, and robust to support consistent insight delivery across the business.
You'll develop and maintain Tableau dashboards and reports that meet business requirements and adhere to TUI's design standards and best practices, ensuring standardized metrics and dimensions are used correctly and universally.
You'll write efficient queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from various source systems to support reporting needs across multiple markets.
You'll test and validate data accuracy in reports and dashboards, ensuring quality and consistency across reporting solutions that impact business decisions.
You'll support business users with report interpretation, providing training and guidance on how to effectively use BI tools and dashboards.
You'll collaborate with Data Engineers and Senior Business Intelligence Analysts to understand data structures and implement reporting solutions that align with the overall data architecture.
You'll identify, document and resolve issues with data quality or reporting functionality, proposing solutions and working with the team to implement improvements as part of continuous enhancement initiatives.


About You


You have a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Business Analytics, or equivalent experience in data analytics or business intelligence.
You're proficient in SQL with the ability to write and optimize queries for data extraction and analysis.
You have experience with visualization tools, particularly Tableau, including dashboard creation and report development.
You understand data warehouse concepts and dimensional modelling principles.
You can translate business requirements into technical specifications that meet user needs.
You have analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
You communicate effectively, explaining technical concepts to non-technical users across various business functions.
Knowledge of additional BI tools beyond Tableau and experience with data visualization best practices would be beneficial.
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), version control systems, and data governance principles would be advantageous.
You work collaboratively in team environments, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.


From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Ops Business Intelligence Analyst

We are easyJet – a FTSE listed, £multi-billion low-cost airline that serves tens of millions of customers every single year. If you’re reading this, you have probably already been an easyJet customer, and you’ll know that there is no more iconic (or Orange!) travel brand in Europe.

We fly more than 1,207 routes, connecting 38 countries across Europe, and employ more than 18,000 colleagues. We’re on a mission to make low-cost travel easy – and whatever your role here, you’ll connect millions of people to what they love using Europe’s best airline network, great value fares, and friendly service.

What makes us easyJet? Our Promise Behaviours – we are Safe, Bold, Welcoming and Challenging. Four Behaviours. One Spirit. One easyJet.

Read on if you

Ø Have experience in numerical, analytical, and problem-solving roles within a product or service-related industry

Ø Enjoy using data to drive business performance and operational improvement

Ø Can be in our fantastic Luton head office 3 x per week

The Team

The Operations Insights & Improvements team is at the heart of easyJet’s analytics function, delivering data products and solutions that empower business users across the entire Operations domain. From Engineering and Ground Ops to Crew Planning and Ops Strategy, we work with a wide range of stakeholders to drive operational performance and shape the future of our data strategy.

The Role

Role

As an Ops Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a pivotal role in supporting our operational needs by analysing and reporting on business performance data. You’ll develop reports, visualisations, and presentations that turn complex data into actionable insights, helping key stakeholders make informed decisions. You’ll also:

Ø Support and grow the BI Analyst community, championing best practices and data fluency

Ø Analyse complex datasets and perform ad-hoc analysis to answer business questions

Ø Work with senior team members to establish and monitor KPIs and other performance metrics

Ø Design and deliver technical training for analytical tools and ways of working

Ø Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Ø Ensure data tools and reports are well-documented and accessible

Ø Manage multiple projects independently, delivering accurate and impactful results

What We’re Looking For

Ø Degree or post-graduate qualification in a numerical/analytical subject, or equivalent business experience

Ø Proven experience in a numerical, analytical, and problem-solving role

Ø Experience with or willingness to learn coding languages such as SQL or Python

Ø Familiarity with business intelligence/data visualisation tools (e.g. Tableau, Thoughtspot, PowerBI)

Ø Practical database skills, with a focus on data extraction and transformation

Ø Strong analytical and logical thinking skills

Ø Ability to deliver under pressure in a fast-paced environment

Title: Demand Planner
Description:
About us




Established in 2015 and headquartered in Milton Keynes, England, we are one of the UK's top Amazon sellers, trusted by leading global brands and licensing partners. Specialising in licensed products from iconic brands including Marvel, Disney, Pokémon, Harry Potter, football clubs, KPop Demon Hunters, Minecraft and more, we serve millions of customers worldwide.




Scaling beyond Amazon, our omnichannel strategy spans TikTok Shop, SHEIN, Temu, Debenhams and major marketplaces across Europe, North America, Mexico, and the UAE.




Location: Office-based, in Milton Keynes
Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 per year
Contract: Full-time, Permanent




We’re looking for a proactive and analytical Demand Planner to join our fast-paced eCommerce team. This role is critical in managing inventory levels, forecasting demand, and ensuring we fulfil customer needs efficiently on Amazon. You'll collaborate closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to align on campaign strategies, set promotional deals, and respond quickly to market shifts using data-driven insights.




Key Responsibilities




1. Demand Forecasting & Trend Analysis

Develop accurate short- and mid-term forecasts for eCommerce SKUs based on historical sales, market trends, traffic data, and campaign calendars.
Continuously refine forecasts to respond to rapid changes in consumer behaviour, online trends, and promotional events (e.g., flash sales, influencer drops).

2. Inventory & Fulfilment Management

Ensure the right stock is available at the right time across all eCommerce channels (own site, marketplaces).
Monitor sell-through rates, stock cover, and coordinate replenishment to prevent stockouts or overstocking.
Work with fulfilment and logistics teams to align inventory with sales velocity and shipping SLAs.

3. Promotion & Campaign Planning

Collaborate with Commercial, Marketing teams to plan and forecast for campaigns, new launches, and seasonal events.
Model promotional uplift and evaluate past promo performance to improve planning accuracy.

4. Cross-functional Collaboration·

Participate in weekly S&OP or trading meetings, providing forecast insights and inventory risk updates.
Align demand planning with marketing calendars, sales targets, and supply capabilities.

5. Data, Tools & Reporting·

Use BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and analytics to track performance and build forecast models.·
Proactively identify optimisation opportunities in data flows, planning logic, and decision-making frameworks.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
2–3 years’ experience in demand planning, inventory management, or digital merchandising, ideally within eCommerce or fast-moving consumer goods.
Strong command of data tools (Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI) and demand planning systems.
Familiarity with eCommerce platforms and analytics (e.g., Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, or similar) is a plus.




Key Competencies

Strategic thinker with strong analytical and logical skills.
Comfortable operating in a high-growth, high-speed eCommerce environment.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills across cross-functional teams.
Agile mindset - able to pivot quickly based on new data or business needs.
Passion for data, digital commerce, and customer-centric planning.




Benefits:

Casual dress
On-site parking
Regular social events including summer & end of year parties.
Spontaneous employee well-being treats
A day off for your birthday
Vouchers at Christmas to shop with F&F
Staff Purchases
NEST Pension
Private medical insurance with Vitality Health with various benefits, including discounts on a gym membership.
