Title: Senior Product Analyst 199646
Description:
Senior Product Analyst

Brighton (Hybrid) | £90,000 Base Salary

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing Data & Analytics function at a business that is placing data and AI at the heart of its strategy. As a Senior Product Analyst, you'll help shape how data is used to drive commercial decisions, improve product experiences, and influence long-term business outcomes. You'll join at a pivotal time as the organisation evolves its data capability and scales a high-impact team.

The Company

They are a fast-growing, product-led technology business operating internationally, with data and AI playing a central role in their future growth. The organisation has invested heavily in building strong data foundations, creating a mature analytics environment and fostering a culture of experimentation and innovation.

As they continue to scale, they are transforming their data function from a centralised model into embedded product teams, creating greater proximity between data professionals and business decision-making. This is a highly collaborative environment where commercial impact is valued as much as technical excellence.

The Role

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and senior stakeholders to identify opportunities, influence strategy and deliver measurable business impact.

Key responsibilities include:

Understanding complex business and product challenges through data analysis.
Identifying, sizing and prioritising commercial opportunities.
Conducting product analytics to improve customer experiences and business performance.
Defining success metrics and building frameworks for measuring impact.
Designing, implementing and analysing A/B tests and experimentation programmes.
Supporting product teams with insight-driven decision making.
Delivering data storytelling and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Collaborating across analytics, data engineering and data science disciplines.
Leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance analysis and product development.
Contributing to a growing data community and helping shape best practice.

Projects may include recommendation engines, customer personalisation, checkout optimisation, fraud reduction, financial process improvement, customer segmentation and AI-powered product features.

Your Skills & Experience

Strong experience turning data into commercial recommendations and business outcomes.
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence decision-making.
Experience working within product, digital, e-commerce or technology environments.
Strong analytical capability, including SQL and relevant analytical tooling.
Experience designing and evaluating experiments, including A/B testing and statistical analysis.
Commercially minded with the ability to balance rigour and pace.
Comfortable working through ambiguity and solving open-ended business problems.
Interest in AI, machine learning and emerging technologies.
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience with product analytics, opportunity sizing and performance measurement.

Applications are also welcomed from candidates with strengths across either of the following areas:

Analytics-focused professionals with expertise in experimentation, product analytics and opportunity identification.
Data Science-focused professionals with experience in recommendation systems, machine learning, customer modelling and AI products.

What They Offer

Significant investment in Data & AI capabilities.
Opportunity to help shape a growing team expanding from 10 to approximately 16 people.
Dedicated learning and development support.
Long-term career progression as the Data & Analytics function continues to scale.
Exposure to cutting-edge AI, experimentation and product development initiatives.
Collaborative, high-performing and commercially focused culture.

How to Apply

If you're passionate about using data to influence product strategy, solve complex business challenges and deliver measurable impact, please apply today.

Join easyJet's Commercial Analytics team and shape the future of revenue management at scale. We're building next-generation pricing and optimisation systems that directly drive business performance across the airline industry. You'll work at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and software engineering—developing algorithms that impact real commercial decisions every single day.




Our Revenue Management and Commercial Data Science chapter is responsible for powering pricing, network planning, scheduling, and inflight retail optimisation. Design and develop advanced algorithmic models for dynamic pricing strategies, revenue forecasting, and cost optimisation
Test rigorously through simulations, backtests, shadow testing, and A/B experiments to quantify real-world impact
Conduct research on airline commercial problems and emerging industry dynamics
Translate insights into action by presenting findings and recommendations to business stakeholders and subject matter experts
Build sustainably by maintaining robust code, comprehensive documentation, and scalable systems
Run and maintain existing systems, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and continuous operational improvement
Collaborate cross-functionally with Trading, Network, Scheduling, Proposition, and Inflight Retail teams to implement integrated solutions

We're a diverse team of engineers, economists, statisticians, mathematicians, and computer scientists—all united by a passion for solving complex commercial problems with data and algorithms.




We leverage cutting-edge techniques in data analysis, machine learning, and optimisation to build systems that automate decision-making and drive competitive advantage. If you thrive in intellectually challenging environments and want your work to have immediate business impact, you'll fit right in.

Degree in statistics, data science, econometrics, quantitative economics, operations research, mathematics, or related field
2+ years of experience in commercial analytics, algorithm development, or applied statistical/machine learning modelling
Proficiency in SQL and Python
Strong understanding of commercial/pricing problems and business fundamentals
Advanced data skills: statistical modelling, machine learning, time-series forecasting, demand prediction, optimisation, inventory management
Experience with dynamic pricing, stochastic processes, or Bayesian inference is a plus




Preferred Experience:

Background in pricing, forecasting or optimisation roles within airlines, hospitality, car rentals, e-commerce, or similar dynamic pricing industries
Familiarity with data engineering concepts (pipelines, data quality, testing, sampling)

Commercially minded with genuine curiosity about business problems, not just algorithms
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Committed to continuous learning and iterative improvement
Excellent communicator who can translate technical concepts for business audiences
Data-driven problem solver with strong analytical rigor




Why Join Us?

Work on real, high-impact systems used by thousands of flights daily
Access to world-class data and complex, real-world optimisation challenges
Collaborate with leading minds across data science, engineering, and commerce
Develop in-house expertise with tools built specifically for airline problems
Be part of a team that values both technical excellence and business acumen

At easyJet, we pride ourselves on a vibrant and inclusive workplace culture that supports and rewards innovation and excellence.

Competitive base salary

Title: Business Insights Analyst x 2
Description:
We're looking for a commercially minded and analytical professional to help shape better outcomes for our SME and Mid-Market customers through data-driven insight and continuous improvement. In this role, you'll lead the delivery of data and analytics across SEBL (Smartest Energy Business Limited), transforming complex information into clear, actionable recommendations that identify risks, unlock opportunities, and support informed business decisions across regulatory, financial, operational, and customer experience activities.

Working collaboratively across Sales, Commercial, Operations, Digital, and Data/BI teams, you'll translate business challenges into structured, testable requirements that drive safe, compliant, and customer-centric change. You'll use data analysis, process improvement, and stakeholder engagement to enhance customer journeys, improve operational performance, reduce cost to serve, and deliver measurable business value while contributing to SEBL's wider strategic objectives.

What skills/experience do I need to be successful?


Proven ability to apply data analysis techniques to business scenarios and deliver actionable business insights;
Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement and efficiencies within current business operations;
Ability to assess and identify risks within existing business models and processes;
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills, with experience communicating findings and recommendations;
Knowledge of data analysis methods, business intelligence applications, and supporting analytical technologies.


What sets us apart?


Global Impact: With offices in the UK, US, and Australia, and plans for further expansion, you'll be part of a dynamic, globally-minded team, with opportunities to explore new markets and make a difference on a global scale.
Flexible Working: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere in the world for up to 30 days a year. We prioritize work-life balance, recognizing that your well-being matters. Find out more here.
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: We celebrate our diverse culture and value individuals irrespective of background, disability, religion, gender identity, sexuality, or ethnicity. Join a team where diversity is not just welcomed but celebrated as a key driver of growth and innovation.


What does hybrid working mean to us?

Hybrid working typically means 2 days in the office location listed on this advert and 3 days working at home each week. Some occasional travel to our other offices may be required.

What happens next?

Once we receive your application, it will be reviewed by a human – no bots here! The average process typically takes around 2-3 weeks, with 2 stages of video interviews using Teams. However, this can vary depending on the role. We may invite you for a face-to-face meeting or require only 1 video interview. If you have any questions or need support, our Recruitment Team is here to assist you.

Title: Lead Game Analyst - Old School RuneScape
Description:
Office location: Cambridge, UK - This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. However, applicants should be based (or willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required.

Are you a data-driven leader who wants to transform player behaviour into meaningful insights that shape the future of one of the world's most iconic MMORPGs?

As Lead Analyst on Old School RuneScape, you'll lead a team of analysts responsible for uncovering the insights that drive better player experiences, smarter product decisions, and long-term business success. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and senior leadership, you'll help shape the roadmap of Old School RuneScape by turning complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

This is a highly influential role where you'll combine technical expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to ensure data sits at the heart of decision-making across one of gaming's most successful live service titles.

What you'll be doing:


Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Analysts, fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and analytical excellence.
Build strong relationships with Old School RuneScape teams to develop a deep understanding of product strategy, player needs, and business priorities.
Deliver insights and business intelligence that directly influence product strategy, feature development, and roadmap planning.
Transform complex datasets into clear recommendations that support better decision-making across Product, Design, and Leadership.
Query, analyse, and interpret large datasets to uncover opportunities to improve player engagement, retention, and overall game experience.
Partner closely with Engineering and Design teams to develop and enhance game telemetry and data collection.
Collaborate with central Data teams to define data requirements and contribute to the evolution of shared data products.
Develop deep knowledge of Old School RuneScape's gameplay systems, mechanics, and player behaviours to provide meaningful context to analysis.
Champion data-driven thinking across the game team and promote best practices in analytics and reporting.


What we're looking for:


Experience leading or mentoring analysts within an analytics, business intelligence, or data-focused environment.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data cleansing techniques.
A demonstrable understanding of video game player behaviours, particularly in MMORPGs.
Familiarity with modern data platforms and architectures such as AWS, Snowflake, and OLAP technologies.
Experience using data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence decision-making across multiple disciplines.


What we offer:

When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks & Benefits package including:


Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan.
Minimum 6% Pension contributions.
Employee Assistance Programme & onsite Counselling.
Life Insurance.
Discretionary annual performance bonus.
Enhanced family leave policies from day 1.
Flexible working hours.
25 days annual leave + Bank holidays & the option to buy/sell holidays + so much more!

We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.

Title: Performance Specialist
Description:
Closing Date

2026-07-06

Job Title: Performance Analyst

Location: Durrington (Hybrid)

Contract Type: 12 month FTC

Hours: 37

Salary: £34,000 to £38,000 depending on skills and experience

About The Role:

There has never been a more important time to join Southern Water. As we move through AMP8, we are delivering one of the most ambitious capital investment programmes in the industry, focused on improving service resilience, environmental performance and long‑term affordability for customers.

The Customer Strategy, Insight and Experience team is responsible for reporting and investigation of issues which improve process for the customer and the company. We provide key facts and insight to empower the wider team to make the right decisions for the right reasons.

About The Role

This Performance Analyst role (internally will be known as Performance Specialist) is responsible for the provision of performance and management information for and about internal and external stakeholders, related to the Southern Water Wholesale Services Division. General duties include investigating, building, processing, reviewing, analysing and reporting of performance and related issues, as well as supporting on regulatory and process change. Working closely with other roles across the department this role is busy, interesting and diverse.

What You Will Be Responsible For:


Deliver timely, fit for purpose, reporting within agreed SLAs. Continuously improve the efficiency of reports to add value and allow for the focus to be on analysing the data rather than processing it.
Produce performance reporting from numerous data sources regarding business level performance vs targets and process regulatory performance. This will require you to develop an in-depth knowledge of processes and systems to ensure accuracy across many customer focussed roles.
Transform data into clear visualisation to meet the stakeholders needs and allow them to see the complete picture.
Support the wider team by providing the information required to make informed decisions on a wide range of topics (including provision of data to external stakeholders such as MOSL, WaterUK and Ofwat).


What You’ll Bring To The Role:


Good understanding and working experience of compiling and generating performance reports and management information.
Strong data handling, technical skills and experience with information validation using Excel and other analytical tools.
Data manipulation skills and experience.
Experience working with reporting and analysis packages and extracting data from corporate systems (e.g. Service Now or other CRM’s, Qlikview, Alteryx, Power BI or similar).
Ability and confidence to communicate appropriately with a range of audiences including peers, senior colleagues and specialists at all levels of the organisation


Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain’s water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability, and service excellence. With £7.8bn planned investment for 2025-30, this is an unparalleled opportunity to join a business committed to delivering a generational shift in the way water services are managed.

You will be joining at a time of significant change, working alongside a highly skilled leadership team with a clear vision for the future. We offer an environment where senior professionals can make a meaningful impact, influence major strategic decisions, and drive long-term value creation.

At Southern Water, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. If you’re passionate about making a positive impact and think you can bring value to our team, we’d love to hear from you—even if you don’t tick every box. Your unique skills and experiences could be exactly what we need.

If this role isn’t quite what you’re looking for but are keen to be contacted about opportunities at Southern Water, you can register your details here: Introduce Yourself (myworkdaysite.com)

Our Commitment to Diversity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Additional Information:

In line with Southern Water’s security requirements, successful candidates will be required to provide evidence of their identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record check (DBS) and verification of their employment and/or education history for the past three years.

Appointment to this role is subject to the successful completion of all preemployment checks, including security vetting.

Please note that if a candidate does not meet the required security standards or fails to pass the vetting process, Southern Water reserves the right to withdraw the offer of employment. Some positions may also require higher levels of security vetting, which may involve providing additional documentation.

Description:
Data Analyst — up to £75,000 | Hybrid, London




We're recruiting on behalf of a fast growing MGA capital partner that backs underwriting talent to launch and scale their own specialist insurance businesses.




They're now looking for a Data Analyst to join their Digital and Technology team, with a strong lean toward data engineering. Solid hands on SQL Server and Azure Data Factory experience in a live production environment. Comfort with Qlik or a similar BI tool. Insurance industry background, ideally with exposure to commercial insurance, policy lifecycle, BDX production or premium calculations. A genuinely flexible mindset. Priorities here can shift from one day to the next, and you'll need to be just as happy deep in a pipeline as you are in a stakeholder meeting.




The setup

Salary up to £75,000. Hybrid working. A small, collaborative team where no task is too small and no problem too ambiguous to dig into.

Title: Data Analyst, Operations
Description:
Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. We're full-service, with people and AI agents working side by side, all aligned to one thing: maximizing our clients' revenue through a genuinely scientific approach to media. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.

What's The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to own the flow of data between our operational systems, our data warehouse and the rest of the business. Systems like Hubspot and our People Planner, hold the client, revenue and pipeline data that Finance, Ops and Client Leadership rely on. This role keeps that data well structured, reliably synced and trustworthy as it moves into BigQuery and back out into the tools people use every day. A key part of the job is getting the right, live data presented cleanly in Notion, so client teams can actually use it to inform their day to day workflows.

What You Do


Build and maintain integrations that move operating system data into the data warehouse.
Push data warehouse data back into operating systems to create complete workflows and data lifecycles
Debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, identifying the causes and automating solutions to prevent issues moving forward.
Own HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) as a system of record: properties, associations, lifecycle stages etc. and the automation that keeps them consistent, including data quality, deduplication and governance at scale.
Work closely with finance, operations, and other business support teams, translating technical decisions into terms non-technical stakeholders can act on.



Who You Are


Deep experience managing data structure (objects, properties, associations, lifecycle stages, automation), not just using it as an end user, with strong data quality and governance practices (deduplication, enrichment, validation, access controls, auditability).
Able to turn a non-technical brief into a full plan and build it, and explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders without jargon.
Comfortable in fast-moving rollouts, balancing speed with long-term architecture as requirements evolve.
Experience building sync logic (canonical IDs, upserts, change detection, idempotent reruns) and ETL/ELT pipelines that survive repeated runs without duplicating or corrupting data.
Experience integrating data into BigQuery, Snowflake or similar warehouses via API-based integrations, including reverse ETL back into business systems.
Strong Python (or similar) and SQL for automation, data movement, transformation and validation across warehouse tables and views.
Confident with REST APIs (auth, pagination, rate limits, retries, error handling) and GCP tooling (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Secret Manager, BigQuery, GitHub Actions) for building and orchestrating automated jobs.
Able to debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, with good version control hygiene (GitHub or similar).



How You Succeed


Data moves between systems reliably and accurately at scale
Systems stay clean at scale, with properties and associations that hold up as volume grows.
Data discrepancies get caught and fixed at the source
Finance, operations and other business teams trust the numbers
New integrations and automations are shipped with documentation and clear guidance
You balance shipping quickly against building for the long term, and can explain that trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder in plain terms.



What happens next?

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

A note on our offices: We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

Please note that we will never ask you to transfer cash or make any other payment to us in order to apply for a role or to work for Brainlabs. Any such asks are fraudulent and should be reported to the appropriate authorities in your area.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.





Job Description



Are you passionate about Data Visualization and Data Analysis?



Sportradar is seeking a motivated Data Analyst (Business Intelligence Analyst) to join the fast paced and dynamic Data & Insights team.



You will be responsible for the design, creation, and implementation of the reporting layer. You will implement creative approaches to solving complex problems. In addition to building new features, you will constantly be improving and expanding existing reporting interfaces.



The role is a key member of the team that will help develop the vision for our Data & Insights team. The Data & Insights team drives innovation and operational excellence through the projects they support across all units at Sportradar.



You will report directly to the Commercial Analytics Manager and collaborate with stakeholders across the Commercial teams to surface the answers to key operational and business questions.



THE CHALLENGE:



Analyse stakeholder requirements and opportunities for improving business decisions and operations efficiency through data analytics.
Deliver state-of-the-art data analytics and reporting solutions leveraging our commercial, operational and business data.
Data modelling for reporting and analytics.
Development and deployment of data visualizations and reports for management and internal business partners.
Present ideas and solutions to business and technical stakeholders clearly and understandably. Documentation of requirements and adherence to data governance protocols.
Support the design and build of scalable, reliable, and secure data warehousing architectures and data integration/processing pipelines.
Train and empower business users to leverage the business intelligence tools and analytics solutions for driving data-driven decisions and insights.
Propose new, innovative ways of using data to improve how we monetize our products and services, how we acquire which new sport rights, and how we analyze our current and future commercial strategies.
Co-create and deliver an ambitious business intelligence roadmap in close coordination with various business and technical stakeholders in the Sportradar group.
Creation and maintenance of technical documentation for BI Tools.

YOUR PROFILE:



Demonstrated technical expertise in the following areas: business intelligence tools, design, and development of dashboards and reporting applications, databases, data modelling, ETL processes.
The successful candidate will be practiced in the hands-on development of software or analytics solutions.
Minimum of 3 years of experience working on projects related to data management and/or business intelligence.
Proficiency in working with relational databases and advanced knowledge of SQL.
Experience working with BI tools such as Qlik Sense/Qlik View, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent is required.
Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift, and/or Amazon Athena is a plus.
Understanding and experience with predictive analytics, statistical modelling, or machine learning is a plus.
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science / Engineering, Mathematics / Statistics, Economics, or related field; equivalent experience acceptable.
Fluent in English (written and spoken).
Autonomous, rigorous, creative, and a team player.

OUR OFFER:



Work for and shape one of the fastest-growing digital sports companies in the world.
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunity for hybrid working.
Investment in your continued development.
Work in an international team collaborating with colleagues from all over the world.


Additional Information



At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

Title: RevOps Specialist - Insights & Analytics
Description:
Planon is strengthening its commercial organization by building a more data-driven and performance-focused Revenue Operations function. To support this, we are looking for someone who enjoys working with data, uncovering insights and translating complex performance trends into clear actions.

As our Revenue Operations Specialist for Insights & Analytics, you will play a key role in how we measure and steer our commercial performance. You will work across Sales, Customer Growth, Marketing, Finance and IM to ensure the organization has clear visibility on pipeline health, revenue performance and the impact of strategic initiatives.

Through scalable reporting, strong KPI governance and actionable insights, you will help GTM leadership understand what is happening in the business and where to act next.

If you enjoy combining analytics with business understanding, building reporting that drives decisions and partnering with senior stakeholders, this role offers the chance to make a direct impact on how our commercial organization performs.

What You'll Do


Build and maintain scalable dashboards, reporting frameworks and executive scorecards to drive commercial performance visibility.
Deliver actionable insights on pipeline, funnel performance, forecasting, customer growth, churn and expansion trends.
Monitor and assess the impact of strategic initiatives and growth levers, translating outcomes into clear business insights.
Own KPI definitions and governance, ensuring consistent metrics, reporting standards and data usage across teams.
Act as analytical partner to GTM leadership, turning data into clear recommendations and decision support.
Strengthen data quality and reporting reliability by aligning closely with IM and Finance teams.


Profile

You combine strong analytical capabilities with a solid understanding of commercial processes. You are comfortable working with data, but equally strong in translating insights into clear narratives that help stakeholders take action.

You have:


4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics or a similar commercial analytics role within a SaaS or technology-driven environment.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, with experience in Salesforce and BI tools.
Solid understanding of commercial metrics such as pipeline, conversion, forecasting and customer growth.
Experience building dashboards and translating raw data into clear, usable insights for business stakeholders.
Ability to translate business questions into structured analysis and actionable recommendations.
Strong stakeholder and communication skills, with the ability to constructively challenge assumptions and influence decision-making through data-driven insights.


We offer

Salary range: £43,092 - £66,072 gross per year, depending on experience.

This range reflects a good faith estimate of the expected compensation for this role, based on objective, role-related criteria. The total compensation package includes participation in Planon's profit-sharing scheme and additional benefits. Learn more about our benefits on our Netherlands Benefits Page.

We offer flexibility through hybrid working, continuous development opportunities, and the chance to work on challenging projects with leading global clients.

Planon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

Title: Yield Executive
Description:
Who We Are

We’re IAG Loyalty, one organisation with two ambitious, growing divisions across Loyalty and Holidays. Each has its own goals, strategy and team, but together we’re united by a shared vision: to create a more rewarding world of travel and experiences.

Our Holidays division, including British Airways Holidays, connects customers to thousands of destinations worldwide through seamless, end to end travel experiences.

Our Loyalty division is home to Avios, the global loyalty currency, enabling millions of members to collect and spend rewards across travel, retail and financial services.

We’re on an exciting journey of growth and transformation. We’re going places.

The opportunity ✨

At Holidays, data plays a huge part in how we price and sell holidays. Our Yield team balances competitive prices with profitability, using insight and commercial thinking to help customers find great holidays while delivering strong results for the business.

As a Yield Data Executive, you'll turn large amounts of data into clear, useful insight for our Yield Analysts and Managers.

This is more than an opportunity to use Excel. You'll work with experienced Yield professionals, collaborate with teams across Holidays and see first-hand how data influences real commercial decisions. As your experience grows, you'll move from identifying what the data says to suggesting what we could do about it.

We're looking for someone early in their career to join the team and build valuable commercial, analytical and Excel skills in a fast-moving travel environment. You don't need previous experience in travel or yield. What matters is that you're curious, confident with Excel and data, and excited to understand what the numbers are telling you.

There's also a clear career path. If you discover a passion for yield and commercial analytics, you can develop your skills and work towards progressing into a Yield Analyst role, taking greater ownership of commercial decisions.

Bring your curiosity. We'll help you build the career.

What you'll be doing 🚀

Half Your Time Will Be To Focus On Competitor Analysis. Using Our In-house Systems And Excel, You'll Gather Holiday Pricing Data From Competitors And Identify Trends, Outliers And Opportunities. You'll Look For Things Like


Where our pricing isn't competitive
Hotels or destinations that are performing differently
Emerging pricing trends
Unexpected changes or outliers
Potential issues with data accuracy or integrity


You'll then flag your findings to the right teams, helping our Yield Analysts and Destination teams understand what's happening and where action may be needed.

The remaining half of your time will involve responding to real-time commercial and operational requirements. You could be analysing why holiday margins aren't delivering, supporting price matching for high-value customer holidays or using data to help determine the order of hotels displayed on ba.com.

What we need from you ⚡


All reports you will use, and analysis of data is done through Excel. So, it is essential you are at an intermediate level and can comfortably use pivot tables and formulas in Excel.
You don’t need to come from a travel or yield background but need to be able to spot data trends and consider data with a commercial approach.
You question the numbers, investigate anomalies and aren't afraid to flag when something doesn't look right.
Working with data and reports means you need exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.
You will juggle lots of different data requests, so strong organisational skills are needed.
You can explain your findings clearly and confidently to different teams and stakeholders.


Whether you're starting out in your career or bringing analytical experience from another industry, this is your opportunity to develop in-demand data skills, gain commercial experience and build a career in the world of travel.

Our offices are based in central Crawley and we offer hybrid working (within the UK only). Generally, this role works from our offices twice a week, with additional days as needed depending on meetings etc. Office days are co-ordinated so that colleagues in the same team are in the office together to collaborate in person. We usually support new colleagues in the office full time for the first few weeks.

Diversity and Inclusion

Our vision is to create a more rewarding world of travel and experiences. Delivering that requires diverse thinking and inclusive leadership.

We are committed to building a workplace where people feel they belong and are valued for their perspective. Inclusion drives better decisions, stronger performance and more innovative outcomes.

We actively encourage applications from people with different experiences and backgrounds, and are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is fair, inclusive and accessible.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Together, we engage with everything we have and are, to help humankind act braver and better.

About UK Life Branch:

With the office in Munich, it forms the Life 1 division of Munich Re. The UK life market is one of the, if not the, most competitive life markets in the world. We understand that Life insurers work in a dynamic market where medical progress, demographic trends and changing lifestyles are constantly giving rise to new risk landscapes. This demanding situation is made even more challenging by changing laws and regulations and ever tougher competition. So, we need a smart strategy and structure in order to succeed.

At UK & Ireland Life we have three pillars to our business strategy, protection, longevity and reinsurance structuring. All three are key to the success of our business so it’s important to look at the big picture. In terms of clients, we trust them as experts of their business and provide them with the financial strength of the world’s largest reinsurer, global expertise, and sharp pricing so that they are both competitive and profitable.

About the role: Working within the UK Data Management Team, responsible specifically for LH1 Valuation Data, you will work with our Lead Analysts to ensure data updates & delivery of LH1 Valuation Data.

This will include being responsible for and having oversight of translating and validating client data, production of CLR ready Valuation Portfolio data and producing data analysis and reports for internal clients (Valuation team) regarding valuation portfolio data.

Key Responsibilities:


Develop, execute and manage data transformation scripts to produce Valuation portfolio data.  
Data cleansing, profiling, mapping and mining of Valuation portfolio data. 
Support and deliver various ad-hoc reporting needs for internal clients regarding the Valuation portfolio data 
Support business requirement gathering activities, especially on their data and reporting needs that relate to valuation portfolio data and how that will be utilised in wider process improvements/projects. 
Ensure client data used for Valuation portfolio delivery is stored in consistent format and in line with treaty arrangements. 
Support and improve where possible processes and/or tools used in the team in relation to the Valuation portfolio delivery. 
Determining, monitoring and reporting the availability, quality and consistency of client data used in Valuation Portfolio deliveries. 
Liaison with internal clients to fully understand data content to maximise the benefits to the business, uncovering possible weaknesses and working for their correction.
Gather, understand and document detailed business requirements for data using appropriate tools and techniques, and ensure these are agreed at all levels throughout the business.
Managing own work priorities; working in a highly organised way.   
Managing colleagues’ expectations.  
Ensuring data used in various work streams are of good quality and up to date. 
Working independently or together with colleagues as appropriate. 
Produce quality written and numerical material appropriate to purpose. 



Competencies:

Business Acumen (we think big) - You understand the business’ ambition, your team’s

commitments and how your role contributes to this.

Plans and aligns (we lead the ‘we’) - You plan and prioritise your work to fit with deadlines and longer-term commitments for you and your team and collaborate with others, encouraging diversity of thought.

Action oriented (we grow with our clients) - You take on new tasks, opportunities and challenges with a keen interest. You have an appetite to learn and embrace new ways of working in order to improve efficiencies and effectiveness.

Self-development (we care and dare) - You demonstrate enthusiasm by seeking new ways to grow and be challenged, through both formal and informal development opportunities.

Communicating Effectively (we are clear and authentic) - You openly listen to the ideas of others,

seek regular feedback to develop, consider the best method for communicating and ask for support and advice when unsure.

Key Skills & Experience:

Essential


Demonstrable Data Processing / Handling and Data Analysis skills.  
Professional experience in a Data Analyst role
SQL Scripting, R, Python, Power BI, Advanced MS Excel. 
Cloud Based Data Platform (Azure, Databricks) Git and version control practices.
High level of numerical and analytical skills.
Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve complex data issues effectively.



Desirable


Understanding of Insurance / Reinsurance Business
Demonstrable experience working with relational databases (Oracle, SQL etc)
Knowledge of data science, including machine learning, statistical analysis, and AI tools.



Thought Leaders:

You will demonstrate inclusive behaviour and encourage your colleagues to play an active role in creating an inclusive culture as well.

You will treat your colleagues and sales and business partners fairly and with respect.

Regulatory & Conduct Requirements:


Ensuring compliance with Munich Re’s Code of Conduct



At Munich Re, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion foster innovation and resilience and enable us to act braver and better. Embracing the power of DEI is at the core of who we are. We recognise diversity can be multi-dimensional, intersectional, and complex, so we want to build a diverse workforce that includes a wide range of racial, ethnic, sexual, and gender identities; economic and geographic backgrounds; physical abilities; ages; life, school, and career experiences; and political, religious, and personal beliefs. Additionally, we are committed to building an equitable and inclusive work environment where this diversity is celebrated, valued, and has equitable opportunities to succeed.

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with everything outlined, or you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the candidate we are looking for!

All candidates in consideration for any role can request a reasonable adjustment at any point in our recruitment process. You can request an adjustment by speaking to your Talent Acquisition contact.

Description:
Job Title: Business Analyst Contract Type: Permanent Hybrid working 3 days a week in the office based in Dunstab...

This role will play a key role in analysing business processes, monitoring system controls, identifying improvement opportunities and supporting governance activities across the organisation. You'll work closely with stakeholders across Finance, Shared Services, Technology and Operations to ensure key processes are operating effectively and efficiently.

This role would suit someone with strong analytical skills who enjoys investigating data, understanding how systems and processes interact, and helping the business make informed decisions through accurate reporting and insight.

Analyse business processes and data to identify control weaknesses, process improvements and operational risks.

Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
Experience producing reports, dashboards or management information.
A structured and methodical approach to analysing business processes.
Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
The confidence to challenge existing ways of working and recommend improvements.
Experience working with business systems, controls, governance or compliance processes.
The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Exposure to finance systems, ERP platforms or business applications.
Experience working within governance, risk, controls, audit, compliance or operational excellence environments.
Knowledge of process mapping, control frameworks or continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience within a large, multi-site or customer-facing business.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
We're looking for a data engineer driven by patient impact and facilitating data driven decision making. We're still small, so you'd be the sole engineer focused solely on the data side of things (at least initially).




What You'll Do

Your day-to-day work will be impactful and varied, including:

Analysing patient data - running queries to generate plots/visualisations and data summaries
Building an internal data platform to allow non-technical colleagues to self-serve with their data queries
Working with the UX team to iterate the app design and requirements through data driven decisions
Coming up with interesting questions to ask about our data to inform product decisions
Improving our application and data model to capture high quality data
Exemplifying best practice for medical data storage, security and privacy




You’ll collaborate closely with the rest of the engineering / UX team, work directly with company leadership, and see the impact of your work on real patients.




About You

You have strong programming skills in Python and its data science ecosystem
You are a software professional, who knows the difference between research and production code
You have good mathematical fluency (particularly around probability, statistics and information theory)
You enjoy working with design and product teams to help shape exceptional products
You care deeply about users - championing great experience and access to quality clinical care
You can communicate your work clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
You take initiative and ownership of your work




Bonus Points

Whilst not required, experience in any of these areas will definitely stand out - let us know if you have any!

Working with medical data (or other sensitive data)
Creating visual tools (e.g. interactive dashboards) for data exploration by others with good UX
Good ML fundamentals (e.g. could build a small neural network from scratch)
Data modelling (and versioning) of complex systems
Startup experience




What We Offer

Challenging work at the frontier of AI-native healthcare
In-person collaborative culture in a beautiful work space in the Cambridgeshire countryside
An onsite gym and digital health subscription of your choice
Early stage equity with employee-friendly terms (via an EMI scheme)
Comprehensive medical coverage (including dental and optical) and life insurance
Optional remote working on Wednesdays, with an annual allowance of 10 extra remote days
Desk setup allowance for your favourite keyboard / mouse / whatever!
Monthly team feasts (and the BBQ is used most days)
A fast paced work environment geared towards excellence and professional growth (with annual training budget)
A chance to have a big impact in a small team transforming care and outcomes at population scale




About Flok

More than a billion people a year suffer unnecessarily from conditions like MSK pain, where the right treatment approach is well-established but undeliverable at scale. We're changing that. Our team has deep expertise across clinical, engineering, and regulated AI, has a track record of healthtech innovation, and is backed by top VCs and multiple unicorn founder angels.




If you like:

Solving hard problems at the intersection of technology and healthcare
The pursuit of excellence—helping each other to do the best work of our careers
Working in an in-person collaborative environment
Taking ownership to have significant impact in a fast-growing mission-driven company with big ambitions




Then you'll fit right in!

Support commercial teams with data, insights, and reporting as data/commercial analyst.
Drive smarter decision-making across sales and operations
Act as the bridge between data, finance, and commercial strategy

Prepare/maintain required datasets/databases for each tool with respective counterparts (e.g., KAM’s) and prepares the dataset/database for the upload into the tools (e.g., Alteryx/Power BI/Excel or a similar data preparation software)
Track commercial targets and OKRs; develop and maintain regular reports, dashboards, and visual presentations that clearly communicate key insights, strategies, and progress towards objectives.
Collaborate with the Revenue Growth Management (RGM), Finance and Sales team to identify potential opportunities, risks, and discrepancies.
Provide reports (regular and ad-hoc) to the Sales Team and the broader business to enable data-based decision making




*Pricing & Value Chain Analysis: *

Evaluate and manage value chains across different products and services, ensuring that pricing decisions align with overall business goals and customer value propositions.
Collaborate with the RGM and Finance teams to assess the impact of pricing changes on profitability and competitiveness.




*Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Process Improvement: *

Engage in continuous review and improvement of cross-departmental processes/procedures/systems to enhance efficiency and alignment with business goals.
Conduct periodic audits to ensure compliance with internal processes and identify areas for improvement.
Support the Commercial Excellence Manager on special projects, providing insights and recommendations that align with the company’s strategic objectives.




* Coordination: *

Proactively coordinate and align commercial excellence activities with broader business strategies, utilizing analytical insights to inform decision-making.
Monitor and track the implementation of strategic objectives, ensuring they are in line with the company’s commercial and financial goals.
Administrative and Strategic Support for example collate and prepare presentations for management or Range Reviews, support customer onboarding request and track Commercial Sample Requests (included but not limited to.)




*Continuous Improvement: *

Maintain a proactive approach in reviewing and optimizing business processes to enhance operational efficiency and support business growth.




Education:

Business related degree or other discipline (e.g., mathematics, economics, engineering) that requires extensive quantitative knowledge (master's an advantage/not essential)
Demonstrated professional and academic success




Experience:

Experience in data analysis (2+ years)
Knowledge of Microsoft Office package and especially Excel and Access are essential
Highly numerate
Second to none time management and organisational skills
High level of accuracy and attention to detail is a must
Excellent communication skills at all levels of the organisation
Experience of building and maintaining cross functional relationships




Skills:

Passionate for working with numbers and spreadsheets
Strong process focus, eagerness for continuous process improvement and process re-design
Well-organised, able to prioritise work, meet deadlines and see tasks through to completion
Self-motivated and able to work on an individual basis as well as part of a team
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with an ability to build cross functional relationships
Confidential with high level of integrity
Flexible attitude and excellent team work

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are working with an Asset Management client seeking a Data Analyst to join their Data, Intelligence & Analytics team. The role will support the clients ongoing data transformation and technology initiatives and act as a key business partner to various stakeholders.







London, UK | Hybrid – 4 Days in Office | £60,000 - £80,000 plus good package

Key Responsibilities

Own the design, development, and oversight of data transformation pipelines.
Analyse large datasets to identify and resolve data quality issues, working with Finance and Portfolio Monitoring to trace discrepancies back to source and implement sustainable fixes.
Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency across multiple platforms and vendors.
Build and maintain visualisations, charts, and interactive dashboards.
Translate complex data into meaningful business insights for senior stakeholders.
Drive process improvements, automation, and operational efficiencies across Finance and other business functions.
Apply AI technologies to solve real business problems and identify opportunities to enhance reporting, analytics, and decision-making.
Work closely with technology vendors and internal stakeholders to support data connectivity and platform integrations.
Identify practical opportunities to embed AI within the firm's data and reporting environment.




Skills Required

Minimum of 5 years' experience in an analytics or intelligence function within asset management or broader financial services, with a university degree in an analytical-related subject (minimum 2:1).
Experience in Databricks, Python, and SQL, including building and owning end-to-end data transformation pipelines.
Experience building and maintaining visualisations and charts for business consumption. (Power BI, Alteryx, or Qlik or similar)>
Demonstrated commercial experience in leveraging AI technologies to solve business challenges.
Experience working with and managing technology vendors or outsource providers to ensure reliable data connectivity and delivery.
Strong stakeholder management and excellent communication skills.
Demonstrated initiative and takes responsibility for delivering outcomes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder skills and a proactive mindset.

Desirable

Experience supporting a technology build-out or platform implementations (e.g: eFront or Appian, or similar platforms).
Familiarity with Azure or other cloud-based data architectures.
Knowledge of modern fund operations and investment data platforms.

Data Analyst / Business Intelligence Analyst

 

 

Location: Hybrid; London - 2 days per week; occasional travel to Suffolk when required

 

Salary: £45,000- £50,000 per annum (including £3,500) London allowance+ benefits

 

Annual Leave: 28 days + bank holidays (rising to 30 days after 5 years)
Bonus: Up to 5%
Pension: Up to 7.5% employee + 15% employer contribution
Career development and progression opportunities on a nationally significant programme

 

 

Closing Date:  Sunday 6 September 2026.

 

 

 

 

Help Deliver One of the UK's Largest Infrastructure Projects

 

 

Sizewell C is at the heart of Britain's energy future. We're looking for a talented Data Analyst / Business Intelligence Analyst (Internal job title: Programme Excellence & Innovation Technical Support) to join our Programme Excellence & Innovation team and help turn complex data into meaningful insights that support critical business decisions.

 

Working across a nationally significant infrastructure programme, you'll create dashboards, analyse performance data, improve reporting processes, and provide valuable insight that helps drive project success.

 

 

What You'll Be Doing

 

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and visualisations.
Develop and maintain Power Apps for various functions / programmes
Analyse and interpret data from multiple systems and data sources.
Produce KPI reporting, trend analysis, management information and business insights.
Work with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and deliver practical solutions.
Improve data quality, automate reporting processes and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Utilise Power BI, Power Query, DAX, Excel, SharePoint, Power Apps and Power Automate and AI enabled technologies to drive efficiency and innovation.

 

 

What We're Looking For

 

You'll have experience working with data, reporting and business intelligence tools, alongside strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 

Essential Skills

 

Proven experience using Power BI, DAX, Power Query and Excel for reporting and data visualisation.
Proven experience using Power Apps and Power Automate.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into reporting solutions.
Experience cleansing, transforming and analysing data from multiple sources.
Strong attention to detail and excellent communication skills.
Degree or equivalent experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Business Analytics or a related discipline.

 

Desirable

 

Experience within infrastructure, energy, engineering, PMO or other regulated environments.
Knowledge of ETL/ELT, data modelling and reporting best practice.
Experience developing KPI dashboards, management information and performance reporting.

 

 

Why Join Sizewell C?

 

Work on one of the UK's most ambitious infrastructure programmes
Competitive salary and bonus
Excellent pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution
Hybrid working environment
Career development and progression opportunities
Opportunity to shape how data drives decision-making across a major programme

 

 

Ready to Make an Impact?

 

 

If you're passionate about data, reporting, automation and creating meaningful insights that influence business decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Apply now and help shape the future of UK energy through data, innovation and insight.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Role overview:

Analytics Engineer

Waterloo - Hybrid Working

Full Time

Permanent

Grade 4

At Currys we’re united by one passion: to help everyone enjoy amazing technology. As the UK’s best-known retailer of tech, we’re proud of the service our customers receive – and it’s all down to our team of 25,000 caring and committed colleagues. Working as one team, we learn and grow together, celebrating the big and small moments that make every day amazing.

Currys is in the middle of one of the most ambitious AI and automation shifts in UK retail. We are rethinking how customers discover and buy technology, how stores operate, how supply chains move, and how colleagues do their best work. We’re reshaping how the business trades, plans and serves.

The AI & Monetisation function is where the boldest bets get placed.The squad you join is greenfield, built around a real business domain, and backed by senior sponsorship. You will own that domain end to end, set the roadmap with the stakeholders who run it, and ship products that move the numbers in the P&L.

These problems are genuinely hard: optimising stock availability, automating complex operating processes, putting useful AI into the hands of frontline colleagues, and monetising the audience and data we already have. You will be a change agent in a business moving fast and willing to back people who can move with it.

Role overview:


Develop and maintain dbt models that transform raw data into trusted datasets for analytics and business intelligence
Implement data quality tests and monitoring to ensure accuracy and reliability
Optimise query performance using effective data modelling and materialisation strategies
Establish and maintain documentation and data dictionaries for analytical models, KPI definitions and metrics frameworks
Support self-service analytics by building reusable, high-quality data models
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Collaborate with data engineers to define requirements for new data sources and pipelines
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in business performance
Build interactive dashboards and reports that empower self-service analytics
Design visualizations that clearly communicate complex data stories to both technical and non-technical audiences


What you'll bring:


Strong SQL skills with experience in complex data transformations, CTEs, and window functions
Expertise with dbt and modern analytics engineering tools
Solid understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing concepts
Experience with Git-based workflows for version control and collaboration for analytics
Knowledge of data testing frameworks and quality assurance practices
Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or similar data platforms
Proficiency in Omni, Looker or similar BI tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities
Excellent communication skills with ability to present findings to diverse audiences


Experience Required:


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst or analytics engineer role
Degree in Computer Science, Analytics, or a related technical field highly desirable
dbt & Analytics platform certification beneficial


Why join us:

Join our team and we'll be with you every step of the way, helping you develop the career you want with new opportunities, on-going training and skills for life.

Not only can you shape your own future, but you can help take charge of ours too. As the biggest recycler and repairer of tech in the UK, we’re in a position to make a real impact on people and the planet.

Every voice has a space at our table and we're committed to making inclusion and diversity part of everything we do, including how we strengthen our workforce. We want to make sure you have a fair opportunity to show us your talents during our application process, so if you need any additional assistance with your application please email careers@currys.co.uk and we'll do our best to help.

Application Deadline: 10 September 2026

Department: Fundraising

Location: Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity

Compensation: £42,770 / year

Description

Are you a Reporting Analyst who enjoys turning complex data into clear, useful information that helps people make better decisions?

Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity is looking for a Reporting Analyst to develop the dashboards, reporting and performance information used by teams across Fundraising, Marketing and the wider organisation.

This is a hands-on role where you'll combine Power BI, SQL and analytical thinking with lots of stakeholder interaction. You'll build and improve reporting, understand what colleagues really need from their data and find smarter ways to make trusted information easier to access and use.

Salary

The salary for this role is £42,770 per annum and we operate a hybrid working policy of a minimum of 2 days per week in the office.

In line with our EDI strategy and Total Reward policy, we calculate our salaries based on benchmarking data across the charity sector. To ensure fairness for existing staff and new joiners, we do not offer salaries above the advertised rate.

Key Responsibilities


Build, maintain and improve Power BI dashboards and reporting that help teams understand performance and make informed decisions.
Use SQL and multiple data sources to interrogate, validate and prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Work with colleagues across the charity to understand their questions and translate them into useful reporting and business intelligence solutions.
Develop clear KPIs and performance measures that give teams a consistent view of what is happening and where attention is needed.
Turn data into clear, engaging reporting that makes complex information easier for different audiences to understand.
Work alongside our Data Engineering and Analysis teams to develop the datasets and reporting capabilities colleagues need.
Identify opportunities to automate and simplify reporting, reducing manual processes and making information easier to access.
Support colleagues to confidently use dashboards and self-service reporting, helping make data part of everyday decision-making.
Help maintain high standards of data quality, accuracy and governance across our reporting.


Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and reporting using Power BI.
Strong SQL skills, with experience interrogating, analysing and validating large datasets.
Experience working with multiple data sources to produce accurate and meaningful business intelligence.
Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to spot trends and understand what the data is telling you.
Experience developing KPIs, performance measures or reporting frameworks.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to understand what colleagues need and translate this into practical reporting solutions.
Good communication skills, including the ability to present data and explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
A proactive approach to improving and automating reporting processes.
Experience of fundraising, supporter or charity data would be useful, but isn't essential.


This is an opportunity to help make data easier to understand, easier to access and more useful. You’ll enable colleagues to have the confidence to turn information into action.

DBS - note a Basic DBS check is required for this role.

How To Apply

Please click on the apply button in the top right-hand corner where you will be taken to a short application form to complete.

Closing date: 10th September 2026

Benefits


30 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
A flexible approach to working arrangements.
Access to our enhanced pension scheme
Life assurance
Access to various health and wellbeing schemes, including the employee assistance programme.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read More About What We’re Building Here.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we are looking for someone to help run and optimise the rhythms at the heart of the business.

We are looking for someone to develop a deep understanding of flexibility markets across the UK, who can collaborate cross-functionally, crunch numbers, and own critical daily and monthly operational processes.

Owning daily operations means sitting at the heart of the ‘Axle control room’. This involves running and optimising the most critical operations processes in the business: asset management, trading across UK flexibility markets, and ultimately ensuring our clients and end customers get paid for the flex they deliver.

A note on the job title: Analytics engineering is often closely associated with dbt. We don't use dbt at Axle because our data set up doesn't require a full ETL framework. Instead, this role is centred on the core analytics engineering skill set: developing a deep understanding of source data and building the data pipelines that power our analytics.

What You Will Be Doing


Owning operations for our UK energy trading (e.g. daily trading processes, reviewing settlements)
Debugging complex edge cases across our trading, asset registration and settlement processes
Identifying risks to revenue and delivery and proactively mitigate them
Communicating insights and actions clearly to engineering and commercial teams
Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders in Distribution System Operators (DSOs) and UK market regulators


It would be great if you had


Strong SQL and Python skills for analysing data, investigating issues, and automating processes
Strong analytical skills: you’ll be speaking MW, kWh, and £ every day
A deep-seated motivation to combat climate change
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment


Benefits

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process


Initial interview
Take-home exercise
Final interview (in-person)
Offer, references, and welcome to the team!


Compensation Range: £75K - £200K

Owning daily operations means sitting at the heart of the ‘Axle control room’. This involves running and optimising the most critical operations processes in the business: asset management, trading across UK flexibility markets, and ultimately ensuring our clients and end customers get paid for the flex they deliver.

A note on the job title: Analytics engineering is often closely associated with dbt. We don't use dbt at Axle because our data set up doesn't require a full ETL framework. Instead, this role is centred on the core analytics engineering skill set: developing a deep understanding of source data and building the data pipelines that power our analytics.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Owning operations for our UK energy trading (e.g. daily trading processes, reviewing settlements)
  • Debugging complex edge cases across our trading, asset registration and settlement processes
  • Identifying risks to revenue and delivery and proactively mitigate them
  • Communicating insights and actions clearly to engineering and commercial teams
  • Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders in Distribution System Operators (DSOs) and UK market regulators

It would be great if you had

  • Strong SQL and Python skills for analysing data, investigating issues, and automating processes
  • Strong analytical skills: you’ll be speaking MW, kWh, and £ every day
  • A deep-seated motivation to combat climate change
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

Benefits

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  • Initial interview
  • Take-home exercise
  • Final interview (in-person)
  • Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Compensation Range: £75K - £200K

Title: Commercial Performance Analyst
Description:
Looking for a challenge in one of the world’s largest airfreight logistics organisations?

At IAG Cargo we are in the business of moving things. From antibiotics to groundbreaking tech, gold bullion to avocados and everything in between. We move cargo that positively impacts society worldwide. Whatever people need, wherever they are. At IAG Cargo we open the skies and fly the world to bring people the things they really need.  

We are the logistics and cargo brand of International Airlines Group (Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, Level and Vueling). Powered by five airlines, our reach is truly global – but it’s the impact we make that defines us. At IAG Cargo, we believe in keeping the world’s economies turning, and do everything with determined attitudes, curious minds, collaborative actions and heartfelt pride. Join us at our globally recognised logistics business, that is Trusted to Deliver.

About The Role

The Commercial Performance Analyst role is an exciting opportunity to join a team focused on transforming how we use data to drive commercial success. You’ll play a key role in supporting a transformation of performance reporting, developing new analytical capabilities within the Commercial team, and delivering insights across the business that help shape more dynamic decisions that maximise performance. The role is a core driver as part of the transformation of Commercial reporting that will help develop new and innovative ways to surface, interpret, and act on proactive performance data by turning complex data sets into actionable insights that drive decision-making and unlock value across the business

The Following Will Be Key To Your Success


Being able to articulate complex pieces of information into stories and outputs which are understood by a range of seniority and experience levels,
Maintaining good relationships with external suppliers to ensure strong collaboration on model accuracy.


What You’ll Do


Working as part of the Commercial Performance team, demonstrate commerciality and curiosity to provide proactive, data-led insights that support improved commercial decision-making across all areas.
Work closely with colleagues in Contribution Management, Sales, and Operations to understand business needs and translate them into actionable and proactive analysis.
Working alongside stakeholders across the Commercial business areas and with Data & Analytics team, develop intuitive real time dashboards and visual tools that bring performance insights to life for stakeholders at all levels in real time.
Provide teams across Contribution Management and wider Commercial area with proactive insight that drives improved commercial decision making, helping grow IAG Cargo’s contribution.


It's All About You

What you’ll bring to IAG Cargo:


Strong analytical skills with experience in performance reporting and business intelligence
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills
Ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights
Experience working with cross-functional teams in a commercial setting
Advanced analytical ability, with a good understanding of how to build models in Excel or similar as well as Tableau and/or Power BI experience
Comfortable working with and managing external suppliers to deliver the correct outcome.
Support ad hoc analysis requests and special projects.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems


Required

Skills and Experience:


Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and Excel
Ability to work collaboratively and communicate insights clearly to stakeholders at all levels
Ability to make decisions and exercise sound judgement based on detailed analysis
Ability to drive change identified from analysis and decisions
A strong team player with energy and drive to achieve the team’s objectives


Desirable


Understanding of the airfreight business
Understanding of airfreight/logistics processes and data


We’ll treat you right

Wherever you work within IAG Cargo, you’ll play a part in helping us deliver what the world needs and join a diverse and inclusive business that’s making a difference.

As well as a competitive salary, bonus, we offer a range of benefits to support our colleagues, which include:


A hybrid environment with 3 days a week in the office and two from home.
From the day you join us, you’ll get access to brilliant staff travel benefits including unlimited basic and premium standby tickets on British Airways and group airlines. You’ll also receive up to 30 discounted ‘Hotline’ airfares per year for yourself, friends, and family.
Flexible bank holiday policy- Individuals not on shift have the flexibility to swap the statutory public holidays, with the days you choose to take off instead.
All our colleagues get access to LinkedIn learning and Rosetta Stone Language courses
For health and wellbeing we offer a free onsite gym facility as well as access to the UNMIND app and a community of Mental Health First Aiders
Access to discounts on Apple, Cinema tickets and loads of other goodies through Perks at work


Diversity and Inclusion

Our recruitment procedures positively support our diversity and inclusion agenda.

All candidates are considered strictly on their merits in relation to the criteria for the role, treated fairly and consistently, and have their individual needs responded to throughout the process.
