Title: YouTube Data Analyst
Description:
LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.

YouTube is one of our biggest growth engines, home to some of the most distinctive channels, including LADbible Entertainment, LADbible Stories and SPORTbible. From working with the world’s biggest creators and A-list talent on hit formats like Snack Wars, to powerful storytelling through series such as Minutes With and Honesty Box, we’ve become one of the most exciting and influential players in the industry.

About The Role

Our YouTube team is growing, and we are on the proactive lookout for a Data Analyst in media industries. The Data Analyst produces insight that drives decisions across the YouTube team and informs the Originals commissioning pipeline.

What The Opportunity Looks Like


Channel Performance - Analyse YouTube channel performance across watch time, CTR, audience retention, subscriber growth, CPMs, return viewers, and audience share to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Dashboard Management - Build, maintain, and optimise live reporting dashboards using Looker Studio and BigQuery, ensuring stakeholders have access to accurate, actionable performance data.
External Intelligence - Conduct competitive and market intelligence using tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, and platform analytics to benchmark performance and identify emerging category trends.
Format Growth and Analysis - Deliver audience, content format, and growth analysis to inform channel strategy, content investment decisions, and new channel or format opportunities.
Portfolio Growth Tracking - Monitor portfolio performance against targets, proactively flagging underperformance and providing data-driven recommendations to support business and commercial objectives.


Skills and experience we'd like you to have


Proven experience in data analytics or digital/media analytics, ideally within YouTube, social media, or digital publishing environments.
Experience analysing YouTube performance metrics, including watch time, audience retention, CTR, subscriber growth, RPM/CPM, and viewer behaviour.
Ability to interpret large datasets and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
Proficiency in BigQuery, SQL, Looker Studio, and data visualisation best practices.
Familiarity with competitive intelligence and social analytics tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, or similar platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.


At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Pricing Analyst




About Natoora




Natoora started close to 20 years ago with a very simple, yet powerful goal to find incredible flavour in fresh produce. Today, our dedication to this mission has grown into an impactful network of over 500 independent growers spanning nine sourcing hubs across three continents. Our mission is clear: to fix the food system at scale by reinstating flavour, nutrition and transparency, all while safeguarding the health of our soils.

Experts in sourcing flavour-first, seasonal fruits and vegetables, we work with hundreds of kitchens and some of the most exciting and influential chefs in London, New York, Miami, Copenhagen, Paris, and Melbourne. However, our commitment to creating a better food system also extends beyond professional kitchens to a strong community of home consumers across the US and the UK. From chefs, to home cooks to schoolchildren, we want to empower everyone to make better food choices and become informed drivers of change.

Our sourcing efforts also go well beyond fresh produce, tackling multiple facets of the food system at once — from restoring the value of whole grains through bread with our own mill and bakery, Alma, to farming produce directly at Great Fen Farm, and crafting our own range of seasonal dips, soups, and sauces in our Bermondsey kitchen. Whether we’re partnering with independent producers on flavour-first dry goods or developing recipes rooted in our seasonal fresh produce, everything we do is founded on the same principles of seasonality,

quality and integrity whilst steadfastly embracing scalability as a source of impact.

On the way, we have been named a Sunday Times Fast Track 100 Company, appeared on the Financial Times’ list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and proudly received a GQ Food & Drinks Sustainability Award.




About the role

We are looking for a passionate and focussed Pricing Analyst to support profitability in the UK through pricing and data-driven insights. You will sit at the intersection of pricing, analytics, and commercial operations, partnering closely with Sales, Buying, and Finance teams. In your day-to-day, you will own key pricing workflows, support growth systems and translate data into actionable recommendations that inform decision-making across the region.




Responsibilities:

Manage cost data and pricing on full product portfolio to align with margin and growth targets
Provide evidence to support cost price reviews with our suppliers
Collect, clean and conduct analysis on competitor data and recommend actions based on your findings
Calculate cost assumptions for new suppliers and regions and review cost assumptions periodically
Analyse, model and interpret the profitability impact of theoretical pricing changes
Drive margin improvements at company level by deep-dive analysis on key selling lines and categories
Create pricing strategies for hero products
Review new product costings, providing feedback and support to the sales team
Ad-hoc projects/analysis to support leadership, sales, and growth initiatives
Create, enhance, and maintain dashboards and reports (primarily in Tableau) as needed




Requirements




At least 1-year of experience in pricing, commercial analytics or similar analytical role
An analytical mind, able to interpret data, develop hypothesis and creative ideas to improve margins
Strong proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets
Experience with BI platforms/tools such as Tableau (preferred) or PowerBI
Intellectually curious but with proven track record of rolling up sleeves to understand the ins and outs of margins (understanding inventory waste, transport costs, liaising with suppliers etc)
Demonstration of strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate with internal and external stakeholders
Accustomed to working with and meeting time critical deadlines
Resilient. Accustomed to Problem Solving.
Demonstrate a passion for food, fresh produce and for our ethos
Applicants must be legally entitled to work full time in the UK




PERKS




You will work in one of the most exciting and innovative companies in our sector, within an open and supportive environment and with the potential to deliver a significant positive impact on our society.




Daily lunch made with the same seasonal produce we supply to chefs
Natoora produce at a significant discount
Your birthday off (once you've hit the 6 month mark)
Kitchen stocked from our own growers and producers - including Estate Dairy milk and butter, jam from England Preserves as well as coffee from our Spa Terminus neighbours Monmouth




Our vision for a better food system is built on real human relationships and a diversity of experience, perspective and ideas. We are committed to equality of opportunity and welcome applications from individuals, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion and/or belief.

Title: Archive Insights Analyst, ITN News Production
Description:
About ITN




ITN is one of the UK’s leading independent content production companies, trusted for over 70 years to tell the world’s most important stories. From BAFTA- and Emmy-winning journalism and impactful factual content to creative entertainment and branded storytelling, ITN brings truth and innovation to every platform. Making over 70 hours of live programmes a week and reaching 1 billion digital views a month, we are a content powerhouse that has an ambition to keep growing, with audiences across the UK and around the world.




Our people are at the heart of our success. With a reputation built on integrity and creativity, ITN continues to evolve with an ambitious growth strategy — investing in new technology, premium content, and future talent. We’re proud to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture where everyone can thrive and help shape the next chapter of ITN’s story.




We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer where everyone’s contribution matters. We’re committed to building a culture that reflects the audiences we serve — one where people feel included, supported, and inspired to do their best work.




How We Work

At ITN, how we work is as important as what we do. Our values describe what you can expect when you work here — and what ITN expects of you.




Ambition – We set bold goals, take ownership, and keep learning. We look for new opportunities and better ways to make an impact.

Courage – We speak up with honesty and respect, challenge ideas constructively, and value open, direct communication.

Team – We collaborate, celebrate others’ successes, and make sure every voice is heard. We put the team’s success first.




We also recognise the importance of balance and wellbeing, so we welcome flexible working, part-time roles and job shares across all areas of ITN.




The Role

Archive Insights Analyst (YouTube Content ID)

This is a role for someone who gets excited by how data and insight can draw people into stories, video production and living histories.




A big part of the job is turning years of archive sales and usage signals into real, creatively coherent collections — working closely with existing archivists to shape packs that feel editorially smart and discovery-led.




You’ll also be comfortable generating and presenting insight clearly, holding your own in conversations about rights, platform policy and commercial outcomes, and making the data legible to colleagues who don’t live in spreadsheets.




You’ll sit at the intersection of editorial judgement, rights management and platform performance, helping ITN make the most of its archive by combining YouTube Content ID expertise with data-driven curation. Title: Product Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Product Analyst

Function: Data

Location: London/ Peterborough

Curious about what’s next?

So are we. Join Compare the Market and help to make financial decision making a breeze for millions.

At Compare the Market, we’re a purpose-driven business powered by tech and AI. We’re building high-performing, results-driven teams with the skills, mindset, and ambition to deliver outcomes at pace. Every role here plays a part in driving our mission forward, and we create an environment where you can bring your authentic self, grow a truly characterful career, and see the direct impact of your work on the lives of our customers.

We’ve carved a meerkat-shaped niche and we’re looking for ambitious, curious thinkers who thrive in a fast-moving, high-impact environment. If you love accountability, embrace challenge, and want to make a real difference, you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Be Doing


Analyse customer behaviour and product performance using techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, and behavioural analytics to identify opportunities and drive improvements
Support Product Managers in understanding customer journeys, user engagement, conversion, and retention, helping to shape product strategy and priorities
Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
Define and measure product success metrics and KPIs, evaluating the impact of product changes and communicating outcomes to stakeholders
Design, execute, and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, helping to embed a culture of experimentation and evidence-based decision-making
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions, proactively monitoring trends, identifying risks, and surfacing growth opportunities
Partner with Analytics Engineering teams to ensure KPI definitions, business logic, and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable, and trusted
Apply AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, predictive modelling, and automated insight generation, to enhance product understanding and measurement
Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis and customer insight


What We’re Looking For

You’ll have strong analytical skills and experience working with large datasets to uncover insights that drive better customer and business outcomes. You’ll be highly proficient in SQL and comfortable analysing customer and behavioural data to support product decisions and strategic priorities.

You’ll bring experience with experimentation and A/B testing, alongside a solid understanding of statistical concepts and product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and segmentation. Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI is essential, as is the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You’ll have an understanding of digital product development and customer experience optimisation, with a curiosity for how emerging technologies, including AI, can improve product measurement, experimentation, and customer understanding. Experience using Python or R for analysis, and familiarity with product analytics platforms such as FullStory, Mixpanel, or Amplitude, would be advantageous.

We’re looking for someone who combines analytical rigour with product curiosity, thrives in collaborative environments, and enjoys helping teams make better decisions through data.

Why Compare the Market?

We’re a business built for pace and performance. Here, you’ll be encouraged to think differently, act boldly, and deliver brilliantly in a culture that values results and rewards progress.

We believe diverse teams make better decisions, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels empowered to grow, contribute, and thrive.

If you’re ready to stretch yourself, raise the bar, and grow with a team that’s serious about performance, innovation, and purpose, we’d love to hear from you.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:

Reporting to the Manager of Customer Relationship Management & Marketing Technology, this position will analyze, manage, customize, and optimize SIGA’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. The Data Analyst will collaborate with various departments to ensure the CRM system aligns with business goals, enhances customer interactions, and contributes to the organization’s success.

Strong ability to work with structured query language (SQL).
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, OneDrive, and Teams).
Ability to create reports/dashboards with large data sets for business intelligence needs.

Title: Analyst Statistician
Description:
Mandate

The Analyst/Statistician advances evidence based decision making across the university by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data related to enrolment, student success, academic programs, operations, and strategic initiatives. The role leverages modern analytics tools—including Power BI and emerging AI driven technologies—to transform complex information into actionable insights. This position supports institutional planning, accreditation, assessment, and compliance reporting while collaborating with academic and administrative units to strengthen the university’s strategic capacity.

Objectives

This position strengthens the university’s ability to make informed, strategic decisions. By integrating advanced analytics, Power BI dashboards, and AI driven insights, the Analyst/Statistician helps shape academic planning, improve student outcomes, and ensure accountability to internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a bachelor’s degree in education, Statistics, Social Sciences, Data Science, or a related field and 3 years related experience. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Include


Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills.
Proficiency with statistical software (e.g., SAS, SPSS, R, Python) and database tools (e.g., SQL).
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Collaborative and independent work.
High level of attention to detail, clear documentation, and ability to work with sensitive information.
Experience with data visualization tools, including Power BI.
Predictive modeling, time series analysis, forecasting.
Familiarity with AI assisted analytics tools (e.g., natural language query features, automated insights, predictive modeling platforms) and the curation of results.


Preferred


Master’s degree in a relevant field.
Experience in higher education or institutional research, especially in the BC context.
Knowledge of student information systems (e.g., Banner).
Experience applying AI tools to data analysis, forecasting, or workflow automation.
Familiarity with accreditation standards and government reporting requirements.

Title: Data Analytics Coordinator
Description:
Position Summary

The Data Analytics Coordinator plays a supporting role as a steward of PRPA's data warehouses, from data ongestion through to the creation and maintenance of reports. They are responsible for ensuring the quality and integrity of data used for various activities from infrastructure planning to business development.

Position Accountabilities


PRPA's primary data steward for all forms of data, including geospatial (GIS) data, which support day-to-day operations at PRPA.
Load data assets into PRPA’s data warehouses following best practices.
Support and maintain PRPA’s data warehouse.
Maintenance of reports and dashboards.
Training of PRPA staff in end user reporting tools available for accessing PRPA’s data.


WORKING CONDITIONS


Works predominantly in an office environment.
Regular, full-time position (37.5 hours per week). Regular working hours are Mondays to Fridays, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM with 1 hour unpaid lunch break.


JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Formal Education


College diploma in Analytics, Computer Science Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Information Technology.


Related Experience


Three to five years' experience in the industry


Other Requirements


Experience with reporting tools and software including SSRS, PowerBI, Informatica.
Experience with SSIS or other data ingestion and transformation tools.
Experience using Safe FME for processing geospatial data.
Experience with report writing, organizing, and presenting data in support of decision making
Demonstrates statistical and empirical analytical skills
Knowledge of relational database structures, theories, principles, and practices is an asset
Knowledge of ETL methodologies, T-SQL and ArcGIS is an asset
Familiar with the transportation and logistics industry
Demonstrates ability to learn new skills and acquire industry knowledge
Good spoken and written communication skills
Strong problem solving and organizational skills
Accuracy and attention to detail, with an analytical eye
Superior judgment and tact in dealing with sensitive issues and confidential information.
Demonstrates ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and to effectively handle changing priorities.
Enthusiastic and self-motivated. Works well individually as well as in a team environment.
Creative and intuitive thinker.
Demonstrates commitment to the Port’s Vision.
Resilient. Embraces change and thrives on change.
Proficient in MS Office, especially Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint; some exposure to MS Access and Project.
Able to obtain security clearance under Transport Canada's Security Clearance Program.


The base salary range for this role is $77,689 - $97,112. This position is eligible for a performance-based variable incentive targeted at 10% of the base salary.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.

Description:
Data Analyst

Technology and Projects Services

(Competition 26:31)




Centrally located in downtown Vancouver, the BC Securities Commission (BCSC) strives to make the investment markets benefit the public – enabling people to achieve their financial goals, enterprises to grow, and British Columbia to thrive. Through smart rules, diligent oversight, strong enforcement and reliable guidance, we act as guardians of the province’s investment marketplace, striving to make BC a place where people can invest with confidence and companies can flourish. We are an independent agency accountable to the provincial legislature and the public through the Minister of Finance.




Position Overview:

BCSC is currently seeking a full-time innovative, technically advanced, and detail-orientated Data Analyst to join our dynamic team in our Technology and Projects Services (TAPS) Division.




The Data Analyst is a technology expert who specializes in analyzing, collecting, preparing, storing, and creating electronic data. The successful candidate will participate in all day-to-day data support functions including: Business Intelligence (BI) support, governance, ad-hoc reporting requests, developing user dashboards, and projects. In addition, you will work with internal and external data sources for the purpose of analyzing, cleaning, answering questions on results of analysis, and preparing data based on defined use cases to be used in advanced analytics.

Key responsibilities:

Collect, clean, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources to support business reporting and decision-making.
Develop and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and data models for analytics and reporting purposes.
Create and optimize Power BI dashboards, reports, and data visualizations to present meaningful insights and support BI tools and platforms, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and accessibility.
Work with Azure cloud services and advanced analytics tools for data processing and automation.
Implement and maintain data management policies using Microsoft Purview.
Ensure proper data classification, lineage, and security through governance best practices.
Utilize Microsoft Fabric for data integration, transformation, and orchestration.
Develop and maintain ETL and ELT pipelines using SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, and other tools.
Perform statistical analysis using Python, R, or other programming languages as needed.
Troubleshoot and optimize database performance, ensuring efficient data processing.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Communicate complex technical solutions to non-technical audiences.
Partner with the Economic Analysis Data Science and TAPS Operations and Information and Data Management teams to drive data related initiatives.




Qualifications:




A technical diploma or university degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or similar field and a minimum of 3 years of experience working with SQL and data analytics required. An equivalent combination of education and experience is considered.
Hands on experience and working knowledge of the following systems, tools and platforms is preferred:
T-SQL programming and JSON
Power Query and Power BI
SQL Server, including SSIS, and SSRS as well as Azure cloud analytics tools (e.g., Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL).
Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Fabric
Experience supporting data governance and data quality initiatives, including maintaining data dictionaries, lineage, and business rules and demonstrated expertise in ELT and ETL principles, including data transformation and pipeline optimization.
Sound understanding of statistical computing programming languages (R, Python), data modeling, data warehousing, and data mining techniques.
Strong analytics skills, with a proven ability to solve logical challenges and synthesize data to develop meaningful insight.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Able to drive results, meet deadlines, and prioritize tasks with minimal supervision.




What we offer:

We offer a challenging and rewarding work environment which includes:

Extensive benefit package including a defined benefit pension plan, medical and dental coverage, Wellness and Health Spending Account benefits, and 4 weeks of annual vacation
Hybrid work model
Beautiful downtown office
Work life balance
Professional development opportunities
A professional and collaborative team to work with!

Salary Range:

The salary range for this position is $86,097 (minimum) - $111.814 (midpoint) - $137,531 (maximum).




The starting salary for this position will be determined considering the successful candidate’s relevant experience and education, salaries of other employees in the same salary range, market conditions, and other relevant factors. Starting salaries are normally below the salary band midpoint.




Application Details:

Please visit our Careers page to submit your cover letter and resume for this position, quoting competition 26:31 by September 11, 2026.

The BC Securities Commission embraces diversity and is committed to building an inclusive workforce that celebrates the richness of our community. We aim to ensure every job applicant is treated fairly and with respect and encourage applications from all candidates, including those with diverse abilities. We welcome you to inform us in confidence by emailing HumanResources@bcsc.bc.ca if you may require any support or accommodations during the application process, including disability accommodation, in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience.




Candidates must be authorized to work in Canada. Investment restrictions apply.

Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Description:
Who We Are

Price Industries Limited, North America’s leading manufacturer and distributor of air distribution products (www.priceindustries.com). The founding principles of Price have never changed – business integrity, first-class service, innovation and a commitment to people. Our dependable quality, reliable delivery, and knowledgeable follow-up service have made Price a market leader in supplying air distribution, critical controls, and noise control products.

After more than 60 years, Price remains a privately held family company with a deep heritage and commitment to innovation and service. Our long-standing vision, values, and the Price way of doing business are the cornerstones of our success.

We are a dynamic, progressive and innovative organization looking for new talent in our growing Winnipeg manufacturing facility. If you thrive on new challenges, and working in a friendly, team-driven environment, you should consider the following opportunity.

What You Can Expect


Health and Dental - Employees and their families enjoy paid benefits covering an extensive list of medical and dental expenses and services.
Manulife Virtual Pharmacy - Access pharmacy services anytime, anywhere through the Manulife app, with eligible prescriptions delivered directly to your home.
Manulife Mental Health and Counselling Services - Access confidential mental health and wellness support through the Manulife app, with convenient options to book counselling, consultations, and guided programs all in one place.
Life and Disability - You will be provided with life insurance in a multiple of your salary with an option to purchase additional coverage.
Pension Matching Program - Invest in your future with each pay cheque through our Defined Contribution Pension Plan and we will match your contribution (up to 3% of your salary).
Wellness Reimbursement Program - Employees are eligible for a fitness centre or club membership reimbursement of up to $300 per year, this includes Fitness related App’s.
Personal and Professional Development - We are committed to helping you reach your potential through training and education.
Community Involvement - Generously supporting health, charities, youth, and education opportunities is our passion, and you’re invited to be a part of that.
Our convenient Price Café offers free Tea and Coffee.


Purpose

Serve as the primary point of contact for ERP data and reporting at the site, ensuring alignment between corporate data strategy and plant operations by supporting data accessibility, reporting continuity, and informed decision making throughout the IFS ERP implementation.

The Successful Candidate's Responsibilities Will Include

Data Consultation & Navigation


Support the data domain throughout the ongoing IFS ERP implementation, ensuring all data-related activities contribute toward the final goal of system commissioning.
Guide users through the organization's data landscape, helping users locate specific data points, dashboards, and KPI information within existing systems.
Consult with business units to support users understand available data resources.
Serve as the liaison between the corporate data team and plant users, translating data strategies into actionable operational insights.
Provide expert guidance to users on data accessibility, ensuring users have timely access to the information required to support informed operational and business decision-making.


Reporting Continuity & Analysis


Gather, interpret, and document reports from existing systems to ensure the new IFS platform delivers equivalent or enhanced reporting capabilities post-implementation.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and anomalies, translating technical data into meaningful insights that reflect real-world manufacturing conditions.
Develop a deep understanding of where data originates and what it represents in a production environment.


Data Triage & Corporate Alignment


Proactively identify, analyze, and triage all data-related requests from users, assessing their scope, impact, and urgency.
Provide timely support for data and reporting requests within the capabilities of the existing platform whenever possible.
Collaborate with the corporate team to evaluate complex data requirements or system gaps, escalating issues as needed to ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise standards and maintain KPI consistency across all plants.
Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand their specific data requirements and ensure the requirements are met during and after the IFS commissioning.


Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess:


Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Proven experience in data analysis, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
Experience working in an IFS environment is considered an asset.
Strong proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) and an ability to learn new ERP data structures quickly.
Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to "connect the dots" between data and real-life operations.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a service-oriented mindset to support and train non-technical users.
Ability to triage requests, manage multiple priorities, and act as a bridge between plant needs and corporate standards.
Self-motivated with a strong willingness to learn new business processes and data systems.
Strong affiliation with Price’s core values

Purpose

Serve as the primary point of contact for ERP data and reporting at the site, ensuring alignment between corporate data strategy and plant operations by supporting data accessibility, reporting continuity, and informed decision making throughout the IFS ERP implementation.

The Successful Candidate's Responsibilities Will Include

Data Consultation & Navigation

  • Support the data domain throughout the ongoing IFS ERP implementation, ensuring all data-related activities contribute toward the final goal of system commissioning.
  • Guide users through the organization's data landscape, helping users locate specific data points, dashboards, and KPI information within existing systems.
  • Consult with business units to support users understand available data resources.
  • Serve as the liaison between the corporate data team and plant users, translating data strategies into actionable operational insights.
  • Provide expert guidance to users on data accessibility, ensuring users have timely access to the information required to support informed operational and business decision-making.

Reporting Continuity & Analysis

  • Gather, interpret, and document reports from existing systems to ensure the new IFS platform delivers equivalent or enhanced reporting capabilities post-implementation.
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and anomalies, translating technical data into meaningful insights that reflect real-world manufacturing conditions.
  • Develop a deep understanding of where data originates and what it represents in a production environment.

Data Triage & Corporate Alignment

  • Proactively identify, analyze, and triage all data-related requests from users, assessing their scope, impact, and urgency.
  • Provide timely support for data and reporting requests within the capabilities of the existing platform whenever possible.
  • Collaborate with the corporate team to evaluate complex data requirements or system gaps, escalating issues as needed to ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise standards and maintain KPI consistency across all plants.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand their specific data requirements and ensure the requirements are met during and after the IFS commissioning.

  • Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in data analysis, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience working in an IFS environment is considered an asset.
  • Strong proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) and an ability to learn new ERP data structures quickly.
  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to "connect the dots" between data and real-life operations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a service-oriented mindset to support and train non-technical users.
  • Ability to triage requests, manage multiple priorities, and act as a bridge between plant needs and corporate standards.

Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding

Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and process optimization

2+ years of experience in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role working with large datasets
Strong experience with Power BI and Power Query
Advanced Excel skills
Intermediate proficiency in Python or R
Experience or interest in AI tools and applications

Strong data cleaning, transformation, and analysis skills
Ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights
Experience building queries, reports, and visualizations
High attention to detail and accuracy
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
A proactive learner who is curious, adaptable, and driven to improve processes

Why Join StarTech.com?

Competitive salary and bonus potential
Comprehensive benefits package
Collaborative and innovative work environment
Opportunities to grow your skills in analytics, BI, and AI

Intro call with our Talent Acquisition Team (30 minutes)

Offer & onboarding

This role offers a competitive salary range of CAD $68,000 to $78,000 and eligibility to participate in our bonus program. At StarTech.com, we value fairness and regularly benchmark pay to stay competitive, recognizing each person’s unique contributions.

Comprehensive health benefits
Tuition reimbursement program
Retirement savings plans
Wellness Program
Additional perks and rewards

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

With a legacy spanning over a century, Pollard Banknote has become a world leader in instant ticket manufacturing and digital lottery solutions that enhance player engagement through cutting-edge technology. Competitive compensation

Comprehensive Group Benefits
Opportunities for professional development
A variety of committee-driven employee engagement activities
Remote Work Environment

Assist in eInstant Benchmark reporting design and development
Maintain and analyze iLottery annual and monthly goals model
Assist with iLottery new business analysis by request
Monitor and collaborate on insights from iLottery industry with internal stakeholders
Assist and support the Manager of Digital Analytics as needed
Miscellaneous tasks as requested by Director of Digital Games Studio

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.

Equity Grade - 6

Title: Analyst, Data & Analytics
Description:
Permanent Full Time

Canada Life is seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join the Insurance Solutions team. As a part of the Performance Management area, this role will be responsible for supporting the data management, analysis, and reporting needs of the department. The Data Analyst supports decision-making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and visualizations tailored to different audiences.

The role will benefit from collaboration with subject matter experts and data scientists. If you are looking to become a subject matter expert in connected data and help guide the team in improving processes through data mining and analysis, this is the role for you.

Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto and London.

What You Will Do


Build, implement, and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards, keeping in mind the needs of varied audiences
Create visually compelling presentations and use strong communication skills to present them to stakeholders (ability to build a narrative that outlines the background and highlights the impact of initiatives)
Identify opportunities to ingest data, prioritize data needs, and build data marts to drive efficiencies in reporting functions
Leverage data expertise to support new initiatives through analysis and ongoing reporting across the entire analytics lifecycle
Communicate requirements to the Technology team for development and ensure smooth deployment of data projects after performing data quality testing
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver data solutions that meet business needs
Support existing data owners in their data management practices, ensuring a single source of truth
Work with large datasets that may be inconsistent, unclean, or not fully modeled
Ensure best practices are followed with respect to data governance and structure
Communicate effectively while demonstrating critical thinking and business acumen


What You Will Bring


University or College education in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, data modelling, and Databricks, with experience creating interactive dashboards
Ability to work with diverse data inputs and build data marts aligned with business requirements
Proven ability to learn quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instructions
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to produce high-quality outputs under tight timelines
Driven to continuously improve processes, performance, and efficiency
Knowledge of the organization, distribution channels, products, systems, and data is an asset
Ability to write complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple sources
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or R
Hands-on experience with Azure compute services and a good understanding of Azure Data Factory pipelines
Preferred: Microsoft Certified – Azure Data Analyst Associate (Power BI) certification


The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $87,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Department: Information Technology

Other duties as assigned.

Working knowledge of SQL, CSS, and content management applications.
Detail oriented with strong analytical, problem-solving skills.
Strong understanding of user acceptance testing and software implementation practices.
Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects.
Collaborative, service-oriented IT team member.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365 automation or AI tools.

In rotation with Senior Developer, provide after hours Tessitura and ecommerce support.

Title: Financial Data Analyst
Description:
Join Our Team

"Cascade Aerospace is one of Canada's leading specialty aerospace and defence contractors - a place where we do cool things for great customers!" We invite you to consider a career with us - come, experience our creative, innovative, and performance-based company!

Job Description

Financial Data Analyst supports financial planning, reporting, costing, and business decision-making through advanced data analysis and financial modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Excel, Power BI, and database querying tools, combined with a solid foundation in accounting and ERP systems. This role will transform complex financial data into actionable insights that drive operational and financial performance.

CPA designation is not required. Candidates with strong analytical, financial modeling, and business intelligence skills are encouraged to apply.

This position requires immediate Controlled Goods clearance, therefore, only Canadian Citizens or Permanent Residents will be considered at this time.

Major Responsibilities & Duties

Financial Analysis & Reporting


Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and maintain recurring financial reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.
Provide actionable recommendations to management based on financial and business performance.


Financial Modeling


Build, maintain, and enhance financial models for budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.
Develop profitability, pricing, and cost allocation models.
Perform sensitivity and trend analyses to support business initiatives and investments.


Business Intelligence & Data Analytics


Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Power Query, and other query tools.
Improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and automation across finance processes.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements and data solutions.


Costing & ERP Systems


Support product costing, operational costing, and margin analysis initiatives.
Analyze manufacturing, distribution, or operational costs to identify efficiency opportunities.
Maintain and validate financial data within ERP systems.
Partner with operations, supply chain, and accounting teams to improve cost visibility and reporting.


Accounting & Financial Controls


Apply general accounting principles to ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
Support month-end and year-end financial reporting activities.
Assist with account reconciliations, financial audits, and internal controls as required.
Ensure data integrity between ERP systems and reporting platforms.


Core Skills


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: PivotTables, Power Query, Advanced formulas and functions, and Financial modeling
Strong proficiency in Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries and working with relational databases.
Strong understanding of data management, reporting automation, and analytics best practices.
Familiarity with ERP reporting tools and financial data structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Education


University degree in Business, Accounting or equivalent
CPA designation is not required.


Experience


3–7 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, data analytics, or related finance roles.
Experience building robust financial models and conducting financial analysis.
Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, JD Edwards, or similar).
Experience with costing and general accounting practices.
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or operational finance environments.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and business intelligence tools.
Experience with advanced analytics, forecasting, and scenario planning.
Understanding of cost accounting methodologies and profitability analysis.


Reasons To Apply


Employee retention and engagement is important to Cascade; we value our employees.
Comprehensive benefits package provided. Extended benefits and the Employee Resilience Program (all 100% paid by Cascade) are offered after 3 months of employment and Pension matching after 6 months.
ATO (Approved Training Organization) provides endorsement (type) training & development.
Company-wide social events and family functions throughout the year.
Relocation Package available for qualifying candidates.


About Cascade

Cascade Aerospace Inc. is a dynamic, privately-held Canadian specialty aerospace and defence contractor focused on providing long-term integrated aircraft support programs for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), military, government and commercial customers.

All employees are encouraged to realize their true potential and play an active role in fostering an environment of safety, quality, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. What You’ll Do


Design, develop, and maintain reports and complex analytical solutions by gathering business requirements, translating requirements into technical specifications and logical data model, developing corresponding database, troubleshooting errors, and deploying solutions. Write ad-hoc queries and reports to support staff and leaders in data analysis, when required.

Design, develop, and support the automated data ETL (extraction, transform and load) processes by automating data gathering from on-premise applications or cloud sources on the internet, troubleshooting programming errors, developing and deploying solutions to fix errors. Develop technical requirement and implementation plan, coordinate with stakeholders to execute technical implementation plan, and escalates to project sponsor(s) when required.
Develop small applications with GUI (Graphical User Interface) to gather business data, troubleshoots application programming errors, and develop / deploy solutions to fix errors.

Provide training on applications and reporting, coach and support staff by hosting presentations, or writing users manuals.
Perform other related duties as assigned.


Qualifications

What you bring


Graduation from a recognized degree or diploma program in Computer Science, three (3) years of recent related experience or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Demonstrated knowledge of the historic and ongoing impacts of settler colonialism on Indigenous Peoples in social and health contexts, including supported by significant knowledge of Indigenous-specific mandates, including clear understanding of and commitment to eradicate Indigenous-specific racism and discrimination and embed Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility.

Brings an understanding of the Indigenous specific racism and the broader systemic racism that exists in the colonial health care structure, and has demonstrated initiatives in breaking down barriers and ensuring a safe environment ensuring a sense of belonging to all and informed by Indigenous Cultural Safety.
Awareness of social, economic, political and historical realities of settler colonialism on Indigenous Peoples and familiarity with addressing Indigenous-specific anti-racism, anti-racism and Indigenous Cultural Safety and foundational documents and legislative commitments (the Declaration Act, the Declaration Action Plan, TRC, IPS, Remembering Keegan, etc.).


Skills & Knowledge


Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
Ability to deal with others effectively.
Physical ability to carry out the duties of the position.
Ability to write programs in a variety of program languages
Ability to organize work.
Ability to operate related equipment.

Shows willingness to articulate and share their learning experiences to contribute to a culture of motivation and inspiration among peers.

Understands the impact of social determinants of health-on-health outcomes. Every PHSA employee enables the best possible patient care for our patients and their families. Whether you are providing direct care, conducting research, or making it possible for others to do their work, you impact the lives of British Columbians today and in the future. That’s why we’re focused on your care too – offering health, wellness, development programs to support you – at work and at home.

Manage and/or provide guidance to junior members of the analytics team.

Knowledge of OLAP database technology and data modelling, with experience in MDX and DAX an asset.
Experience with SSIS, SSAS, ETL processes, SQL Agent jobs, and related integration and data management tools.
Experience with Visual Studio.NET and VB.NET is an asset.
Project management experience is an asset.
