Libro Credit Union is growing!

Join Libro Credit Union as a full-time Data Analyst - London Administration

At Libro Credit Union, every employee and every customer are members. Everything we do is about strengthening financial well-being for a better tomorrow.

As a Certified B Corporation©, we use business as a force for good. That means:

  • Empowering people to live their most fulfilled lives.
  • Supporting businesses and communities to thrive.
  • Caring for the planet and economic growth through sustainable practices.

Libro invests in our employee’s development and career ambitions. We value candidates who are accountable, courageous, inclusive, driven to perform and have a passion for supporting people, local business and communities in strengthening their financial well-being.

We are currently hiring a full-time Data Analyst to support our London Administration team. This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

The Data Analyst's primary responsibility is to lead research and analytic activities to solve a wide range of business problem. They will retrieve and gather vast amounts of data, organize it and use it to reach meaningful conclusions. They will exercise their knowledge of statistical techniques, analytics skills and database analysis tools and techniques to develop strategic insights to drive business goals. Data Analyst are more excited about what they can learn with data, than they are about what is already known.

The base salary will be determined based on skills, experience, qualifications, education/training and internal equity. Our compensation practices are equitable and transparent, and support progression through the salary range as employees grow in the role.

The Role

  • Collaborate with Internal partners to develop and execute research and analysis for strategic projects.
  • Contribute to enhancing the validity, reliability and accuracy of data and information utilized in support of business initiatives.
  • Source, manage and implement data from third parties, as required.
  • Data analysis, mining, modelling, cleansing, migration and mapping.
  • Collect, review, analyze, evaluate and prioritize reporting requirements.
  • Develops and implements report specifications including coding, testing and implementation into production environment.
  • Create datasets and/or reports for high-level analytics, including but not limited to data cubes for modeling trends, business reviews and/or analytics.
  • Present your findings with good presentation through meetings and/or presentations.
  • Ensures high quality automation techniques are applied and detailed procedures are in place
  • Collaborate with database and disaster recovery administrators to ensure effective protection and integrity of data assets.
  • Advise on current development tools and their best uses. Research new technologies to understand and make recommendations where these technologies may help solve business requirements.
  • Develop strategies for data related glossaries, data dictionaries and data flow diagrams with deep understanding of data governance in mind.
  • Work collaboratively with strategic, third-party partners and vendors on analytical requirements projects.
  • Provide expertise to other departments to analyze data, develop statistical models, and make recommendations on initiatives and projects.
  • Manage and/or provide guidance to junior members of the analytics team.

What We’re Looking For

  • Graduate or postgraduate university degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, with 5-7 years of experience in systems analysis, programming, database management, and extensive business knowledge.
  • Extensive experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches and working with complex, high-volume, high-dimensional data from multiple sources.
  • Advanced skills with SQL Server Management Studio, including stored procedures, views, functions, and ad hoc database queries, MS SQL Server Reporting Services.
  • Recognized expertise in one or more reporting/visualization tools, such as Tableau, Power BI, or Power Pivot/Map.
  • Advanced MS Excel skills, including pivot tables, graphs, mathematical formulas, and statistical add-ins.
  • Strong analytical and coding skills in R, Python, or similar languages are an asset.
  • Knowledge of OLAP database technology and data modelling, with experience in MDX and DAX an asset.
  • Experience with SSIS, SSAS, ETL processes, SQL Agent jobs, and related integration and data management tools.
  • Experience with Visual Studio.NET and VB.NET is an asset.
  • Project management experience is an asset.

We Offer Total Reward Programs to Set You Up for Success In & Outside of Work:

  • Competitive salaries, benefit packages, pension plans, & incentive programs, that value your dedication.
  • Generous vacation time. 
  • Employee wellness program, Employee & Family Assistance Program, fitness club discounts, technology offers, travel and entertainment deals.  
  • Dedicated staff banking specialists to support strengthening your own financial well-being! Staff accounts and staff rates on products and services. 
  • We believe in developing internal talent. Unlock your potential with tuition assistance and opportunities for advancement.

If you're passionate about helping your community, interested in being part of a remarkable team, and want to do your part to strengthen financial well-being for a better tomorrow - we want to hear from you!

Libro is committed to fostering a safe, healthy, and inclusive work environment that inspires respect. As an inclusive employer we are committed to providing a fully accessible recruitment process. Email us at careers@libro.ca any time during the recruitment process to let us know what supports you may need to be successful.

Please note the expected salary range for this role is available on the Libro Careers site, where candidates are required to apply.

Title: CRM Data Analyst
Description:
Invest Alberta Corporation (IAC) is dedicated to driving economic growth and fostering a business-friendly environment. IAC attracts high-impact, high-value investments by building on Alberta’s strengths and competitive advantages to create and win opportunities that make Alberta’s economy the most dynamic in North America. IAC strives to create a client and employee experience that aligns with our values; accountable, solution-minded, collaborative, trustworthy, and inclusive. By joining IAC, employees become part of a community of passionate service-oriented people who embody Alberta’s entrepreneurial spirit. 




Position Overview




In the role, the successful candidate will be responsible for the implementation, optimization, and support of IAC’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. This system is key to tracking and providing metrics for potential clients, contacts, and resources of IAC.




Primary Duties:




· Manage quality and consistency of data, train users, generate reports and input data to support Invest Alberta’s initiatives and mandate.

· Develop and continually evolve the reporting metrics and dashboards over time to the required standard for monthly Board of Directors reporting.

· Provide timely insights and analytical support to the senior leadership team.

· Spearhead work across all areas and offices to help them maintain timely, accurate, and uniform documentation of all records in the CRM system.

· Assist with administrative duties related to research & business intelligence.

· Mine and clean data in preparation for analysis.

· Continual optimization of CRM system to enhance usability, advising on best practices, and recommending process improvements to ensure scalability and efficiency.

· Create and maintain user permissions, profiles, data entry standards, data visibility to ensure compliance with privacy and security requirements.

· Develop, document, test and implement the CRM platform, ensuring the design and functions meet the needs of the organization.

· Demonstrate continuous improvement and critical thinking skills to create high quality deliverables.

· Facilitating weekly check-ins with external IT vendor to review progress of support items

· Management of IT asset inventory and maintaining oversight of hardware-related deficiencies

· Approving new hardware, upgrading existing hardware

· Overseeing the management of IAC’s cybersecurity and compliance 

· Managing SharePoint and related Microsoft ecosystem collaboration tools

· Maintaining & creating Microsoft Power Platform workflows

· Training and onboarding staff, setting up licenses and access

· Reviewing and cataloguing SOC reports for vendors ahead of audits

· Facilitating company-wide internal IT satisfaction surveys and vendor reviews

· Support Invest Alberta team members and operations as required.




Qualifications




· Relevant undergraduate degree such as economics, computing science, information management, statistics, finance, math, or other relevant degree; equivalent experience will also be considered.

· Demonstrate technical aptitude and experience supporting web-based applications.

· Must be organized, meticulous and able perform in a fast-paced environment.

· Excellent oral and written communication skills.

· Project management experience including the ability to juggle competing demands from marketing, internal customers, and management.

· Excellent ability to collaborate with all groups in the organization.

· Experience using Salesforce as a CRM system is an asset as is experience working in a Crown corporation or government agency environment. 




Why Join Invest Alberta?




You will work alongside a passionate team dedicated to attracting investment, creating jobs, and showcasing Alberta as one of the world's most competitive jurisdictions for energy development and innovation.

Title: Data Analyst EA SPORTS™ FC (Game Development Analytics)
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note - this is a temporary (12 month) position located in Vancouver, BC only. Relocation is not supported for this temporary role.

EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games.

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate, and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

As a Data Analyst you will play a key role in analyzing our operational data to improve our Quality Verification strategies for the EA Sports titles (such as FC, NBA and NHL). You should be a sharp, curious, and analytic individual who has a passion for diving into data to solve business problems. Your insights will influence how we build and verify the quality of our games, and how to improve our business processes through data insights.

The Data Analyst will be responsible for assembling data from multiple sources, conducting analyses, performing research, interacting with different internal customers, designing, documenting, and implementing analytical solutions, as well as compiling and presenting results, in graphical and written summaries, to a variety of audiences. You will be responsible for building metrics reporting systems and for tracking process improvements across the organization. You will excel in a fast paced environment, managing multiple responsibilities and deadlines in an internationally based team. The ideal candidate would be an effective communicator who combines solid technical skills with pride in excellence, who also demonstrates the potential to grow into a client-facing consulting role and/or an analytical consulting role (i.e. development of simulation models).

What a Data Analyst Does At EA


Assembles data from multiple sources, conducts analyses, performs research, designs, documents and implements analytical solutions.
Presents analysis conclusions to the internal customer in a clear, understandable, and valuable way.
Communicates with team members and business stakeholders.
Presents high quality reports and findings in Power BI or as presentations.
Builds metrics reporting systems and tracks process improvements across the team.
Conducts analysis using statistical software, databases, spreadsheets, and reporting tools
Designs, evaluate and monitor key metrics, understanding root causes of changes in metrics
Develops and maintains scripts and queries to import, manipulate, clean, transform data from different sources
Builds and shares live dashboards and reports complete with user documentation
Builds and trains statistical models for hypothesis testing
Performs quality assurance on generated results to ensure accuracy and consistency
Presents conclusions in a clear and concise way


The Next Great Data Analyst Needs


Relevant experience in a past analytical role.
Expert data visualization techniques for charts and reports - good knowledge of Microsoft Power BI and/or Tableau.
Unstructured Data handling - Know best practices on how to stage unstructured data and properly model it to solve the problem at hand
Must have very good database and SQL knowledge, NoSQL and elastic search - a strong bonus.
Data Analysis - good knowledge of R language, MS Excel mastery, including VBA, PivotTables, and array functions - or other similar tools used for discovering data patterns and correlations through statistical methods.
Good math and analytical skills including statistics, simulation, and optimization.


We Thought You Might Also Want To Know


Where are we located? The EA Vancouver Office is located in suburban Burnaby, British Columbia
EA is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$77,700 - $107,900 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, and extended health/dental/vision coverage and basic life insurance.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. Title: Data Analyst II, Fraud
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind.

Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders

About the Role:

As a Data Analyst, Fraud, you will be part of Remitly's Identity & Trust Analytics Team. Your mission is to leverage analytical methods to identify, prevent, and mitigate fraud impacting our customers globally. You will develop a deep understanding of Remitly's fraud detection systems, regional risk profiles, and operational processes to improve fraud defenses while maintaining a seamless experience for legitimate customers. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business Management, and Compliance to customize and optimize fraud models and workflows, integrating data from legacy and new platforms. This hybrid role requires 2–3 days per week in the Vancouver office.

You Will:


Become an expert on Remitly's fraud data (e.g. chargebacks, promo abuse, scams, onboarding risk).
Build data-driven models and dashboards to analyze and monitor fraud exposure, balancing customer experience with operational efficiency.
Collect, normalize, and analyze data from legacy prebriefs, transaction logs, and onboarding systems to identify fraud trends and behavior anomalies.
Partner with Business Management and Product to continuously improve customer verification, KYC, KYB and compliance workflows.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure fraud control effectiveness and minimize false positives.
Develop and track risk metrics that quantify fraud exposure, policy compliance, and system performance.
Provide actionable insights and influence the development of fraud detection strategies, tools, and automation.


You Have:


3+ years in an analytics or fraud/risk analysis role within fintech, e-commerce, or digital payments.
Experience with fraud or trust analytics.
Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, economics, or another quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience).
Proficiency with SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large datasets (Python, R, or statistical modeling experience preferred).
Strong understanding of fraud taxonomies (chargebacks, identity theft, scams, onboarding risk, and promo abuse).
Demonstrated ability to distill business problems, develop hypotheses, perform analysis, and communicate clear recommendations.
Excellent data storytelling and communication skills; ability to translate complex findings into business decisions.


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125000. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits


Four weeks vacation
Health Benefits
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
RRSP plan with company match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Life Insurance & Disability
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.Under the Company's current hybrid-work expectations, employees in this position work onsite Tuesday through Thursday each week. Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs, and the Company may modify its hybrid-work expectations from time to time. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Title: Underwriting Analyst
Description:
We are seeking an Underwriting Analyst to join our team in Toronto, Montreal, Winnipeg, or Burnaby. The Underwriting Analyst supports and enhances underwriting tools, reporting, pricing, and quoting systems while developing technical solutions for ad hoc underwriting requests.

This can be a hybrid or remote role.

The Underwriting Analyst Will


Analyze and interpret large and complex datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights for clients and internal stakeholders.
Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models using Excel, Power Query, and other analytical tools.
Assist with the development and continuous improvement of underwriting tools, processes, reporting automation, and data management practices.
Gain familiarity with pricing analysis and evaluating new business opportunities through TPA channels in order to be able to maintain and improve existing quote tools.
Analyze claims experience, demographic data, financial results, and carrier proposals to develop recommendations and support strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with carriers, consultants, Account Managers, brokers, and internal teams to gather data and ensure accurate underwriting outcomes.
Identify plan performance, claims trends, and reporting issues, and recommend solutions to internal stakeholders.
Prepare renewal analysis and reporting packages, including support for insurer negotiations.
Support new sales initiatives and revenue growth objectives through data-driven analysis and underwriting expertise.
Provide underwriting and analytical consulting services to various stakeholders.

About the Role
Application Form
About Connor, Clark & Lunn F…


Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.

Title: Content Analyst
Description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.


The salary range for this position is $55,000 to $61,000 per year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location.

Full time

Worker Type

Employee

Job Exempt (Yes / No)

Yes

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success and we strive to provide employees with a competitive total rewards package which includes:

Hybrid working environment
RRSP Contributions

Work flexibility Programs

Study Support

Description:
Job Description

We are seeking an Intermediate Data Analyst to support the evolution of analytics across the Sawmills Division. This role will help deliver reporting modernization initiatives, migrate reporting assets from legacy platforms, develop Power BI solutions, and contribute to emerging digital twin, AI and automation capabilities.

The successful candidate is a curious problem-solver who enjoys working with business stakeholders to transform data into actionable insights while developing expertise in modern analytics platforms.

Responsibilities


Partner with business teams to understand reporting, analytics, AI or automation needs.
Gather business requirements and translate them into reporting, data engineering, AI agent or automation solutions.
Support the development and testing of AI-enabled and automated solutions by validating data, documenting requirements, and assisting with user adoption activities.
Contribute to PowerBI semantic model engineering, data transformation processes, and reporting standards.
Develop, maintain, and improve dashboards, reports, visualizations, semantic models
Perform data validation, quality assurance, and data pipeline troubleshooting activities.

Minimum of five (5) years of experience in business software development, business intelligence analysis, statistics, or software project management

Project Management Professional (PMP) designation and/or Change Management certification

Title: Data Analyst, Corporate Human Resources
Description:
Job Description

We are seeking a customer‑focused Data Analyst to join our Corporate Human Resources team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on turning data into actionable insights, enjoys engaging with stakeholders, and is passionate about empowering others to advance their analytics capabilities. You will contribute to building our enterprise data foundation—including the development of our data lake, secure data access, and advanced reporting—and support analytics across the HR function. The role also involves applying AI technologies and building analytical agents to automate insights and enhance decision‑making. The salary range for this position is between $60,000 - $85,500 annually.

Responsibilities


Partner with business and leaders to understand operational challenges and develop data‑driven solutions that support strategic decision‑making.
Act as a trusted advisor, educating internal customers on analytics tools, data literacy, and best practices for self‑service and data‑informed thinking.
Support the development and evolution of the enterprise data lake, including defining requirements, validating datasets, and enabling downstream analytics.
Manage user security and access controls to maintain governed, appropriate data access.
Deliver analytics and reporting across Human Resources, providing visibility into performance, risks, and trends.
Build and deploy AI‑powered analytics capabilities, including agents that automate data processing, summarize insights, and augment reporting workflows.
Lead requirements‑gathering sessions and translate business needs into effective reporting and visualization solutions.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI and Alteryx.
Analyze complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that influence business decisions and initiative selection.
Identify opportunities to automate, optimize, and standardize data and analytics processes.
Support data governance practices including data quality, integrity, metadata standards, and stewardship.
Mentor colleagues on interpreting data, leveraging analytics, and applying emerging AI tools effectively.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in analytics, data management, or business analysis.
Experience applying AI in a business context, including building or deploying AI agents.
Experience working with data lakes, data pipelines, or enterprise data platforms is an asset.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
Proficiency in Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, and Excel.
Ability to explain complex analytical and AI concepts in clear, engaging ways for non‑technical audiences.
Strong problem‑solving abilities and a creative, innovative approach to analytics.
Background in statistics, Lean, or Six Sigma is an asset.

Founded in 1882, J.D. Irving, Limited (JDI) operates in Eastern Canada (New-Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Québec, Ontario, Newfoundland and Labrador), as well as in USA. Title: Talent Acquisition Analytics & AI Specialist
Description:
About Boomi and What Makes Us Special

Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.

How You'll Make An Impact

Are you a data-fluent, technically minded analytics professional looking to build the future of Talent Acquisition (TA)? We are looking for a TA Analytics & AI Specialist to join our team during a pivotal chapter. 

In this role, you won't just pull standard reports—you will own the data pipeline from our source systems into Snowflake, build advanced dashboards in Power BI, and architect AI agents to automate high-friction TA workflows. If you are a systems thinker who thrives on writing optimized SQL, configuring API connections, and leveraging advanced prompt engineering to scale operations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Implementation & Data Architecture 

Act as the technical data lead, ensuring data fields, schemas, and historical data migrate with 100% integrity.
Partner with IT and Enterprise Data teams to manage our TA data pipelines inside Snowflake and write optimized SQL queries to blend disparate datasets.
Audit, clean, and rebuild calculated fields, data schemas, and dashboards to ensure absolute data integrity across platforms.

 AI Agents & Automation Orchestration

Design, test, and deploy autonomous AI agents and automated workflows to eliminate manual TA administrative tasks and maximize operational efficiency.
Leverage advanced LLMs like Claude (including Artifacts, Projects, and API connections) for rapid data prototyping, drafting complex code scripts, and building intelligent automation loops.
Find creative ways to use generative AI and API integrations to streamline TA operations, absorbing manual administrative overhead through tech.

 Cross-Functional Reporting & Predictive Analytics

Own the end-to-end delivery of weekly, monthly, and quarterly TA metrics, narrative reports, and automated dashboards for critical stakeholders, including the Head of TA, the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), Finance, HRBPs, and Regional TA Leaders.
Translate complex datasets into clean, scannable visual stories and data packets that cross-functional, non-technical stakeholders can easily action.
Move beyond standard, lagging indicators to design advanced capacity models, hiring velocity forecasts, and pipeline bottleneck analytics.
Design and execute data projects that bridge the gap between TA and the business—such as correlation studies tying interview/assessment data to on-the-job performance.

 The Experience You Bring

Experience: 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or systems operations
The Hard Tech Stack: Strong, hands-on proficiency in writing complex SQL queries and building dynamic dashboards in Power BI or Tableau. Direct experience working with relational databases and data warehousing tools like Snowflake is highly preferred
AI & Agent Fluency: Advanced proficiency using Claude or similar LLMs to build reports, analyze complex datasets, and prototype technical data solutions. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, connecting APIs, and building AI agents/automated workflows
Systems Thinker: High attention to detail. You enjoy figuring out how "Field A" in one system impacts "Report B" in another, and you understand how data orchestration impacts downstream analytics

 Bonus Points If You Have

Exposure to HR/Talent Acquisition data structures and schemas.
Hands-on experience building integrations or orchestrating workflows using the Boomi platform. 

 Aren’t sure if you’re a match? We know that impostor syndrome and the confidence gap can prevent us from meeting spectacular candidates — so don’t hesitate to apply; you could be the perfect fit!

Compensation and Benefits 

Boomi is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Base compensation for this position in our Vancouver hub ranges from $92,000 - $115,000 CAD annually + applicable bonus. Final compensation will be determined by various factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location.

 

Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi. We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.  

Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

Title: Data Prioritization Analyst
Description:
Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

In the increasingly complex world of financial services, accurate and complete data is critical for Risk management, financial reporting and regulatory compliance. Ensuring data governance begins with an understanding of financial services data, identifying the critical elements (CDEs), data quality controls and resolving data issues.

As a Data Prioritization Analyst with the data prioritization team, you will be accountable for working with various Data domains to prioritize critical data associated with business processes. Reporting to the Associate Director, you will work in collaboration with other teams providing data services such as the DMO’s, Data Lineage, Data Quality, Metadata management, and Data Completeness Teams.

What will you do?

Data Prioritization


Create and support repeatable, robust process to identify Data Elements that are most critical and has the highest impact on RBC’s key processes. Seek out industry trends and organizational knowledge to understand alternative approaches / solutions to propose viable options
Engage Data Domain stewards and Business Unit leadership to identify and define key business processes and prioritization and identification of critical reports
Engage Report Owners and their delegates to prioritize data utilizing the enterprise approved Critical Data Element (CDE) identification methodology.
Support other Data Management activities.
Identify, capture and curate metadata associated with CDEs (such as Business Term, Data Classification, Owning Data Domain, vintage tags among other things) for U.S. key regulatory reports.
Accountable for IHC Regulatory Reporting Data Domain metadata associated with Data Prioritization / CDEs to be present in Collibra, Enterprise Data Governance Platform.


Communication and Documentation


Document the critical data, its usage in business process and reports and rationale for critical data in firm standard CDE memo document template
Engage with key stakeholders from Risk Management, Finance, Liquidity, AML and other business Units
Manage and report on work status, including escalating execution risks in a timely manner


Training and Continuous Improvement


Gain and apply an in-depth understanding of data management, data governance, and metadata tools and systems to support the definition and documentation of effective data elements.
Work with the Chief Data Office and other Data Management Offices to support standards and best practices to improve data quality, participating in initiatives to raise awareness and drive improved data quality across the organization (e.g., Data Working Groups, Data Literacy projects).


What do you need to succeed?

Must-have


2-3+ years of experience in Data Management, Accounting, risk management, and/or Data Analysis

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

  

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.
Experience with data mining, predictive analytics, machine learning, and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is an asset.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.

Our Team Members enjoy life at Home with our strong culture of support and inclusion, excellent benefits, and a team that always has your back. You will receive:

The expected starting salary range for this role is $85,800 - $128,600; the final offer will reflect relevant skills and experience.
Eligible for the annual bonus program.
Comprehensive Benefits Program including:
Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with Company Match, and choice of contribution level.
Group RRSP.
Discount from our Corporate Retail Store in St. Jacobs.
Home & Auto Insurance discounts.
Competitive vacation time.
Personal and sick time.
Employee Discount Program through Venngo WorkPerks.

Title: M5 Process Analyst
Description:
Reporting to the Manager of Fleet and Facility Analytics and M5 Support. This position monitors data interfaces between M5, SAP, and other applications (e.g., ROB, P6) to identify and investigate data errors, requiring advanced knowledge of databases, SQL, and systems management. Using specialized skills and advanced analytical techniques, it works alongside OCT to ensure key interfaces supporting billing, payroll, and supply chain function effectively.

This role optimizes the use of the M5 system to align with Fleet Services and City business needs by designing aligned business processes. Additionally, it serves as a point of contact for Assetworks Fleet Management Information System (M5) user support, handling inquiry resolution, issue investigation, access management, and advice.

This position is also responsible for reviewing and verifying payroll data prior to transfer to the payroll system, collaborating with supervisors and timekeepers to resolve time reporting issues, and post-transfer data validation. It requires strong data skills and understanding of payroll rules across 3 unions.

What will you do?


Guide users on navigating system features, screens, dashboards, and reporting tools
Update user documentation following software upgrades to reflect layout updates and enable adoption of new features
Manage user access administration, including provisioning new accounts, adjusting roles, disabling departing user profiles, and handling password resets
Respond to user inquiries, offer system usage guidance, and develop operational workarounds independently or in coordination with the Fleet Information System Administrator, end users, or vendor support
Serve as the primary contact for M5 interface operations, maintaining real-time and batch integrations with core COE systems (e.g., SAP, PeopleSoft, ROB)
Escalate complex interface issues to OCT when unresolvable internally by the Fleet Information Administrator
Evaluate integration requirements, prepare technical specifications, and conduct impact testing for core system updates or new M5 releases
Monitor interface management tools to resolve transmission errors and collaborate with staff to rectify data rejection causes
Review employee-reported hours for completeness, verify statutory holiday pay accuracy, and resolve issues before data is loaded into the payroll system via the interface. A strong knowledge of the 3 union Collective Bargaining Agreements and their payroll rules is essential
Collaborate with branch supervisors and timekeepers to ensure payroll time approvals are completed prior to pass-off, and provide guidance on handling exceptional situations
Reconcile payroll data between the Fleet System and the payroll system post-pass-off to confirm successful data uploads
Apply requested adjustments in the payroll system after pass-off and prior to the payroll cutoff deadline
Audit billing and system data to uncover business process or system errors affecting data quality
Pinpoint user behaviors resulting in data discrepancies and offer recommendations for training and coaching support
Log support tickets with the software vendor upon detecting system bugs causing errors
Assist frontline staff with proper data entry to maintain data integrity and facilitate smooth interface data transfers
Analyze business process challenges against system functionality to identify conflicts, partner with stakeholders on solution development, lead testing, and perform necessary analysis to ensure resolution
Perform related duties as assigned



Qualifications:


University Degree in a related discipline such as Computer Science or Information Technology and 2 years of relevant experience in an Information Technology environment. Formal certification in the area of expertise is desirable
Minimum of 2 years of experience directly related to database querying, managing computer interfaces, data analysis and troubleshooting system issues
Oracle SQL is required



Assets:


Experience with SAP interfaces and M5 are assets
Experience in a Fleet environment is an asset



Skills required for success:


Knowledge of work methods, practices and terminology related to the Fleet Management Service industry and Fleet Management databases
Strong capability to bridge customer requirements and technical system specifications when resolving complex issues
Proficiency in conducting thorough research, rigorous testing, and comprehensive documentation
Aptitude for evaluating program interdependencies to deliver actionable, well-reasoned recommendations
Proven communication and collaborative skills
Skill in auditing extensive datasets (e.g., billing files) to maintain data accuracy and completeness
Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and data extraction tools including SQL Developer, Crystal Reports, and Tableau
Solid project management abilities, with a focus on prioritizing work to consistently meet operational deadlines
Demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues and contribute effectively within a team setting
Alignment to our Cultural Commitments and Leadership Competencies ( https://bit.ly/4brRrXm )
Embracing a culture of equity, diversity, reconciliation and inclusion



Conditions of Employment:


This position will work out of a facility that is not accessible via public transportation. A valid Class 5 license and access to personal transportation is recommended



Work Environment:


Note: This position may be eligible for a hybrid work arrangement with the flexibility to work from both home and the worksite as per the Letter of Understanding between the City of Edmonton and Civic Service Union 52
The weekly hours of work for this position are currently under review and may change at a future time. Any changes will be made in accordance with the City of Edmonton/Civic Service Union 52 collective agreement and the incumbent will be notified in advance

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.

Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.

Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.

Title: Vineyard Business Analyst
Description:
Winemaking in some major regions of the world can be an ‘industrial’ undertaking, but for us here at Iconic Wineries of British Columbia, every decision in the vineyard has a direct impact on the quality of what ultimately ends up in the bottle.

Exceptional vineyards require more than great farming practices. They require clear insights, strong operational discipline, and the ability to understand the story behind the data.

Our vineyards generate vast amounts of information every season, from labour and productivity metrics to purchasing activity, operational costs, vineyard performance trends, and planning data. The opportunity is no longer collecting data. It is transforming that information into meaningful insights that help our teams make better decisions.

The Role

As our Vineyard Business Analyst, you will play a critical role in helping us better understand, measure, and optimize the performance of our vineyard operations. Sitting at the intersection of data, operations, finance, and viticulture, you will transform complex operational information into actionable insights that improve productivity, strengthen cost visibility, and support decision-making across our vineyards. This is a highly collaborative role that combines business analysis, operational reporting, procurement support, and data visualization. You will work closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, and finance partners to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and build reporting tools that provide clarity across vineyard operations. More than a reporting role, this is an opportunity to bring a fresh perspective, challenge assumptions with data, and help shape how vineyard performance is measured and managed for years to come.

Productivity & Performance Analytics


Measure and monitor vineyard productivity, labour efficiency, and operational performance across activities, blocks, sites, and seasons.
Analyze key operational metrics including hours per acre, cost per activity, labour utilization, and year-over-year performance trends.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Translate complex operational data into practical recommendations that vineyard leadership can act on.
Support annual planning processes through productivity benchmarking, workforce analysis, and operational forecasting.
Develop meaningful performance indicators that help leaders understand operational effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.


Data Visualization & Reporting


Design and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that provide visibility into vineyard performance and operational health.
Transform data from multiple operational systems into meaningful business insights.
Develop reporting frameworks that allow teams to proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Present data in a clear and compelling way, helping stakeholders understand the story behind the numbers.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accessibility across vineyard reporting processes.
Create visualizations that simplify complex datasets and support informed decision-making at all levels of the organization.


Financial Analysis, Procurement & Cost Visibility


Support procurement and purchasing activities by validating invoices and ensuring alignment to approved budgets and plans.
Monitor vineyard operating costs and spending trends to improve financial visibility across the organization.
Partner with Finance and operational teams to improve cost reporting and forecasting accuracy.
Identify potential productivity or cost-related risks before they become larger operational challenges.
Maintain disciplined documentation and reporting standards that support planning, budgeting, and operational decision-making.
Help establish stronger cost controls and spending transparency across vineyard operations.


Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


Partner closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, finance teams, vendors, and stakeholders across the business.
Build trusted relationships while introducing new ways of measuring and evaluating operational performance.
Support the development of data-driven processes that improve consistency and operational discipline across vineyard operations.
Bring curiosity, fresh thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset to help evolve how work gets done.
Contribute to a culture where decisions are informed by data, insight, and transparency.
Act as a bridge between operational teams and data, ensuring insights translate into meaningful action.


Who You Are


Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Agriculture, or a related discipline.
2+ years of experience in business analysis, operational analytics, financial analysis, supply chain, procurement, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced Excel skills with strong capabilities in data manipulation, reporting, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to transform data into actionable recommendations.
Comfortable working with both operational and financial datasets in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders through data and insights.
Experience in agriculture, wine, food manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, or operational environments is considered an asset, but not required.
Naturally curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by solving problems and improving processes.
Able to translate complex information into simple, practical business recommendations.


What's In It For You


A rare opportunity to help build and shape how vineyard performance is measured across one of Canada's most respected premium wine organizations.
Visible impact across vineyard operations, influencing planning, budgeting, productivity improvement, and operational decision-making.
Exposure to vineyard operations, finance, procurement, business analytics, and strategic planning in one highly collaborative role.
The opportunity to create reporting tools and processes that become foundational to how our teams operate.
A role where your insights directly influence business decisions rather than sit in a report.
Partnership with experienced vineyard, finance, and operational leaders who value curiosity, fresh thinking, and continuous improvement.
The ability to bring a fresh lens, challenge legacy processes, and make a measurable impact on how the business operates.
Opportunity to grow your scope and influence as our vineyard analytics and reporting capabilities continue to evolve.


Why Join Us?

Iconic Wineries of British Columbia is committed to hiring, engaging, and growing qualified, talented, and motivated team members at every level of our organization. We offer competitive compensation that recognizes individual and company performance. The typical hiring range for this position is $65,000 - $80,000 annually, complemented by a bonus plan. Base pay is determined by market location and job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and education.

As part of our Total Rewards program, we are also proud to offer:


Access to company-matched RRSP contributions
Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans with 24/7 access to care and support for you and your family
Paid time off
Training and development to build a fulfilling career


At Iconic Wineries of British Columbia, We Exist to Unearth the Extraordinary

Best in Our Craft

We set the standard with a pursuit of excellence that can be found in everything from our products and processes to our vineyards and people.

Ambitiously Curious

We stay curious, dreaming big and navigating the unknown with an enduring belief in better.

Made With Humility

We bring humility, authenticity, fun, and support to every collaboration and celebrate wins as a team.

Daringly Disruptive

We disrupt the status quo, moving fast to seize opportunities and acting scrappy to stay ahead of industry giants.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Hi, we're HUB!

We are a leading North American insurance brokerage that advises businesses and individuals on how to reach their goals. When you partner with us, you're at the center of a vast network of risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management specialists that bring clarity to a changing world with tailored solutions and unrelenting advocacy – so you're ready for tomorrow.

The Opportunity!

This is a permanent, full-time position, reporting to the Director, Business Intelligence at HUB Canada West (HCW).

As the Data Scientist, you are the technical engine of a small, high-leverage analytics function. This role exists to turn HCW's growing data foundation across cloud data platforms and SQL into measurable business value: predictive models, self-serve analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-powered tools that change how branches and leadership make decisions.

The successful candidate brings classical data science fundamentals (statistics, machine learning, experimental design) and is equally comfortable in the emerging world of AI engineering: prompting and orchestrating large language models, building reusable AI workflows, and integrating LLMs into BI products. As the discipline of data science continues to converge with AI engineering, we want someone who can move fluidly across both.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor and a generalist problem solver. You enjoy ambiguity, you pick up new tools quickly, and you care about outcomes more than orthodoxy.

What You'll Bring To Our Team -


5+ years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics engineering, advanced analytics, or a directly related applied technical role.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or similar). Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered in lieu of formal credentials.
Background in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is a strong asset, with practical familiarity with concepts such as policies in force, premium, retention, and producer compensation.
A generalist, problem-solving mindset: comfortable picking up new tools, languages, and platforms; energized by ambiguity rather than blocked by it.


Skills & Competencies

Must-Haves


Strong SQL skills, including comfort with complex joins, and query optimization against large datasets.
Strong Python skills for analysis, modelling, and automation (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), plus practical experience with ML Algorithms such as Random Forest, Recommender Systems or Clustering.
Demonstrated production experience with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and the ability to design dashboards that leadership can intuitively use.
Working knowledge of statistics, machine learning fundamentals, and model evaluation; able to choose the right tool for the question rather than reaching for the most complex one.
Demonstrated ability to use Claude (or other AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or equivalent) as a serious working tool: structured prompting, iterative refinement, awareness of failure modes, guardrails, and the discipline to verify outputs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical findings into business decisions and to write clearly for executive audiences.


Nice-to-Haves


Experience building Claude Skills, artifacts, MCP server integrations, or agentic AI workflows.
General familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, is a plus as HCW's data environment evolves.
Experience with light data engineering tooling such as dbt, Airflow, or Cloud Composer.
Comfort with version control (Git), code review practices, and collaborative development workflows.
Familiarity with Canadian data privacy requirements (PIPEDA) and the practical realities of working with sensitive customer and HR data.


A Day in the Life -

Analytics And Modelling


Design and deliver applied analytics and machine learning solutions across sales, retention, finance, operations, and talent (for example, customer segmentation, churn and renewal probability, book of business analytics, producer performance modelling).
Translate ambiguous business questions from leadership into structured analytical problems, choose the right level of methodological rigour for the decision at hand, and communicate results in plain language.
Apply solid statistical thinking to model evaluation, uncertainty quantification, and the honest framing of data quality limitations.


AI Engineering


Build and maintain production-grade prompts, Claude Skills, and AI-assisted workflows that extend HCW's analytical reach (for example, manager-facing prompt playbooks for self-serve call analytics).
Integrate large language models with HCW data sources to enable natural-language analytics, automated narrative generation, and intelligent document processing.
Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and bring promising techniques into HCW thoughtfully, with appropriate guardrails.


Data Access And Transformation


Extract, join, and transform data from HCW's data warehouse, Power BI semantic layer, and other source systems to support analytical work. Note: this is not a heavy data engineering role. Platform, ingestion, and core pipeline work sits primarily with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT. The Data Scientist is expected to access and shape data, not to build the warehouse.
Engineer features, build reproducible analytical pipelines, and document data lineage and assumptions.


Business Intelligence And Self-Serve


Build interactive Power BI dashboards that make analytical output usable by branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives.
Develop reusable Power BI templates and data structures that let branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives self-serve their own analysis without relying on ad hoc analyst support.
Track adoption of Power BI reports and dashboards, and surface how they are being used to drive measurable business value across branches and leadership.


Automation


Identify high-friction manual reporting and operational workflows, then automate them using Python, scheduled data pipeline jobs, Power Automate, or AI-powered workflows.
Design automation that is observable, recoverable, and trusted by the business.


Stakeholder Engagement And Communication


Work directly with the COO, regional leadership, and operational managers to scope work and present findings.
Coach and uplift the broader BI community of practice on Python, SQL, AI tooling, and analytical thinking.
Collaborate with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT on data standards, governance, and shared platform decisions.


Salary Expectations -

The expected salary range for this position is $90,000.00 to $115,000.00 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate's skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position's business line, scope, and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include extended health benefits, disability insurance, RRSP matching, paid-time-off benefits, and eligible bonuses. If you believe that your qualifications and experience surpass the minimum requirements for this role, we encourage you to submit your application. By doing so, we will be able to keep your application on file for consideration for potential future positions within our organization.

Why Join HUB?


Do you enjoy making friends? We love making friends; join our team of amazing people who all get along and thrive together!
We work hard and play hard! Get ready for our Staff Holiday Parties!!
Paid day off for your birthday – we want to celebrate you!
Paid day off for volunteering in your community – HUB is a company that gives back and is active in our communities.
Room to grow within the organization.
Lots of company perks, benefits, RRSP matching and great compensation.


Your Future with HUB -

Choose a career with HUB International and take the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction. By joining HUB, you will become part of a rapidly growing company that offers significant opportunity for advancement.

At HUB, we value education and continuous learning, and we will assist you along your career development path. We provide HUB Ready training for new employees, as well as financial support for licensing, industry designations, management & leadership development, and other related courses, designations or programs.

Hi, we're HUB!
