Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team to help build out the analytics and data infrastructure behind one of our newer business lines. You'll start by strengthening the production dashboards and data onboarding that our stakeholders rely on every day, then move into designing new data models largely from the ground up, helping shape what additional data sources could sharpen our analysis.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership: you'll work directly with stakeholders across the business to understand what they need, shape the data models and pipelines that get them there, and communicate your findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. If you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy building something net new, and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You’ll Do


Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and onboarding data pipelines that our business stakeholders rely on.
Design and build out new data models largely from scratch, helping identify additional data sources that could strengthen our analysis.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis and reporting.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings, models, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We’re Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, i.e., Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience with consumer credit or lending analytics, ideally from a banking background.
Fintech or SaaS fintech experience is strongly preferred.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.
Python or another coding language.
Experience with dbt,Airflow, and Snowflake.


Why You’ll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership – opportunity to build your process and influence the company workforce and at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by leading a critical part of our customer experience.
You’ll have a broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - 125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Experience defining and tracking KPIs and metrics

Work from Home Flexibility

Role: Logistics Data Analyst

Reports to: Senior Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics

Status: Full-Time, Regular

Division: Enercare Home and Commercial Services

Location: Markham (Birchmount)

Compensation: $69,136 - $110,618

Please note that the compensation range listed includes base salary and potential incentive pay. Incentives such as bonuses are not guaranteed and depend on individual performance and company results. Actual compensation within the range will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

About The Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics, the Logistics Data Analyst plays a critical role in transforming warehouse, distribution, inventory, and service parts data into actionable insights that drive measurable operational improvements.

This role supports Enercare's supply chain strategy by developing dashboards, analyzing operational performance, improving inventory accuracy, and enabling data-driven decision-making across logistics, warehousing, and field service operations. The successful candidate brings strong analytical rigor, curiosity for operational processes, and the ability to convert complex datasets into meaningful recommendations that improve service levels, productivity, inventory management, and customer outcomes.

Accountabilities

Performance Management & Reporting


Develop, maintain, and continuously improve operational dashboards and performance reporting related to inventory accuracy, replenishment effectiveness, Parts on Truck (POT%), technician productivity, and other key logistics KPIs.
Transform large and complex datasets into actionable insights and recommendations for operational leaders and stakeholders.


Inventory Accuracy & Control


Redesign and manage ABC, control-group, and random cycle count programs; conduct gap analysis; establish counting frequencies; and recommend SOP improvements to improve inventory accuracy and compliance.
Support root-cause investigations and corrective actions related to inventory variances, stock discrepancies, and transaction integrity.


Warehouse & Distribution Analytics


Analyze warehouse and distribution material flow (receiving → put-away → storage → picking → packing → shipping) to identify bottlenecks, reduce cycle times, and improve operational efficiency.
Monitor inventory movement, aged inventory, and replenishment performance and recommend actions to improve service levels and reduce working capital.


Parts & Field Service Analytics


Conduct truck stock and service parts analytics, including usage modeling, min/max optimization, seasonality reviews, replenishment cadence evaluation, and standard truck stock recommendations aligned to 80/20 principles.
Develop insights and recommendations that improve Parts on Truck (POT%), parts availability, technician productivity, and First-Time-Fix performance.


Continuous Improvement & Automation


Support continuous improvement, Lean, and 5S initiatives by translating KPI trends into practical operational improvements, standard work, and visual management solutions.
Monitor, validate, and maintain analytical tools, dashboards, and automated reports to ensure data integrity and usability.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve data quality, and eliminate manual processes.


Ad Hoc Analysis & Business Support


Deliver high-quality, decision-grade analytics to support operations, procurement, supply planning, and cross-functional business initiatives.
Collaborate with operational leaders to identify performance gaps and develop actionable solutions.


Operational Flexibility


This role will evolve with the needs of the business. The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate flexibility and agility by taking on additional duties, special projects, and cross-functional responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives, operational priorities, and continuous improvement initiatives.


KPIs You Will Influence


Inventory Accuracy (%)
Cycle Count Compliance (%)
Variance Closure Time
Parts Replenishment Stability
Min/Max Adherence
Parts on Truck (POT%)
Technician Productivity
Inventory Availability and Fill Rate
Aged Inventory Reduction
Improvements correlated to First-Visit - Rate (FVR) through optimized truck stock and parts availability


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
4-7+ years of experience in warehouse, distribution, inventory, or supply chain analytics with a demonstrated history of improving operational KPIs.
Proficiency with ERP, WMS, and reporting systems; SAP experience is considered a strong asset.
Advanced Excel skills and experience using Power BI for dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience working with SQL, Power Query, or other data analysis and transformation tools is considered an asset.
Experience cleaning, transforming, validating, and analyzing large operational datasets.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to develop structured, pragmatic, and actionable analytical approaches.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of logistics operations, including inventory control, replenishment, receiving, warehousing, picking, shipping, and supplier performance management.
Familiarity with Lean principles, 5S, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Zynga Poker is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do


Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behaviour to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which aims to significantly increase each analyst’s impact through the power of LLMs
Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 4 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies

We are seeking an Analyst, Business Intelligence to support the design, development, and maintenance of interactive dashboards and reports for Inventory Management stakeholders. Responsibilities

Job Description

Document data models, report logic, KPIs, and business definitions related to inventory management.
Provide training and support to end-users on Power BI dashboards and self-service inventory analytics capabilities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization, working capital reduction, and service level performance.
Leverage Python for advanced data analysis, automation, and data transformation (e.g., building data pipelines, performing complex calculations, and enhancing Power BI datasets through integrated workflows).

3–5 years of experience in BI/reporting roles, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Power BI.
Strong proficiency in:
Power BI Desktop & Service
Power Query (M language)
Data modeling concepts
Solid understanding of Inventory Management and accounting principles.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.) is an asset.
Hands-on experience with Power BI Service, including workspace management and deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric (Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, or related components) is an asset.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Description:
About the Canadian Bankers Association

The Canadian Bankers Association is the voice of more than 60 domestic and foreign banks that help drive Canada’s economic growth and prosperity. The CBA advocates for public policies that contribute to a sound, thriving banking system to ensure Canadians can succeed in their financial goals. cba.ca.




Job title: Analyst, Benchmarking & Data Analytics

Division: Corporate Strategy & Operations

Location: Toronto

Reports to: Director, Data Strategy, Information Management & Governance




Overview




Reporting to the Director, Data Strategy, Information Management & Governance, the Analyst is responsible for collecting, validating, and analyzing data related to the financial services industry to produce banking industry reports and benchmarking outputs. The role places a strong emphasis on interpreting industry data, identifying trends, and translating findings into meaningful insights that reflect banking sector activity and developments. The Analyst will actively engage with member banks to support accurate data submissions, clarify context, and ensure reporting remains representative of the industry. The Analyst is also expected to analyze data trends to support briefing notes, publications, and other advocacy-related materials. The role includes applying strong data governance and data quality practices, and maintaining clear documentation of data structures, definitions, and metadata to support transparency and consistency across reporting. Familiarity with business intelligence and data platforms (such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent tools) is required to support report creation.




Description of Responsibilities




Serve as a primary resource for banking industry benchmarking reports and a secondary resource for supporting advocacy and industry-focused initiatives
Perform regular updates by working with member banks to collect, validate, and input data into banking industry databases and benchmarking reports, ensuring reporting is timely and accurate
Analyze, evaluate, validate, manipulate, and cross-reference data while applying formal data quality rules, controls, and reconciliation processes to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness of industry reporting
Interpret financial services data to identify trends, patterns, and developments within the banking industry
Support the development of briefing notes, publications, and other advocacy‑related materials through data analysis and trend interpretation
Apply departmental procedures to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and consistency of the data collected
Co-ordinate and participate in meetings with member banks, as required, to address concerns relating to data quality
Assist with industry surveys, as required, including supporting development, data collection, and analysis of results
Provide research and analytical support to cross‑divisional teams, CBA staff, and member banks to support understanding of banking industry trends and current issues
Maintain and update data dictionaries, metadata definitions, and data catalog entries to ensure transparency, usability, and alignment across benchmarking datasets and industry report
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of data governance frameworks, including standards for data definitions, metadata management, quality controls, and documentation




Key Qualifications, Abilities and Skills




Undergraduate degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related analytical discipline, with 3–5 years of experience in data analytics and reporting, including hands-on use of BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Microsoft Fabric)
Experience applying data governance and data quality practices, including validation, reconciliation, and maintaining clear documentation of data structures, definitions, and metadata
High level of accuracy and attention to detail, with a structured approach to data validation, documentation, and reporting consistency
Exceptional numeracy, quantitative, analytical and research skills including the ability to think critically and present concise and accurate information
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain data insights and work effectively with bank members and stakeholders
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders, as required
Experience in the financial services industry is preferred; related knowledge such as financial and accounting principles, completion of the Canadian Securities Course (CSC) and a working knowledge of French are considered beneficial

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates throughout the recruitment process.




To apply for this position, please send your resume and accommodation requests, if needed, to talentmanagement@cba.ca, quoting the job title that you are applying for.




We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at the CBA; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Data Analyst, Product
Description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

We are looking for a Data Analyst, Product who will play a pivotal role in bridging data insights with strategic business decisions as Relay enters an exciting new chapter of growth. As we’ve grown, we need support from you in bridging the gap between data insights and strategic product or business decisions, influencing the direction and success of Relay. You'll be instrumental in ensuring that our product & business teams are empowered with deep, actionable insights, enabling us to make informed, data-driven decisions that resonate with our customers' needs.

What You'll Be Doing


Collaborating with cross-functional teams by proactively proposing analytical solutions and data insights that drive improvement in key strategic pillars
Ensuring teams have the necessary data they need to function effectively by identifying and tracking core KPIs on top of building dashboards and reports
Performing in-depth analysis to drive fresh insights, and inform business recommendations by presenting trends to stakeholders
Monitoring and evaluating data quality to ensure the accuracy and consistency of data
Consistently delivering high-quality data models, easy-to-interpret visuals (such as charts, graphs and dashboards), and reports that demonstrate a strong understanding of business needs and objectives
Apply statistical methods to dissect and interpret data, aiding in the prediction and evaluation of new product features and market opportunities. This includes conducting A/B tests and measuring the impact of product changes on user behaviour
Synthesize information from diverse sources. Integrate and analyze data from user feedback, surveys, operational metrics, and event logs to connect insights directly to business outcomes
Regularly reporting outcomes and insights to stakeholders across Relay, including the senior leadership team, providing a clear narrative of the impact on business objectives, thereby influencing future data-driven decision-making


Who You Are


You have 2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in another data-focused role
You are fluent in SQL, including writing complex queries, working with window functions, optimizing performance, and understanding data warehousing concepts and security best practices. You're able to clearly explain your approach and reasoning, not just produce a working query
You have experience using business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Metabase, Sigma, Periscope, Mode, or similar platforms
You have a track record of using data to influence business decisions. You enjoy turning complex analyses into clear, actionable insights that drive meaningful outcomes.
You start with the business problem before jumping into the data, asking thoughtful questions to understand the context and objectives
You have experience working with large datasets, from exploration and analysis through to delivering insights. You're comfortable working independently while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
You communicate clearly, build strong relationships with stakeholders, and enjoy collaborating across multiple teams
You thrive in ambiguity and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment where priorities, processes, and data infrastructure continue to evolve


Bonus Points


Experience with cloud computing (AWS, GCP or Azure) and familiarity with cloud data warehouse platforms (Bigquery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
Familiarity with dbt for data modelling, automation, or experimentation
Experience with a data-oriented programming language (Python, R)
You’ve joined a company at its early stages and have seen it through scale


The Interview Process


Stage 1: A 30-minute Google Meet video call with a member of the Talent Team
Stage 2: A 60-minute Google Meet video call with the Hiring Manager
Stage 3: A take-home case study, followed by a 60-minute Google Meet video call with members of our Data team.
Stage 4: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of our Leadership team


Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.

The annual salary range for this role is $99,000 CAD to $121,000 CAD.

For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $110,000 CAD. Offers below this point reflect candidates we believe can grow into the full scope of the role with support and development. Offers above this point reflect impact that meaningfully exceeds the role’s defined expectations or an expanded scope from day one.

We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub.

Why Relay Might Be the Perfect Fit For You


You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.
You crave autonomy: We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’re someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.
You own your work: You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
You build with AI, not just use it: You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.
You care about impact, not noise: You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself.
You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity: You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.
You seek out feedback: You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.
Small businesses are why we're here: Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.


Join Us

We're looking for people who are relentless, curious, and care deeply about the work. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description -- your perspective and drive matter more. We welcome diverse backgrounds and people who think critically, challenge the status quo, and want to help small businesses thrive.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the hiring process, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

  • You have experience using business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Metabase, Sigma, Periscope, Mode, or similar platforms
  • You have a track record of using data to influence business decisions. You enjoy turning complex analyses into clear, actionable insights that drive meaningful outcomes.
  • You start with the business problem before jumping into the data, asking thoughtful questions to understand the context and objectives
  • You have experience working with large datasets, from exploration and analysis through to delivering insights. You're comfortable working independently while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
  • You communicate clearly, build strong relationships with stakeholders, and enjoy collaborating across multiple teams
  • You thrive in ambiguity and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment where priorities, processes, and data infrastructure continue to evolve

Bonus Points

  • Experience with cloud computing (AWS, GCP or Azure) and familiarity with cloud data warehouse platforms (Bigquery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)

Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.

Title: Data & Research Analyst
Company: Royal College of Dental Surgeons of Ontario
Description:
The Royal College of Dental Surgeons of Ontario (RCDSO) is a leader in health care regulation. As the governing body for more than 12,000 dentists in Ontario, our mission is to act in the public interest by putting patients first. We are committed to transparency, accessibility, openness, and fairness in all our work.

 

Bring your excellent analytical and research skills to our team as a Data & Research Analyst within our Office of the Registrar (OTR) department.

 

The OTR department ensures that the College meets its mandate of patient protection and putting patients first in all the work that we do. They set the College’s strategic priorities, and oversee our regulatory functions and compliance, as well as operations. OTR maintains various stakeholder relationships, including working with the College’s Council, committees, and government relations. 

 

You will leverage data collected by the College to generate meaningful insights that support operational excellence, regulatory effectiveness, and strategic decision-making. Working with both structured and unstructured data, you will conduct descriptive, exploratory, diagnostic, and predictive analyses, identify trends and emerging issues, and communicate findings through clear reports, visualizations, and presentations to diverse audiences.

 

You are a curious and analytical professional with a strong attention to detail and a passion for evidence-informed decision-making. You enjoy investigating complex questions, translating data into actionable insights, and collaborating with stakeholders to support organizational priorities and continuous improvement.

 

This role will require the successful candidate to work remotely, with the capacity to attend mandatory in-person meetings as required. Requests to work in-office will be accommodated.

 

At this time, we are only considering candidates located in Ontario or who are willing to relocate and who are authorized to work in Canada.

  

What can I expect to do in this role?

Reporting to the Data Scientist, you will:

Work with departments to identify operational and strategic issues related to extracting value from their data
Identify and define departmental analysis and research needs
Contribute to metadata documentation within enterprise and non-enterprise systems
Analyze small and large datasets to provide descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analyses using univariate and multivariate techniques with potential to develop and present results via reports and slide decks
Conduct appropriate statistical analyses to explore strengths of associations, identify predictions and find trends with the data
Summarize findings when reviewing publicly accessible organizational documentation such as annual reports, online stats or internal analyses
Review and summarize analytical results into reports, presentations and narratives/stories using data visualizations (e.g. charts, graphs, infographics)
Liaise with external system partners (including government and researchers) to identify common research needs that may lead to insight into our data and process and may generate new forms of knowledge to share with the wider oral health community
Conduct data quality analyses to verify the accuracy and reliability of data extracted from Enterprise systems
Utilize project management and agile principles when overseeing and supporting project

 

What skills and background do I need?

The Data & Research Analyst requires:

Undergraduate or associate degree in a related field or a combination of education and relevant experience; master’s and PhD with thesis/dissertation emphasis is an asset
Demonstrated educational experience in the following domains are preferred: statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, economics, sociology, cognition, engineering, neuroscience, psychology, health sciences and data science
Proven experience with hypothesis testing, inferential statistics, predictive modelling within a non-academic organization
Three- to five- years of understanding and coding experience with statistical programming languages or those with statistical and data frame packages for the purpose of statistics, data cleaning and report generation; examples include statistical analysis, database manipulation and report generations such as R, Python, SAS, Stata, SPSS, etc.
Basic coding experience with Microsoft SQL Server (or other programs using SQL) to join and refine tables for future analytics
Proficiency with MS 365
Strong ability to convey complex problems to a wide range of stakeholders and knowledge levels
Experience presenting findings to department or within the organization; experience presenting at conferences an asset
Flexible, adaptable and a demonstrated commitment to learning new skills, software and knowledge domains
Proven organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities to meet deadlines
Experience with gathering requirements from external stakeholders related to data request lifecycle including concepts related to intake communication and analysis, requirements gathering, request analysis, de-identification, report generation and secured data transfer)
Experience researching health information, health data or health policy concepts through environmental scans, literature searches and website navigation are assets
Experience in the healthcare sector as it relates to health data organizations, health facilities or research units an asset
RCDSO is building its bilingual (French/English) capacity and excellent French language proficiency is an asset

 

Compensation and Total Rewards  

Base annual hiring salary from $91,184.94 to $102,583.06, commensurate with experience
Comprehensive extended health benefits package, paid vacation, wellness and sick days 
A matched Pension Plan (up to 8% of salary), Voluntary Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA) and Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP)
Career-related learning and development opportunities
Half-day Fridays between July 1st and September 1st as well as a half-day workday before statutory holidays
Onsite gym, corporate discount to GoodLife Fitness, and wellness-related webinars
Opportunities to connect with colleagues through virtual and in-person social events

How do I apply?

To apply to this vacancy please submit your resume and cover letter describing why you are interested in this position and how your knowledge and skills may be well suited for the role via the RCDSO Job Portal on our Careers page by September 10, 2026 at 5 pm.

 

Our recruitment process is conducted remotely unless otherwise specified. Candidates are welcome to request an in-person interview.

 

Thank you for your interest; only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. 

 

Our inclusive, flexible and collaborative workplace helps us build better regulation that puts the public first. RCDSO does not currently utilize artificial intelligence in its recruitment and selection process.

 

Accommodation is available upon request under the Ontario Human Rights Code.

 

www.rcdso.org

Title: Senior Client Insights Analyst
Description:
The Team

The Senior Client Insights Analyst plays a vital role in the firm’s Pricing & Client Insights team, focusing on client portfolio and legal matter analytics and reporting. This includes developing dashboards and data visualizations for stakeholders across the firm. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Client Insights, this role is part of the broader Client Insights & Client Matter Intake function and can be based in any Canadian office.

You Will Be Focusing On


Collect, consolidate, and analyze client/matter data to prepare reports and presentations
Conduct periodic and ad hoc client portfolio and matter performance analyses
Collaborate with Pricing, Finance, Business Planning & Analysis, and Pursuits teams to provide accurate and timely reporting
Support the development of best practices for client insights
Assist in assessing client insights processes and identifying improvements to enhance satisfaction and profitability
Research and manipulate client insights data to assess key metrics and trends
Ensure accuracy across various data sources
Contribute to process improvement initiatives, including tool implementation and report development
Prepare and distribute monthly client insights reports for stakeholders
Prioritize tasks and resolve issues efficiently
Engage with external clients when needed
Support price benchmarking initiatives
Assist with special projects as required


What You Bring To The Role


Bachelor's degree or diploma in a quantitative field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Analytics, Data Science)
3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role
Strong interpersonal, communication, analytical, and data management skills
Familiarity with change management and process improvement
Client service-oriented mindset
Ability to build relationships internally and externally
Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
Effective research and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently using sound judgment
Results-driven with the ability to meet tight deadlines
Proficiency in MS Excel, SAP, and/or Business Objects
Knowledge of data visualization tools (Tableau and Power BI)
Bilingual in French and English is an asset


Why Join Our Team


Hybrid work environment
Retirement savings plan with employer contribution
Benefit premiums paid by the firm
Telemedicine services
Wellness matters: Flexible health and wellness allowance that covers much more than gym memberships!
Training and development programs based on your interests and needs

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Activations
Description:
Join a Challenger

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving? The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.

We can’t wait to get to know you!

The Work

As a Senior Data Analyst on the Activation, Next Best Action team, you will be instrumental in leveraging data, advanced analytics, and modeling to drive critical business outcomes. You will provide key insights that drive Next Best Action strategies across the customer lifecycle, helping optimize onboarding, activation, engagement, and long-term customer growth for banking products. You will leverage data to personalize customer journeys, improve channel performance and profitability, and support effective credit risk management for our credit card portfolio. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and strong communication skills to translate complex data into actionable recommendations across various functional teams.

What You'll Do


Leverage diverse datasets to generate actionable insights that support Next Best Action (NBA) strategies, optimize onboarding and activation journeys, and drive business growth.
Develop, monitor, and refine NBA strategies across various channels, utilizing advanced analytics, modeling, and statistical testing (e.g., A/B, multi-variate) to optimize profit.
Conduct in-depth analyses of onboarding campaigns, and customer journeys, identifying opportunities for revenue growth and cost reduction.
Design, develop, and present comprehensive reporting (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly) and automated dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker) to monitor key performance indicators and track financial/operational controls.
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, sales, and media teams to define analytical requirements, implement end-to-end campaign tracking, and deliver customer-focused solutions.
Continuously improve and automate data extraction, analysis, and reporting processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, concise, and compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, fostering data-driven decision-making.


What You Bring


Minimum of 3-5 years of progressive experience in data analysis, sales and marketing analytics, financial modeling, or data mining, with a strong focus on extracting actionable insights from large datasets.
Experience in digital banking, marketing, or credit risk is a significant asset.
Post-Secondary education or equivalent experience in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science/Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, or Business Administration, coupled with a solid understanding of data analytics principles.
Expert in SQL for querying large, complex datasets (BigQuery Standard SQL is a plus).
Demonstrated experience with statistical software (e.g., SAS, R, Python) and/or programming/scripting languages.
Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models for customer segmentation, propensity modeling, and personalization.
Hands-on experience with digital analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics) and media platforms (e.g., Google Marketing Platforms, Facebook) Proficiency in developing reports and interactive dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker).
Strong understanding of database structures and schemas.
Advanced MS Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint).
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
Solid understanding of digital marketing and eCommerce best practices.
Proven ability to communicate complex analytical findings and strategic insights effectively, both verbally and in written presentations, to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and quality in all deliverables.
Ability to manage multiple complex projects, prioritize effectively, and deliver high-quality results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated personal accountability and a results-oriented approach.


What we offer [For full-time permanent roles]

💰 Competitive discretionary bonus

✨ Market leading RRSP match program

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits

📝 Employee Share Purchase Plan

👶🏽 Maternity/Parental top-up while you care for your little one

🏝 Generous vacation policy and personal days

🖥 Virtual events to connect with your fellow colleagues

🎓 Professional development and comprehensive Career Development program

💛 A fulfilling opportunity to join one of the top FinTechs and help create a new kind of banking experience

The incumbent will be working hybrid and in office time will be spent working from EQ Bank’s additional office space located at 2200-25 Ontario Street, Toronto, ON.

EQ is committed to building an inclusive, accessible environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported. We believe our organization is stronger — and our people thrive — when we honour and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives. We’re equally committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally.

All candidates considered for hire must successfully complete a criminal background check and credit check. Title: Consultant, Reporting and Analytics
Description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As a member of CIBC’s Capital Markets Technology team, the Consultant, Reporting and Analytics is responsible for supporting the delivery of advanced advice in data analytics, providing research and insights, and ensuring senior management has the relevant information to make informed decisions. The Consultant, Reporting and Analytics applies strong problem framing and solving skills, translate business questions to data requirements and analytical solutions; provides insights that inform decisions influencing department strategy, performs in-depth analysis of research information to identify opportunities, develop relevant dashboards, and makes recommendations for business use. The role performs tasks of technical depth and breadth, utilizing a solid understanding of business dynamics to conduct impact analysis and provide feedback on problems with recommended solutions involving Business Intelligence.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 2-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You’ll Succeed


Data Analysis & Insights - Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to uncover trends and opportunities. Use SQL and Pyspark to process and prepare data for PowerBI dashboard.
Visualization & Reporting - Build interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, or Python visualization libraries.
Strategic Thinking – Drive, manage and execute data and reporting projects and initiatives in alignment with CIBC Strategy while supporting the business goals, objectives, and key performance indicators. Ability to think strategically about how to mobilize and engage teams across the enterprise to deliver strategic change.
Innovative Problem Solving - Actively lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of complex data analytics and visualization solutions
Communication - Excellent verbal and writing skills to effectively articulate ideas and opinions that involve analysis, processes, and technology solutions to others with different disciplinary backgrounds. Ability to produce a variety of business documents that demonstrate command of language, clarity of thought and orderliness of presentation.


Who You Are


You can demonstrate experience in: 3–5 years in data analytics, business intelligence, or related roles. You must have at least 2 years of experience with PowerBI; coupled with at least 4 years of SQL experience. It’s an asset if you have Python and Microsoft Copilot Studio experience, and if you’ve worked within Capital Markets/Equities.
You have a degree in a quantitative field (i.e. mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics, engineering, physics, business) or equivalent experience. Advanced degree is an asset (i.e. MMA, MBAN, MSc, MA, MBA). You have the “Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate” certification.
You are a problem solver. You have exceptional critical thinking, problem solving and decision-making skills with demonstrated ability to independently identify and analyze business problems and recommend solutions.
You demonstrate knowledge in organization's Information Technology (IT) environment and understand the integration / interdependencies of various processes across a line of business.
Your influence makes a difference. You know that relationships and networks are essential to success. You inspire outcomes by sharing your expertise.
You’re digitally savvy. You seek out innovative solutions and embrace evolving technologies. You can easily adapt to new tools and trends.
You're motivated by collective success. You know that teamwork can transform a good idea into a great one. You know that an inclusive team that enjoys working together can bring a vision to life.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.


What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.


We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions


What You Need To Know


CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.
You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.
We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).

Title: Analyste, Données sur la santé et programmation statistique/ Analyst, Health Data & Statistical Programming
Description:
À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) professionnel(le) rigoureux(se) et analytique pour soutenir la réalisation de projets de recherche, d’analyse et de production de rapports destinés à nos clients. La personne retenue contribuera à l’analyse de données liées aux prescriptions, aux soins médicaux et à la santé afin de générer des informations pertinentes qui soutiennent les activités commerciales, les besoins des clients, le développement de solutions et l’innovation de produits.

Ce poste convient parfaitement à une personne possédant de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, une bonne base en analyse de données et un intérêt pour l’application de méthodologies statistiques et de programmation à des enjeux concrets du secteur de la santé et des affaires. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes de projets expérimentées afin de concevoir des analyses, préparer des résultats, appuyer la production de rapports et contribuer à la livraison de projets de grande qualité.

Principales responsabilités


Réaliser des analyses pour des rapports destinés aux clients, des besoins d’affaires et des projets de recherche.
Sous la supervision de son gestionnaire, planifier et effectuer des analyses de données liées aux prescriptions, aux soins médicaux ou à d’autres données de santé afin de soutenir les objectifs des études et d’en dégager des conclusions exploitables.
Identifier, recueillir, nettoyer et préparer les données en utilisant des méthodes appropriées conformément aux exigences des projets et des études.
Générer, interpréter et présenter les résultats analytiques afin de répondre aux besoins internes de l’entreprise et aux attentes des clients.
Développer et maintenir des programmes, outils et livrables analytiques répondant aux besoins des clients internes et externes.
Appliquer les méthodologies standards aux projets de recherche assignés et soutenir la production de rapports standards et personnalisés.
Collaborer avec les équipes de projet afin de déterminer les solutions de données appropriées, développer des modèles analytiques, effectuer les analyses et préparer des résumés écrits des résultats.
Réaliser la programmation nécessaire à la création et à l’exécution de modèles analytiques ainsi qu’à la production de résultats interactifs pour les clients à l’aide d’outils tels que SQL, Python, Tableau et Excel.
Participer aux activités d’assurance qualité, de validation des données, de résolution des problèmes liés aux données et à d’autres activités de gestion des données.
Identifier les risques pouvant affecter la qualité ou la livraison des projets et les signaler aux responsables ou gestionnaires de projet tout en proposant des mesures d’atténuation pratiques.
Participer activement aux réunions d’équipe, fournir des mises à jour régulières sur l’avancement des travaux et contribuer au partage des connaissances au sein de l’équipe ou du service.
Sous supervision, contribuer aux stratégies de programmation, au développement d’outils ou de macros spécifiques aux projets, au respect des procédures opérationnelles standard et à l’efficacité des communications liées aux projets.


Qualifications


Baccalauréat en statistique, économie, mathématiques, informatique de la santé, science des données, administration de la santé ou dans un domaine connexe requis.
Maîtrise, MBA ou autre diplôme d’études supérieures pertinent considéré comme un atout.
Expérience pertinente acquise dans le cadre d’un stage, d’études ou d’un emploi en analyse de données, analyse statistique, programmation, analytique de la santé ou analytique de recherche considérée comme un atout.


Compétences et expérience requises


Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de résolution de problèmes et aisance à travailler avec des ensembles de données complexes.
Maîtrise avancée de Microsoft Excel, incluant les formules, la manipulation de données ainsi que les activités d’analyse et de production de rapports.
Connaissance pratique de SQL.
Capacité à interpréter les données, identifier les tendances et transformer les résultats en livrables clairs et significatifs.
Grande attention aux détails ainsi que de solides compétences en planification, organisation et suivi des dossiers.
Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément, à communiquer efficacement et à travailler de façon autonome avec un encadrement approprié.
Approche collaborative et aptitude à établir des relations de travail efficaces avec ses collègues, gestionnaires et équipes de projet.


Compétences techniques


SQL et applications Microsoft Office.
Connaissance avancée ou approfondie de Microsoft Excel.
Une expérience ou une connaissance de Tableau et Python est considérée comme un atout.
Une connaissance des technologies Microsoft liées aux serveurs, aux postes de travail et aux réseaux est un avantage.


Connaissances et aptitudes privilégiées


Connaissance des méthodes analytiques, de la conception de projets, des mathématiques, de la gestion de projet, de l’amélioration des processus, du développement de solutions et de la résolution de problèmes.
Capacité à identifier de manière proactive des problèmes complexes et des besoins d’affaires, puis à élaborer des solutions ou recommandations pratiques.
Capacité à soutenir les méthodologies et approches analytiques associées aux projets de recherche assignés.


Ce que vous apporterez

Vous êtes une personne analytique, organisée et à l’aise avec l’utilisation des données pour résoudre des problèmes concrets liés aux affaires et aux besoins des clients. Vous aimez approfondir les détails, travailler de façon autonome et utiliser des outils comme SQL et Excel pour dégager des informations pertinentes à partir de données complexes du secteur de la santé. Vous communiquez clairement, gérez efficacement vos priorités et êtes fier(ère) de produire un travail précis et de grande qualité dans des délais serrés mais réalistes.

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

Il s’agit d’une excellente occasion de contribuer à des projets d’analyse et de recherche ayant un impact réel sur la prise de décision des clients, les activités de l’entreprise et le développement de solutions. Vous acquerrez une expérience précieuse dans l’analyse de données de santé, l’analytique des programmes de soutien aux patients, la production de rapports, la programmation, le contrôle de la qualité et la prestation de services orientée client, tout en évoluant au sein d’une équipe expérimentée et collaborative.

About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical professional to support the delivery of client-facing research, analytics, and reporting projects. The successful candidate will contribute to the analysis of prescription, medical, and healthcare-related data, helping generate meaningful insights that support business operations, client needs, solution development, and product innovation.

This role is well suited to someone with strong problem-solving skills, a solid foundation in data analysis, and an interest in applying statistical and programming methodologies to real-world healthcare and business questions. You will work closely with experienced project teams to design analyses, prepare findings, support reporting, and contribute to high-quality project delivery.

Key Responsibilities


Conduct analyses for client reports, business needs, and research projects.
Under guidance of their manager, plan and conduct analyses of prescription, medical, or related healthcare data to support study objectives and derive actionable findings.
Identify, collect, clean, and prepare data using appropriate methods aligned to project and study requirements.
Generate, interpret, and report analytical findings to meet internal business and external client needs.
Develop and maintain programs, tools, and analytical outputs that support internal and external client requirements.
Apply standard methodologies to assigned research projects and support the delivery of both standard and custom reports.
Work with project teams to determine appropriate data solutions, develop analytical models, run analyses, and prepare written summaries of study results.
Conduct programming needed to build and run analytical models and generate interactive model results for clients, using tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau, and Excel.
Support quality control, data validation, data issue resolution, and related data management activities.
Identify risks to project delivery or quality and escalate concerns to project leads or managers, while suggesting practical mitigation approaches.
Participate actively in project team meetings, provide timely progress updates, and contribute to knowledge sharing across the team or department.
Under supervision, contribute to programming strategies, project-specific tools or macros, standard operating procedure compliance, and effective project communication.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, health informatics, data science, health administration, or a related field required.
Master's degree, MBA, or relevant advanced degree preferred.
Relevant internship, academic, or professional experience in data analysis, statistical analysis, programming, healthcare analytics, or research analytics preferred.


Required Skills And Experience


Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and comfort working with complex datasets.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, data manipulation, and analytics/reporting work.
Working knowledge of SQL.
Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, meaningful outputs.
Strong attention to detail, planning, organization, and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, communicate clearly, and work independently with appropriate guidance.
Collaborative working style and ability to build effective relationships with colleagues, managers, and project teams.


Technical Skills


SQL and Microsoft Office applications.
Advanced or extensive knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
Tableau and Python experience / familiarity are considered valuable optional skills.
Familiarity with Microsoft server, workstation, and networking technologies is beneficial


Preferred Knowledge And Capabilities


Knowledge of analytical methods, design, mathematics, project management, process improvement, solution development, and problem resolution.
Ability to proactively identify complex problems and needs, and develop practical solutions or recommendations.
Ability to support methodology and analytical approaches for assigned research projects.


What You'll Bring

You are analytical, organized, and comfortable using data to solve practical business and client problems. You enjoy digging into details, working independently, and applying tools such as SQL and Excel to create meaningful insights from complex healthcare data. You communicate clearly, manage priorities effectively, and take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work within tight, but manageable, deadlines.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful analytics and research work that supports client decision-making, business operations, and solution development. You will gain exposure to healthcare data, patient support program analytics, reporting, programming, quality control, and client-focused delivery while learning from an experienced, collaborative team.

À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) professionnel(le) rigoureux(se) et analytique pour soutenir la réalisation de projets de recherche, d’analyse et de production de rapports destinés à nos clients. La personne retenue contribuera à l’analyse de données liées aux prescriptions, aux soins médicaux et à la santé afin de générer des informations pertinentes qui soutiennent les activités commerciales, les besoins des clients, le développement de solutions et l’innovation de produits.

Ce poste convient parfaitement à une personne possédant de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, une bonne base en analyse de données et un intérêt pour l’application de méthodologies statistiques et de programmation à des enjeux concrets du secteur de la santé et des affaires. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes de projets expérimentées afin de concevoir des analyses, préparer des résultats, appuyer la production de rapports et contribuer à la livraison de projets de grande qualité.

Principales responsabilités

  • Réaliser des analyses pour des rapports destinés aux clients, des besoins d’affaires et des projets de recherche.
  • Sous la supervision de son gestionnaire, planifier et effectuer des analyses de données liées aux prescriptions, aux soins médicaux ou à d’autres données de santé afin de soutenir les objectifs des études et d’en dégager des conclusions exploitables.
  • Identifier, recueillir, nettoyer et préparer les données en utilisant des méthodes appropriées conformément aux exigences des projets et des études.
  • Générer, interpréter et présenter les résultats analytiques afin de répondre aux besoins internes de l’entreprise et aux attentes des clients.
  • Développer et maintenir des programmes, outils et livrables analytiques répondant aux besoins des clients internes et externes.
  • Appliquer les méthodologies standards aux projets de recherche assignés et soutenir la production de rapports standards et personnalisés.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de projet afin de déterminer les solutions de données appropriées, développer des modèles analytiques, effectuer les analyses et préparer des résumés écrits des résultats.
  • Réaliser la programmation nécessaire à la création et à l’exécution de modèles analytiques ainsi qu’à la production de résultats interactifs pour les clients à l’aide d’outils tels que SQL, Python, Tableau et Excel.
  • Participer aux activités d’assurance qualité, de validation des données, de résolution des problèmes liés aux données et à d’autres activités de gestion des données.

  • Participer activement aux réunions d’équipe, fournir des mises à jour régulières sur l’avancement des travaux et contribuer au partage des connaissances au sein de l’équipe ou du service.
  • Sous supervision, contribuer aux stratégies de programmation, au développement d’outils ou de macros spécifiques aux projets, au respect des procédures opérationnelles standard et à l’efficacité des communications liées aux projets.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat en statistique, économie, mathématiques, informatique de la santé, science des données, administration de la santé ou dans un domaine connexe requis.

  • Expérience pertinente acquise dans le cadre d’un stage, d’études ou d’un emploi en analyse de données, analyse statistique, programmation, analytique de la santé ou analytique de recherche considérée comme un atout.

Compétences et expérience requises

  • Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de résolution de problèmes et aisance à travailler avec des ensembles de données complexes.

Compétences techniques

  • SQL et applications Microsoft Office.

  • Une expérience ou une connaissance de Tableau et Python est considérée comme un atout.
  • Une connaissance des technologies Microsoft liées aux serveurs, aux postes de travail et aux réseaux est un avantage.

Connaissances et aptitudes privilégiées

  • Connaissance des méthodes analytiques, de la conception de projets, des mathématiques, de la gestion de projet, de l’amélioration des processus, du développement de solutions et de la résolution de problèmes.

Vous êtes une personne analytique, organisée et à l’aise avec l’utilisation des données pour résoudre des problèmes concrets liés aux affaires et aux besoins des clients.
